body:
Fight to the finish

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_11_3_pm2&n=1)
---
Peter,
Which drink sounds most tempting: **Gasoline, nail polish remover, or a delicious green smoothie?**
---
---
My name is Mar, I’m on Dr. Stein’s social media team, and **I created that video in September because I was TIRED of hearing about “the lesser of two evils”.** I reject both evils – I’m voting for Dr. Stein, the only anti-genocide candidate with a path to the White House. The candidate who stopped me in my tracks when she locked arms with student protesters as police pressed her down with a bicycle. [**If you’re rejecting evil too, please contribute to the Stein/Ware campaign as they fight for us in this final push.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_11_3_pm2&n=2)

---
As I’ve fought the genocide of Palestinians this year, I’ve stopped trusting people, organizations, and institutions that refused to stand up and fight Israel’s brutal regime. **But Dr. Stein is different. I’m proud to support her as a human rights activist, veterinarian, feminist, and Muslim American woman of color.**
---
---
I’ve always been passionate about fighting for human rights, marginalized communities, animal wellbeing, and our planet’s health. Dr. Stein’s platforms on justice, the environment, student debt, Black liberation, and 2SLGBTQIA+ rights make me honored to stand with her. [**Click here to watch the viral smoothie video**](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=RJ3f0iceFrE9eH0E0hYe8ePGJ6KdHqvFZ1-cZKMdy8fgBAXCa6UL4ilfvhHE9pdY&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_11_3_pm2&n=4) I recently reposted that video as part of my final push to support Dr. Stein. To my surprise, it was censored by Meta. **You read that right. My funny video comparing Dr. Stein to a healthy green smoothie was flagged and censored by Meta.** Their reasoning? It contains “graphic violence”. (No it doesn’t.)
---
---
**This type of blatant censorship just makes me prouder and more determined to stand for my beliefs by voting for Dr. Stein.** It shows that we’re up against powers that will stoop to any level to undermine our message. It shows our movement is powerful – we’re a threat to corporate greed, colonialism, the military industrial complex, big pharma, AIPAC, and much more. They have seemingly limitless resources and control so much of what we’re exposed to, and my smoothie video is just one example. **We may not have the billions of dollars they have, but we have one thing they don’t:** _**Something worth fighting for.**_ [**Let’s band together in this fight to the finish. Join me in supporting Jill Stein and Butch Ware for President and Vice President** :](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_11_3_pm2&n=5)

Peter,
There’s some insane youth voter suppression going on around Florida right now and no one is talking about it.
**Here’s what’s going on:** I’ve been in Florida the past few days helping to get out the vote for Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidate (and my friend), Nate Douglas. Yesterday, we were reaching out to students at a college football tailgate at UCF when I heard from multiple students that they haven’t voted yet because the line is too long.
I’m talking 2-3 hour waits for early voting at the University of Central Florida where there are 12 voting booths for 50,000 students. 👎
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241103-2?refcode=em20241103-1406&amount=5&refcode2=1406_587540_uarc9l&akid=1406%2E587540%2Euarc9l)**
This was the line to vote early. Yesterday, it was 2-3 hours long and it was about to rain. (spoiler alert, same thing is happening today too)
This is straight up election interference by one of DeSantis’ minions, the Orange County Supervisor of Elections, who is actively suppressing youth voter turnout at the University of Central Florida.
**[If you are as outraged as I am right now, will you contribute $5 to do everything we can to launch a voter outreach effort ahead of Election Day?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241103-2?refcode=em20241103-1406&amount=5&refcode2=1406_587540_uarc9l&akid=1406%2E587540%2Euarc9l)**
For context, I asked multiple people how long the wait is in a different (older) part of the district and it’s only a 10 minute wait to vote there.
Previously, the state was trying to ban early voting on college campuses for which it was sued. The courts forced the State to allow it. Now, they’re just making it extremely time-consuming to vote on college campuses.
Today, they’ve added more voting booths but the lines are still this long. Students are turning out massively and UCF happens to overlap with Nate Douglas’ district.
**This situation outlines how urgently we need to reach every voter and equip them with the information they need to cast their vote. Not only that, we need to make the case for candidates – like Nate – who are fighting to regain abortion rights or enact common sense gun laws.**

subject: A blue wave is coming to Ohio!
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I hope you’re feeling the energy – because I certainly am!
Just this week, new internal polling from the Harris campaign shows they’re winning late-deciding voters by double digits, thanks in no small part to Trump’s unhinged Madison Square Garden rally.
We saw the same effect on our race after Trump and Jim Jordan smeared the people of Springfield, Ohio with racist lies.
It’s proof that people are tired of chaos and division.
All the ingredients are there for a Blue Wave to wash over Ohio, flipping the House and pushing MAGA extremism out of power.
But here’s the thing: we can’t leave anything to chance.
We have just 48 hours left to lock this in and show Jim Jordan and Trump that Ohio is ready for real change. Will you chip in $20 or whatever you can today to help fuel our momentum through the finish line? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241103_blue_wave_link1]
Imagine a future where our communities are true neighbors again – where we look out for one another, not shout each other down over politicians.
A world where families can come together without debates turning into arguments, where we talk about hopes and plans, not who’s angrier about the latest ULTRA-MAGA stunt.
We can have that world.
A place where our seniors aren’t worried about losing their benefits, where veterans are honored with action instead of empty words, and where the voices of women, workers, and every Ohioan are respected and heard.
We can be a state and a country where hard work is rewarded, healthcare is protected, and no one is made to feel like their rights are a political bargaining chip.

Everyone is focused on the presidential polls, but they forget that key statewide races that impact voting rights -- from governor to attorney general to secretary of state to the state supreme court -- are also on the line in a few weeks.

Fox News: North Carolina removes 747,000 from voter rolls [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110324_4&amount=25]
Team: More than 700,000 North Carolinians had their voter registration “purged” before Election Day. The State Elections Board made the announcement of compliance with state law.
This means that North Carolina -- emerging as a crucial state in this year's election -- completed their removal of roughly 10% of their 7.7 million registered voters a little more than a month before the election.
T hese state by state purges, driven by lies and disinformation, often disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . We've seen it reported in other states, like Georgia, and we're sure it's the case in North Carolina this year too.
What can we do about it with just weeks to go and voting already starting? To start, you can ask your friends and family in North Carolina to check their registration status, make sure they are still on the rolls, and make a plan for voting. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39262%2E3422442%2ESHERn9)
Derek,
Right now, everyone is paying a lot of attention to the presidential swing states. That’s understandable because we must send Kamala Harris to the White House and keep Donald Trump out of it.
**But, we can’t take our eyes off what’s happening in states like California.** To deliver on Kamala’s agenda of growing the middle class, protecting the right to an abortion, and safeguarding our democracy, we need to elect a Democratic majority in the House.
We need to keep up volunteer and donor engagement here in California to win House seats and retake the majority, even though our state isn’t competitive at the presidential level. Check out this recent headline:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241103-2?refcode=em20241103-39262&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39262_3422442_SHERn9&akid=39262%2E3422442%2ESHERn9)
We have an incredible opportunity on Tuesday to flip the House of Representatives and turn the page on two years of Republican dysfunction in Congress. To do that, we can’t let up until polls close.
Katie has known for years that flipping California swing districts is key to Democrats taking back the House. Tomorrow, Josh Hawley will embark on a one-day tour of Missouri.
It would take any average Missourian nearly all day to complete the tour by car -- and that's without stopping!
**But thanks to Posh Josh Airlines, Hawley can continue his luxury lifestyle by literally flying over Missouri between each stop.** In most cases, he won't even leave the airport!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d3a8507c-995f-45ac-b25d-bf40daa31c9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
FEC reports filed last month revealed that during Hawley's last one-day tour of Missouri with Harrison Butker, his campaign spent $68,000 on private flights in a single day -- the same amount as the median yearly household income in Missouri.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d3a8507c-995f-45ac-b25d-bf40daa31c9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then, when Hawley was called out for repeatedly treating Missouri like flyover country during our debate last week, he didn't handle it so well...
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1f2edd56-318d-420f-bf55-760767dd65c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Missourians deserve a U.S. Senator who actually travels the state and meets with voters -- not another out-of-touch elite who only visits Missouri an average of**[six times per year.](https://substack.com/redirect/61319b1d-043c-4a7a-95ca-ad142c683862?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **
That's why my campaign has made it a priority to hold events across the state -- in rural, urban, and suburban areas -- and hear from voters about the issues most impacting them.
**So before I ask you to[add a donation of $25 to my campaign so we can turn out the voters I've met with all across Missouri during this race,](https://substack.com/redirect/d3a8507c-995f-45ac-b25d-bf40daa31c9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I wanted to share some of my favorite photos from the events my campaign held and attended in October. **

| Friend, There are just 2 days left until one of the most critical elections our state has ever seen. Will we protect our Live Free or Die values, or become another Massachusetts? **It was reported this weekend that the Democrats, backed by big out-of-state special interests and liberal activists, will spend a record amount of money trying to flip our state house. ** We've done an exceptional job fundraising this year thanks to true Granite Staters like you, but we still need to raise a little bit more to keep up. We are thrilled to report that support for Kamala Harris is overwhelmingly positive! However, a critical issue threatens to undermine this progress: numerous Democratic voters, particularly those with disabilities, are being sidelined due to glaring accessibility issues at polling stations. _This Election Day, your support for Able Dems is more vital than ever._
Did you know that about one in three voters has a disability? It's alarming that in today's society, these individuals still face significant barriers that impede their fundamental right to vote.
_This isn't just an inconvenience—it's a direct threat to the human rights and representation of disabled individuals and other protected groups._
Able Dems is steadfast in its commitment to champion the election of Democrats with disabilities and our staunch allies. We are here to change the narrative from being passive subjects to active decision-makers at the policy table.
**The equation is simple: when we fight, we win. But to fight effectively, we must first ensure that everyone can reach the battlefield. Your generous donation empowers us to break down these barriers, providing essential resources and support to boost electoral accessibility.**

Critical election integrity updates ahead of Tuesday’s vote
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

**November 3, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi friends, are you ready for the final countdown? **2 days to go.**

I’ll be headed to Washington D.C. tomorrow to join UK’s Channel 4 live on election night on a panel with some great guests at 6:45MST, you can watch [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
It’s certainly going to be a wild 48 hours, here’s some highlights of the last few days....
**The polls are all over the place** , but here’s a positive take from Mark Mitchell at Rasmussen on [www.townhall.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.):
_The presidential race has been close for the most part, with Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump going neck-and-neck throughout the entire campaign season. However, just days before votes begin to be calculated, a new poll shows Trump winning in a landslide._
_Rasmussen’s head pollster made a striking prediction about the winner of the 2024 election._
_Mark Mitchell suggested that Trump will take a significant lead nationally and among critical battleground states, positioning him to win in a landslide._
_“What you’re hearing out there is that the polls are close, and I think that’s wrong,” he told Breitbart News. “I think the polls, on average, show a strong Trump win, and my polls taken independently show that as well.”_
_Mitchell predicted a significant Trump landslide victory that would mirror Ronald Reagan’s historic win against Jimmy Carter in 1980. He also pointed out that most people “don’t care who Kamala Harris is.”_
Many other takes with Kamala in the lead so it will be exciting to see who’s right and who’s not Tuesday night!
**The Libertarian Party recently[filed a lawsuit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) against Colorado Secretary of State** Jena Griswold following an alarming security breach that [exposed BIOS passwords for the state’s voting machines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). There’s a hearing tomorrow afternoon at 1:30pm MST at the Denver District Court on Bannock, Division 275. Show up if you can! Exposed passwords could allow unauthorized access and tampering with election data, sparking serious questions about Colorado’s voting security after this breach. This legal action demands accountability and urges Secretary Griswold’s office to strengthen security protocols immediately. For Colorado voters, this incident raises concerns over the reliability of electronic voting systems just days before they head to the polls.
**With election day around the corner** , both parties are ramping up their efforts in key swing states, adopting what insiders are calling a [“pull the goalie” approach](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This tactic—reserved for last-ditch efforts—signifies an all-out push to mobilize voters, focusing heavily on close battleground areas where even a slight edge could determine the outcome. This strategy highlights just how high the stakes are this election cycle and reflects a broader urgency among party leaders to [drive voter turnout, despite fluctuating polls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). It’s a reminder of the pivotal role that turnout can play in shaping the final results. So please VOTE and make sure your friends and family do as well!

You can read a Rocky Mountain Voice exclusive recap of all the issues that have been uncovered in our Colorado elections [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Stay connected with Rocky Mountain Voice to keep up with these stories as they unfold. We’re committed to bringing you the latest news on election integrity, security measures, and the impact of political strategies. Let’s make sure that as Coloradans, we are all informed, engaged, and ready to make our voices heard on Tuesday!

In liberty,
Heidi Ganahl

| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Colorado GOP: Hundreds of voting system passwords were publicly shared by secretary of state’s office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) More than 600 BIOS passwords for voting system components in 63 of the state’s 64 counties were publicly shared in a file on Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s website, a news release email from the Colorado Republican Party reads.

**[Ganahl: Exposing Colorado’s election failures, how citizen pressure uncovered what officials tried to hide](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) During my run as the GOP Nominee for Governor in 2022, I talked to voters across Colorado that didn’t trust our elections. 25% of Republicans didn’t vote. After the race, I decided to dig in and see if I could find a way to restore trust for voters in the process.
**[It’s time to hold Griswold accountable](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In a troubling development, Colorado’s Secretary of State recently confirmed that critical election system passwords were inadvertently published online, leaving sensitive data exposed for months.
|

**STATE**
**[Absence of U.S. Rep. Jason Crow from 6th District during campaign has been noticed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Laurie Arnold, who lives in Colorado’s 6th U.S. House District, wonders why her current representative, Jason Crow, is spending his time, money and energy campaigning for Democrats in Georgia, North Carolina, Delaware and Pennsylvania, rather than the people in Colorado’s 6th District.
**[How BIOS password exposure could threaten election integrity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Election security is key to a constitutional republic by, for, and of the people. Each part of the voting system should be designed to prevent interference. BIOS passwords are vital to this security. They are the first defense against unauthorized access to a voting machine’s core settings.
**[Trump Campaign calls for action over Secretary Griswold security breach in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In a letter addressed to Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold, representatives for Donald J. Trump for President 2024, Inc. have raised alarms over a reported disclosure of BIOS passwords for voting system equipment across the state.
**[Final take in 3rd District: One candidate has misled with deception, half-truths and lies; we support vote for Hurd](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Adam Frisch and the Democrats are at it again. In Colorado Congressional District 3, once again the Frisch campaign, in cahoots with the Colorado Democrats, is spending money and sending flyers to voters in support of a third-party candidate who can’t win.

**[Prop. KK is a 6.5% tax on gun owners, firearm retailers that with local tax is ‘more like 30%’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Proposition KK has turned Colorado’s gun stores like Jerry’s Outdoor Sports into the front line of a battle over 2nd Amendment rights.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_

**NATIONAL**
**[J.D. Vance and Joe Rogan perfectly deconstruct the ‘radical religion’ of the transgender movement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) If you’re looking for good analysis breaking down the insanity of the modern “trans” movement, then J.D. Vance’s Thursday interview with podcaster Joe Rogan is the discussion to watch.

**[Supreme Court allows Virginia to remove noncitizens from voter rolls before election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that Virginia is entitled to remove noncitizen aliens from its voter rolls, siding with the commonwealth over lower courts less than a week out from the election.

**[He’s back. Steve Bannon released after serving 4 months in federal prison, 1 week before election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Former White House chief strategist Steve Bannon was released from prison early Tuesday after serving a four-month sentence for defying a subpoena from the January 6 Select Committee. He is now free one week before the 2024 election is decided.
**[Forget swing states, here are the swing counties that will decide the 2024 election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Swing states have been getting all the headlines in the run-up to Election Day, but within them, there are a handful of counties that will determine if Vice President Kamala Harris or former President Donald Trump wins the big prize.
**[Brace for ‘unrest’ if Donald Trump wins, Democrats warn](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Americans should prepare for “unrest’ if former President Donald Trump completes the greatest political comeback in modern American politics, Democrats told the Wall Street Journal on Monday.

**LOCAL**
**[Durango band teacher indicted on charges of sexual predator acts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) On July 23, 2024, a Durango teenager told police that an adult male approached them online. He offered to engage in sexual acts with the 16-year-old.

**[Business owners ask City Council for help with homeless activity, get no action in Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Grand Junction businesses and residents in the downtown area have become fed up with the nefarious and criminal activity stemming from the Homeward Bound Day Center for the homeless, and they are directing their ire at elected officials on City Council.
**[Why Western Colorado stands opposed to the Dolores River National Monument](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) On Saturday in Nucla, Colo., hunters emerged from the wilderness. They paused from their morning hunt and headed to the town park in camouflage, joining with neighbors and locals to meet candidates for election.
**[Senate District 16 Showdown: Robyn Carnes vs. Chris Kolker](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) In the race for Colorado’s Senate District 16, which represents Denver’s western suburbs, residents have a choice between incumbent Democratic Sen. Chris Kolker or Republican challenger Robyn Carnes.

clean_body: Critical election integrity updates ahead of Tuesday’s vote | | | | November 3, 2024 SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST By Heidi Ganahl | | Hi friends, are you ready for the final countdown? 2 days to go. I’ll be headed to Washington D.C. tomorrow to join UK’s Channel 4 live on election night on a panel with some great guests at 6:45MST, you can watch ! It’s certainly going to be a wild 48 hours, here’s some highlights of the last few days.... The polls are all over the place , but here’s a positive take from Mark Mitchell at Rasmussen on : The presidential race has been close for the most part, with Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump going neck-and-neck throughout the entire campaign season. However, just days before votes begin to be calculated, a new poll shows Trump winning in a landslide. Rasmussen’s head pollster made a striking prediction about the winner of the 2024 election. Mark Mitchell suggested that Trump will take a significant lead nationally and among critical battleground states, positioning him to win in a landslide. “What you’re hearing out there is that the polls are close, and I think that’s wrong,” he told Breitbart News. “I think the polls, on average, show a strong Trump win, and my polls taken independently show that as well.” Mitchell predicted a significant Trump landslide victory that would mirror Ronald Reagan’s historic win against Jimmy Carter in 1980. He also pointed out that most people “don’t care who Kamala Harris is.” Many other takes with Kamala in the lead so it will be exciting to see who’s right and who’s not Tuesday night! The Libertarian Party recently against Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold following an alarming security breach that . There’s a hearing tomorrow afternoon at 1:30pm MST at the Denver District Court on Bannock, Division 275. Show up if you can! Exposed passwords could allow unauthorized access and tampering with election data, sparking serious questions about Colorado’s voting security after this breach. This legal action demands accountability and urges Secretary Griswold’s office to strengthen security protocols immediately. For Colorado voters, this incident raises concerns over the reliability of electronic voting systems just days before they head to the polls. With election day around the corner , both parties are ramping up their efforts in key swing states, adopting what insiders are calling a . This tactic—reserved for last-ditch efforts—signifies an all-out push to mobilize voters, focusing heavily on close battleground areas where even a slight edge could determine the outcome. This strategy highlights just how high the stakes are this election cycle and reflects a broader urgency among party leaders to . It’s a reminder of the pivotal role that turnout can play in shaping the final results. So please VOTE and make sure your friends and family do as well! You can read a Rocky Mountain Voice exclusive recap of all the issues that have been uncovered in our Colorado elections . Stay connected with Rocky Mountain Voice to keep up with these stories as they unfold. We’re committed to bringing you the latest news on election integrity, security measures, and the impact of political strategies. Let’s make sure that as Coloradans, we are all informed, engaged, and ready to make our voices heard on Tuesday! In liberty, Heidi Ganahl | | | TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK More than 600 BIOS passwords for voting system components in 63 of the state’s 64 counties were publicly shared in a file on Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s website, a news release email from the Colorado Republican Party reads. During my run as the GOP Nominee for Governor in 2022, I talked to voters across Colorado that didn’t trust our elections. 25% of Republicans didn’t vote. After the race, I decided to dig in and see if I could find a way to restore trust for voters in the process. In a troubling development, Colorado’s Secretary of State recently confirmed that critical election system passwords were inadvertently published online, leaving sensitive data exposed for months. | STATE Laurie Arnold, who lives in Colorado’s 6th U.S. House District, wonders why her current representative, Jason Crow, is spending his time, money and energy campaigning for Democrats in Georgia, North Carolina, Delaware and Pennsylvania, rather than the people in Colorado’s 6th District. Election security is key to a constitutional republic by, for, and of the people. Each part of the voting system should be designed to prevent interference. BIOS passwords are vital to this security. They are the first defense against unauthorized access to a voting machine’s core settings. In a letter addressed to Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold, representatives for Donald J. Trump for President 2024, Inc. have raised alarms over a reported disclosure of BIOS passwords for voting system equipment across the state. Adam Frisch and the Democrats are at it again. In Colorado Congressional District 3, once again the Frisch campaign, in cahoots with the Colorado Democrats, is spending money and sending flyers to voters in support of a third-party candidate who can’t win. Former White House chief strategist Steve Bannon was released from prison early Tuesday after serving a four-month sentence for defying a subpoena from the January 6 Select Committee. Swing states have been getting all the headlines in the run-up to Election Day, but within them, there are a handful of counties that will determine if Vice President Kamala Harris or former President Donald Trump wins the big prize. | | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=45ea3ff9dba94f0d949b2e07d10fb1ff&_e=9V4BwHeL9JZ0Nal4tXRiWrcfGxzqu2Z1bvgnmp3_1odX-D-wbug9jq3GVzR8ykzw5g60A5UjrfRbed94IH4ZEXovYZywTLMsYiuwCrcHvJbE4ImCuSLlYsfHZ2pUYUJXv7BlpoW26Zs14gTsmcqfatJR5gKzck7U-nDuJiZxLljOelkDLVgdtS8Q4Lpb9TRvGavGSi4jBM1Az71q3k5oZH_QLDh3Jphqr2JjIE2xp54MayJwW09EWyFsd5b-PnDyKMA1Qz1rXXHCY-aVi0iNfEzCYToCqyX42Mxpug_45PtJLldLjfLT5zhKsiscVfOQHS8nlPv8Q7pSTZEl1qyvDQlfJv9GgjPl-hk8YzReiiI8_IOgHKZsGA2lDZTGESMK4A44f1YX1uG6OzTU1y4xNpeSt6BSureLAPiosa6j-d2DqAEhBTpnn5tiMYcExcYc "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. subject: Thank you
body:
48 hours

| | Peter, Welp, Election Day is in 48 hours. And yet it feels like we’ve been preparing for ages for this day. This grassroots team has been on the journey with me the entire time, and no matter what happens on Tuesday, I want you to know how grateful I am. Your early donations allowed us to get a jump start on our Latino organizing. Now those early volunteers are campaign ambassadors hosting GOTV house parties. Your early donations allowed us to respond quickly when the GOP launched unexpected attack ads. This meant that every time they spread lies, we were ready with the truth. And now, your donations are fueling our volunteer team as they knock on the final doors. It may sound trivial, but your donations are now purchasing hot pizza for our tired volunteers. It really makes a difference. It’s been a long road, with lots of twists and turns. But deep down, I really believe we’re going to win. Because when you do things the right way, and you treat people with respect, that should count for something. **[So, if you can, please chip in to help our team finish strong... because this grassroots team deserves to win on Election Day!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96498769/510231240/-1280984495?&refcode=E11408-20241103-JoshPersonal-SL-2024Race&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjlhZTU5ZTMtNTg5YS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=W0bXRTTc-MYtLdVOM5sQWAqXaBKc8ABF7Ly_oKmtd8k=)** Thank you for all you’ve done for me and our democracy. Discovering the corruption of professional journalism was much of what drove me to begin writing on this platform. While I've found many [opportunities](https://substack.com/redirect/4bb95ca5-69bc-43af-bd97-3b4ee0e096d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to [drag](https://substack.com/redirect/d0afa932-416f-401f-b8d7-c7169c94149f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) editors [and](https://substack.com/redirect/ca099fc4-7aba-43ec-b54a-ea1c3903e513?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) writers [for](https://substack.com/redirect/b7d79bab-51d9-40de-a582-6880369779a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their [various](https://substack.com/redirect/c439f859-a795-498f-a7e2-2caf7928e932?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) recurring [failures](https://substack.com/redirect/ca63ed9d-80da-4a19-9522-72c630038ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), few present examples as compelling as the myths embedded in reporting on the election currently underway.
The cults of personality built by journalists have not been limited to career politicians. The billionaires who have purchased mass media institutions only to [effectively hamstring them](https://substack.com/redirect/3d4aaf8f-de42-4337-918e-cd88e1149e4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) did so not as their primary strategy to secure their political whims, but rather as a supplemental strategy augmenting their primary approach of [buying elections outright](https://substack.com/redirect/5d24e1a4-e2f4-4f3d-9b24-292f70ee6246?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ba9609f-8e6d-43d4-ba30-d6b650bc43ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

### **Building cults of personality allowing politicians to escape accountability**
I've specifically [criticized](https://substack.com/redirect/61750159-40aa-4453-b649-84f589874406?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) journalists for [building cults of personality](https://substack.com/redirect/c439f859-a795-498f-a7e2-2caf7928e932?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) surrounding prominent Democrats. President Bill Clinton may have been the first beneficiary of the pattern, which allowed his [skills](https://substack.com/redirect/ef050c8b-b9b9-493f-a84b-c1a541735de3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on a saxophone to obscure his self-serving [betrayal](https://substack.com/redirect/86c203b0-b1e8-4ae5-afd8-5afa48e043b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of working class Americans and ethical challenges.
Obama [continued](https://substack.com/redirect/d492a540-e05a-4833-a127-fb91f4d24654?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the pattern, exemplifying the [cultural allure](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7c2316-cb72-441f-8e17-d30420bc60e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a celebrity president. He played basketball, hosted lavish parties at the White House featuring Hollywood actors alongside recording artists and finance moguls, and appeared as often in [pop culture](https://substack.com/redirect/da0b1779-889a-46a9-b122-ed7856d19501?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as in Washington.
Who needs pesky accountability agents asking a [groundbreaking](https://substack.com/redirect/43a4e241-dc19-43f3-b430-85e3fc40172b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) president about why he chose to [murder American citizens with no trial or charge](https://substack.com/redirect/fa61a5dd-84ba-4b6b-9f9e-11fad2a09ffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) based on nothing more than their speech? (If that sounds outlandish, that's because it is. The [assassination](https://substack.com/redirect/3d24ba88-da0d-47b7-96fb-69d659a43ba8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Anwar al-Alaki [and his son](https://substack.com/redirect/fbd68082-f9bf-439e-8511-992c85ec02aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who was born in Virginia, was as constitutionally scandalous an event as one could imagine, but drew nary a peep from the legions of journalists focused on the White House.)
President Biden--and Vice President Harris--have been no exceptions to the rule. ...

Kari Lake has a cash advantage on us. She’s used that advantage to outspend us in the Tucson media market, home to Arizona’s second largest metropolitan area. It’s a must win region.
#

We’ve made a difficult decision.
Kari Lake has a cash advantage on us. She’s used that advantage to outspend us in the Tucson media market, home to Arizona’s second largest metropolitan area. It’s a must win region.
That spending and the attacks coming Ruben’s way have had a real impact. In recent Arizona polls, Kari Lake has actually taken the lead over us. Make no mistake: She could win.
At this stage in the campaign, we can’t let things like this go unanswered. We’ve got to fight back. But the truth is, the money to do it wasn’t in the budget. Adding additional spend ahead of our final monthly deadline with just days to raise what we need to close a new budget gap is dangerous, too.
There’s risk either way here, but we huddled as a team... and decided to give the green light.
It was a difficult decision. We’ve missed fundraising goals lately, and we only have two days to raise this investment back. But we’re betting on you today, Peter. We’re hoping that telling you the truth will convince you to chip in and fill the gap in our budget.
There is no time to waste. Arizona is the last line of defense for our Senate Majority.

Dear Peter, People of many different faiths have designated tomorrow (Tuesday, November 5th) as a day of fasting and prayer for our Nation. I trust in the power of prayer. The United States of America is truly a blessed and promised land. God has promised that our land will remain free if we remember Him. I am grateful to live in this great country. # Vote, Vote, Vote!
---
| Have you voted yet? If not, now is the time to GO VOTE.
This election is more important than ever and is our opportunity to put America first--to support policies that keep our communities safe, secure our borders, and strengthen our economy. As Republicans, we believe in limited government, individual responsibility, and defending our Constitution.
Let's not sit on the sidelines. This is our time to step up, protect our principles, and secure a strong future for the next generation. Let's get out there, make our voices heard, and vote for the values that will make America great again!
You can find your voting location and pertinent information [here. ](https://k8bk5lcbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NEv6XAA5b8KhHUT1pPJ5P9dWZziL5HwZRREuxsYIPMqByEzHaDf0tYhvs7ZfPuJM-AGXzMneORYXL04Da0Hk3VEY4wtQQZkwI3ecdsJ-yilqCioIesBvAYD6mVFsuQoYzNZuY9Fk7o5QfX7GLE4khAh-7opXYSGV&c=c_42uU-KTljKCby6EVvWM5Tpn1ZF6FuKorkeb3fv6242jjxAKwZOTQ==&ch=jBUin_m6lHKopk44xcihcNCLfAtH4M6-YkNwyLzxxdagaNnWO_W0oQ==)

|
# Op-Ed: Kamala Harris Is Wrong for America
By Morgan Luttrell
---
| As we quickly approach the 2024 presidential election, it is more important than ever that we elect a president who has the knowledge, vision, and competence to guide America through chaotic, unprecedented times and get our country back on track. Unfortunately, Vice President Kamala Harris has shown time and again that she lacks the necessary qualities to lead our country effectively. Her time in office has been full of indecision, political opportunism, and a failure to address the real concerns of everyday Americans.
One of the clearest concerns with Kamala Harris is her inability to define and stick to her policy positions. She has repeatedly flip-flopped on key issues, such as immigration and criminal justice and law enforcement reform, leaving voters confused about where she truly stands. This inconsistency shows she lacks the necessary decisiveness needed to handle complex issues like border security and immigration reform.
To that end, as Border Czar, Harris has completely failed to deliver meaningful - or any -- solutions. She has been completely absent. Instead of visiting the border to see the crisis firsthand and engage with the communities and law enforcement most affected, Harris has distanced herself from the crisis. Her dereliction of duty has only exacerbated the chaos at our border, where illegal crossings have surged, drug and human trafficking continue to rise, and our law enforcement officers are stretched thin. Kamala Harris' refusal to confront this crisis head-on sends the message that she is unwilling or unable to tackle one of the most pressing issues facing our nation today.
Further, the tragic Afghanistan withdrawal in 2021 was a direct result of failed leadership and a major projection of weakness on the world stage. The mismanagement of the exit strategy raised serious concerns about the competence of the Biden-Harris Administration. We lost 13 American heroes, the Taliban took control, and women and Christians continue to face brutal persecutions. Handling such a critical and high-pressure event requires stability and careful planning, qualities that Kamala Harris clearly fails to bring to the table.
Kamala Harris has been part of an Administration that has overseen record high inflation, rising energy costs, and a disastrous economy. The lack of leadership on these issues only underscores that she is out of touch with hardworking Americans. Our country cannot afford to have leaders who fail to prioritize the kitchen table issues families are facing. More, hard-working Americans can't afford the American Dream in the Harris economy.
As alarming as her record as Vice President is, it nearly pales in comparison to her time in the Senate. During her tenure from 2017-2021 in the Senate, she had a more liberal voting record than socialist Bernie Sanders. Some of her most radical efforts include support for legislation to prevent states from barring males from female locker rooms and athletic teams; leading a bill which would have forced Catholic hospitals and other faith-based health institutions to perform abortions and gender transition surgeries; and she strongly supported the $10 trillion Green New Deal. Unsurprisingly, these themes are reflected throughout her time as California attorney general as well.
In less than thirty days, Americans will have the chance to course correct the direction of our country. Kamala Harris is simply not the right choice.
Read the full piece in the [Huntsville Item](https://k8bk5lcbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NEv6XAA5b8KhHUT1pPJ5P9dWZziL5HwZRREuxsYIPMqByEzHaDf0tYhvs7ZfPuJMHTEF7PUokoNqzrtVckAToIWslf0y2KrceW-P1Wc-AJY4KvGoyNbkFwx8fwUsZe_4lJN1eBijsW2UGFLc4Fbmvox48FWne8ynCwAEx0xKcxu3TbrsWWB887CNd73nrpfjxFRB29nkzjtIuw0Q9xmpFwjSKJEVkrwvY4ZODyNP9-bYbOGu6yMe8gbGWXWNWzJtjwTgWh2NS9SK6vxO2MFNPU5KeTzmLZL_-7Ffvy80BaJmyiDDTf1I3Q==&c=c_42uU-KTljKCby6EVvWM5Tpn1ZF6FuKorkeb3fv6242jjxAKwZOTQ==&ch=jBUin_m6lHKopk44xcihcNCLfAtH4M6-YkNwyLzxxdagaNnWO_W0oQ==).

## Texas Warns Feds Away From Polling Sites
Texas Secretary of State Jane Nelson informed the Department of Justice that federal poll monitors would not be allowed inside Texas voting sites on Election Day, citing a state law [restricting their access](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72OwyAQhJ_GdFjLjyEuKK5Jl2uvtNawxOhIHAEKydufnP6K6Wbm0_dzWS6Ycrpfv_FGrr3ivkiQmgvBQS8BU34vmgW3QpgFIyesAitBW8k2d4ro_SQiEAQ0SiFOq1cahTnZCSGy5I4zIeCInMxICudVA5nVk5mCHTRQSG0vY9uo0QtrzO_9SWX0-41lt7X2qIP6GuR5kOfe-3inXjvR71EY5Pmz4SuWUnmkQAUzf-w5847Nb1QqF7OdwVhWXHj0lHOq5sBeb5jyh9L-1X46-RcAAP__PHZbEA) to polling places or central counting stations. The DOJ [had announced plans](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOtCAURp8GOwwwiGNB8Td287dbmovcUTYoBO7qzNtv3Gy7xVd9ycnJ-XhMDwgx7Mt_2NDS65kmJZTmUnKhJw8hvifdeOuEH2SDVvY30Suhe9WsVkjpQN47IzvdO6OhM2Lwbrh3QujZySbYCyaluKY60-INBqcFGjej6XzPtEAfKJWWViR8QX3GdzqwtHPammhXolzZ7R9TI1PjeZ7t51elMGO7pIOpMWVgasyFqfH34B4zFNpwJ76l_WLznGKsXPW8EhBWPqctxwD7jPyJHgtEfiQK-8JLWFaqPMJZm2J9PkOMoZrLc9kgxB8t-rPTYdV3AAAA___z520i) to deploy monitors across 86 jurisdictions in 27 states, including eight counties in Texas, to ensure compliance with federal voting rights laws. "_Rest assured that Texas has robust processes and procedures in place to ensure that eligible voters may participate in a free and fair election_ ,” Nelson [said in her letter](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3OozAQRZ_GdEb24J9QuNiGLttuicb2ELxrMAInJG-_Iv1XjHSkkc7MvX_u4x1TTuvjNy7k6nsqIwhQXEou1Bgx5c-omui8iL1syEnbCQtCWWhmB1IaHWyvINwCSpx6YY2yXnuEMHnfJHfJpBTXgDYtddh7Jcj4QEZHy5SgmGrZ2zpTpTceU_6UF-1tKEuT3VzrdrDuF4OBwXCeZ_tvLs9ryWDAvaaQicGw0nkwGLaSU03hQsoUairrxV8vnyjSjplvJWe-lPW6evC_z6OmQDzShntdaK0MBrhpbgzY2EXiQRvkSgNw7PueR2m8IRISUTe7i9uZck6HuaI8Fkz5-3n9scqXg_8BAAD__438dd8). Gov. Greg Abbott concurred with Nelson in a social media post.
## Texas Power Company Law Overturned
A federal judge ruled that out-of-state power companies can now operate in Texas, [striking down a state law](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAURL8Gd1hwjY1dUGzj7m27pUXgJr4SBgtISP5-5fSvmGo0o6Pz72f7sRQoPv7aA01939MGAhSXkgu1eUvhs6nOm5vwi-zQSD0IDUJp6HYjPcxgF9QOhkniaGcntF4GNQoLi8COzHUmpbgC49TjYJebEjjdHE6j10wJ9FRT7uuOFd-23MMnvTD3Lh1dMHutZ2HDHwYrg7W11rs9p3i1DNaIrTBY9_QsNUX-3TNYba7kAjJYz9Qw82BbeVLlNdtYDiqFUuSBIhaO2aXK5TLPQoHoz_3ssvFnoxCoTBfe47AUvjT1Vz0vA_8DAAD__wbGaJs) that limits new transmission line construction to companies already owning lines in Texas. The decision benefits companies like Florida's NextEra Energy and New York's LS Power, which [challenged the law](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGSqzAMRb_GdGZsQcyjcPEaumy7JWOwINo1OGOLkPz9jrP1FhoVGp05935ex6ujQPv64Ta0_FziCApaqbVU7egdhdfYVt5Oyve6Qqu7RnWg2g6qm13UbIz2Fz0v_3QHfQ-gARowS9N0CH1FtsC0VmXgYmpsXD-1Cs00o7n4TrQKPXFMNd-Q8enyEl7xgame41YFe2O-Z9H8FzAIGM7zrBMejCmXu4Ah4OpC2cS0Oqa4CxiOLL8Ov6KcQpy_s3xzJSe3541yprjLQDvK6aDgaV9lwsyJ5vKe5W98JaEXMFTJ-vtJIVA2RXbdHIW3G_9Z1sPCTwAAAP__vultDw) after its passage in 2019 and previous efforts to enter the Texas market. U.S. District Court Judge Robert Pitman ruled that the law violates the U.S. Constitution because it [restricts interstate commerce](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGTpCAUhH8NZkzBE3EMCC4xm0svtBCe-m4RLGBnxn-_5eQbdNRV_XV9_x7Tw1KguP61O5r6XtIEAhSXkgs1eUvhnFTjzSz8IBs0sm9FD0L10GxGKu0Wi53UsvcS2m6eO-_uWi2LQO-Ghsw1JqW4Ap2-YWuHWQnUs0Pd-Z4pgZ5qyre6YcW3LUs40xPzzaW9CWar9Sis_cNgZDDWDTcK4eoYjEcK5E4GI0bM68kxPimnuGOsDEY1aBD3nv__9ivyw-ZKNoSTzyG5r8I_LF6zjWWnUihFHuyLwdhk448XhUBFX_fW3dKH2NRf9TwN_AQAAP__w-xppg).
## In-Person Election Day Voting For Inmates
Dallas and Harris counties will allow eligible inmates to [vote in person](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO6zAMRL9G7mToZTkuVNzGXW67pUGbTKIFbQWRNkr-fqH0W7Di4ODMfJ2XM0SOx_U_7BTK65IWo4yTWkvlFoTI78V1GFaFk-4o6NGq0Sg3mu4WEE-ThUFbclaPenUWp81NqxvcydKAXQwNprVqZwbfk4VpdYr8upEfcBROEcaSHn25UaEX5Au_05Me_Zb2jsOtlHsW9p8wszBzrbU_1g0vtb2FmQ-qWZiZ0wYszIzADFlu6ecob1lqkt8QOcsPWN4Tt6KypUtMh4zHDoUawPqTH_0gzNw9At5rZI7ZN7vrDpE_MuXPdZ7B_AYAAP__i9FnmQ) on Election Day, continuing a practice that Harris County implemented in 2021 and Dallas County started just last year. Under Texas law, people with felony convictions who have not completed their sentences are [restricted from participating](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAMhp8mbDklTg7KkKEL23XtiExsIGpITiTi7t6-4tS1g6VPsj_L_r9v4w1DDGn5wo1dfc55BAVWai2VHQlDfI22ITcp6nXDTndGdaBsB83qLBtDs_GtndAAAXVA2PLH3FpDPVMT3LlMa3UWXNsLG-wnq7idPLdX6oRVTKHm_VJXrvzEMsdXPni_-Lw10a213oswnwIGAQNOXpuzI2C451IFDB6TPL1UpF9xX5ikz-kIvp60h42LPHLlN4eE8W-syC0U4o0x5V3meeZUuEjKqcqKPyzxga_TDGmRe1jWWgQM-mr7zppOwNDsju6PEGMo7fnGsmGI76vrvzEeDn4DAAD__xWhd88) in elections. However, most inmates in county jails are serving sentences for misdemeanors. According to criminal justice advocates, jail-based voting not only increases participation in elections but also [lowers recidivism rates](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1urDAUhJ8GOiPbGPtSuLgN3aZNifxzgBN5MbJPluXtI9KnGE0x0ujT9_mYHw4T7uuHe4Kl95JnyaViQjCu5ugwXbNqo_U8jqIFK0zPjeTKyHazhutRcd0L6OW_qAcxGi314MPiYlyMatHeZ0LwO3LQHfRu9IqD9gH0EE2jOESkXDragODt6pKu_ILShfxsk92Ijtr0_xs5NXI6z7OrsBPsAff1KPkLAnW5rI2cjpwwXMwXhKWRE-6hgKu4r-z49gkDq24Bupi_WIFKudzTK9NdBdeNaiOntth4nJgSVn2zrU-H6ReF_nTzsvInAAD__3W9aW8). Officials are unsure how many inmates will choose to cast a ballot but say they are committed to providing the opportunity to do so.

## Trump, Harris Make Final Push
Former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris intensified their campaigns in [Sun Belt states over the final weekend](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO6yAYhJ_G7hxxM5iC4jTpctotLS4_8R9hsIAkytuvnH6LKUYjjb6Zn9t6s5gw3__bHUyPZWWEiYnSiYg1WEyfVYzBRAAGfARDFSeKaj2zcTPBAzBP7KIlk3Fm0rmoZ1ALlzIwH0Y0Zxul5JTk5LII5YTTinOtIo9qEAQC9lIvj4K5bxDTp7ygXnzZx2S23o828H8Duw7sao8M73ZGp6kdfYKBXTdbK7ap1-d-TI-y5Vby5O1-WLzn6TunwY6-5PD0vdQ2Ca6ARBtn4al2ALMWQs6ESskX7qIbqwnHG1PCJk_E-24xfZH6Xxe9DPsNAAD__xYXZ4U) before the election, aiming to sway undecided voters in key battlegrounds. Harris emphasized her readiness to offer new leadership as president, while Trump predicted a sweeping victory, including winning the popular vote, during rallies in North Carolina and Virginia. Trump continues [rallying in North Carolina](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDtuwzAQRE8jdTT4MyUVLNK4c9qUwoq7tDagSIFibPj2gdKnmGIwwODhfd3nO3Di_PiEjXyLZdZSW6GUkHZG4PSebY8-EmkyPXk1GDmoabrqfvVuURJxsYuW0ihHarmaaFyEkcZptKpnf74pJc84Iy-jHRa7TIMx0xBNHDorCbmVevkunNtKMb3Lk-ollK1Pfm1tPzrz0elbp2-wZ3od53SW2jgk6vQNS4aEotWfbRe51LaKALUkziACbDvwIwuAgDCCdVFLVBjc1QaYKNqgg0Ea--pxf3FKfLiT6rEBpz-K9p-Vp9e_AQAA__9zvGOR) today after stops there each day since Saturday. Harris also visited the state on Saturday. Both campaigns will be in Pittsburgh today for a [final appeal to Pennsylvania](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLluxCAQhp8GOiwum3VBkcbdpk1pYRjWE-FDwK61bx-RJlWKaeY_9On_us93hwn3x6fbwNZ4zJJLzYRgXM_BYXrPmgYbASQoClYYxY0Yx17S1ULfDyZEAO7hpiSM4hb84ILvF8U1eIq2tQnB2w2KdzdtFr2MRqnRRBUN0RwC1iN33wfudYWY3scLcuePjSa71noWoj6InIicruvq_FJ2uErTiZxOrLUsz_xYiZzan8hpdTljYTU_t5NllxJCYX9GVrOLET3D7XS-tgTNNpwXpoRlaESPzWH6Jaj_LfKy8icAAP__eWdlfg), viewed by many as perhaps the most critical swing state. You can see the latest projections for [battleground states here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL9uwyAYxJ8Gb1j8czADQxdv6drR-mxw_FUYLKCx0qevyN7hpJNOOv3uvu7zHTBgfHzC4W3d0iyYUJRzytTsAMNrVp2zm_fCy85briXT3JhBdLt10kjHBmWGEbhcBzUKpblXg4GbXEbdoW1tnLOmm2T9qPSiFqOlNHqTmyaKeYc15f47Yay738IrPX3u13R0we61noXIDyImIqbruvp1KdFfpeVETM0SMb2Rd8gZC6355zjpmUIbRQ9cd3xApBeWNcWCkULG3xSBRv8EBzSmXHe6Qk4BIxAxddm688IQsNwa3-MADG-e-t8_Tyv-AgAA__9NbWhK).
## Tornadoes Rip Through Oklahoma City Area
At least 11 people were injured and hospitalized early Sunday when [a swarm of tornadoes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX8NbEbGJhAGD13Y0rUjOuJzuMRwyL4Epb--oura4fTppKenT-_rMl6AIq23T1jQSeDRaNOoula6GT1QfI9N6V1ANGhLdHVndVf3_cmUs5usnfy5PsFVw3XCxvRB-9aas8X25H1fkjva6lof11pdnZtuaqa-s7bvgg1d0Wj0JJyqO9MqM4b45hem6spLGd0ssuXCfhRmKMyw73vF35AeOVDKcmQKM6y45wMgxCtE9fcvzyi0RVQb8gFa78-EXkEQTCrjCxOqLJyWrDbOmaaISjit4BmzEoSkZE78vM2KHxFmXqAwQ5mc33aKkXJ72N8WoPhrK_-t93LmJwAA___CjXY6) hit the Oklahoma City area, damaging homes and toppling power lines. The [National Weather Service](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL0OnDAQhJ8GukX-A-PCRRq6S5sSGbw-9mJsZHyH7u0jorQppprRaL759ZgfjiKl50-3o60hz4IJBZwDU7N3FL-zar0NiAJli5ZryTQ3phftZkfhtDPaSR16pdzC-h5NwGVkgx5cH1qydxvn7NYgWTcqvajFaCmNDjLoRjH0VHPpXplS3TDEb_5g6da8t9FutR5nI380YmrEdF1Xl_A6ze02YjprLt9GTIMWWgXhteRcm7BKMY6rEuu_yH7CRXWDmktyPuMJ7wNqBgwgobhK6QmUXu-CNzYlyL-j2_LuIKL7ICy4UfJwuLpBDuDxrOW9VsqpLdYfF8VI53CjPHdH8e_0-r8rP1b8CQAA__-bSHXS) estimated that between six and 12 twisters touched down during a four-hour period starting late Saturday night, rating the tornadoes as EF-3 and EF-1. Tornado warnings were issued, including one that prompted shelter-in-place orders at the [University of Oklahoma's Norman campus](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO3CAYBOCnwR0W_GCzLigiRe42TRSltMCA_d9hWAG7K7_9yddfMdVIo0_z_77cDUZM2x9zeN1CXoCBpJxTJhdnMJ6L7JwO3oMXnddcCab4NA3Q7RrMEERw1jqxMgt-VZZLB-EGwg_qBh3qa41zdmUUrL9JZaWdlBCTCiIoIpl32HLpPzKmtvsQz_zypV_z0UW9t_aoRPwiMBOYjV2Tf9d-y1dNYP73l8DccknGZfo2JWHaKNb69I4-E758qdhOmj-j2fNh6GqOx7MSmGvL5SRiRkfEb84HKcZxhK5o93hjjFjHS7YdBuO3pP30zEvDVwAAAP__0YRloQ). Authorities reported significant damage in communities such as Choctaw and Newcastle, with more severe weather forecast for Sunday afternoon. Watch [a video of the aftermath here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j71u7CAUhJ8GurXgHC4_BcVerZxqI6WIUlrYwJoIL5bN2vLbR06fYpoZaT59X_fu7lJOz8e7m4KtsXTAQFw4vzDReZfy0QnqbQwBAtJguUKmuDH_gI6299EDBzfI6LnRzOjYc-c1YNBaKkaTPd84Z2ckskYL1YveKESjIkZFBAs-1bI03yU96xhiPsoWlmYoE812rHVeCV4JtATafd-bo7zqqw_nfjauDiPBdiN4e_tQhklWP-crAemmmeD_SvAGbKWL9fOeck6rPJGPyaX8i6h_KW8WfgIAAP__DB9Vpw).
## List: Which States Drink the Most
Delaware and New Hampshire lead the country in per capita spirits consumption, with each state averaging [over four gallons of liquor per person](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuSrCAYhJ8GMqa4OWhAcBKzOemGFsqP_rsIFjJavv2Wk2_Q2deX6q_X8HIYMc3_3Qq2hjxILjUTgnE9eIfxGjT1NgBIUBSsMIob0XWNpIsNXk1GN3I0YdKtbEwAw1Wnn9AG4RpH0d5pQvBbT8UfrTajHjujVGeCCoZoDh5rLo_vjKkuEOKVDyiPKa802qXWbSfqH5E9kf2ZS_Rb3t7RVcypwIFw3iSR_V5dBVZc-sE070T2Lk55yZFNOe3vdbsNbLzYh6PF-u3EGHF_3hPm1WH8VNa_Ljis_A0AAP__RrFgJw) annually.

That’s roughly equivalent to 20 standard 750 ml bottles of spirits per person each year. The average American consumes less than that, about 2.3 gallons of spirits each year, but the per capita total varies by state. Utah has the state with the lowest per capita consumption at 1.36 gallons, followed by West Virginia at 1.82. See [how much your state is drinking here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuSrCAYhJ8GMqa4OWhAcBKzOemGFsqP_rsIFjJavv2Wk2_Q2deX6q_X8HIYMc3_3Qq2hjxILjUTgnE9eIfxGjT1NgBIUBSsMIob0XWNpIsNXk1GN3I0YdKtbEwAw1Wnn9AG4RpH0d5pQvBbT8UfrTajHjujVGeCCoZoDh5rLo_vjKkuEOKVDyiPKa802qXWbSfqH5E9kf2ZS_Rb3t7RVcypwIFw3iSR_V5dBVZc-sE070T2Lk55yZFNOe3vdbsNbLzYh6PF-u3EGHF_3hPm1WH8VNa_Ljis_A0AAP__RrFgJw).

Peter, it’s Julia Louis-Dreyfus. If you know me, you know I love a good joke. But today, I’m reaching out about something that couldn’t be more serious: this year’s election in the battleground state of Nevada.
**
With everything from abortion rights and climate change to the future of our democracy at stake, I’ve been paying close attention to which states and which races are the most important – and everything I’m reading says that Nevada will be decisive for control of the White House _and_ the Senate.
[That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask: Will you join me in supporting Senator Jacky Rosen by splitting $10 between her reelection campaign and Lucas Kunce today? Every dollar will go a long way toward making sure she wins in Nevada so we can keep the Senate and the White House blue.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83483?refcode=em20241104-8624&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8624%2E614464%2E5sgoxl)

subject: The Middle Class Needs Donald Trump
body:

# The Middle Class Needs Donald Trump
---
|
# By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman
# and Political Commentator
---
|
---
|
**There can be no compromise or middle ground regarding America’s middle class.** When it comes to America’s middle class, there can be no middle ground and no compromise. The strength of our economy rests on their shoulders, yet for four years, we’ve watched the Biden-Harris administration wage an all-out assault on the American Dream. Crushing inflation has left families, fixed-income seniors, and aspiring members of Generation X struggling to find financial footing. Americans need a champion who genuinely cares about their prosperity. Donald Trump will champion the middle class with the same common-sense and innovative economic policies that once empowered this nation. When Trump’s policies return, so will growth and prosperity, and then all Americans will win. **One of Trump’s most potent economic tools is tariffs** The middle class is America's backbone. It is our workforce, our small business owners, and our consumers. This group's health is essential to our nation's health, and Donald Trump understands this better than any American or global leader. Trump is a generational figure, the best hope for restoring the American Dream for everyone, regardless of race, gender, or political beliefs. One of Trump’s most potent economic tools is tariffs. Often misunderstood, tariffs are a crucial weapon in his economic arsenal to protect American workers. Trump has used them strategically to level the playing field against foreign competition, ensuring American businesses remain in the United States. The result? Job growth, rising wages, and opportunities for the middle class. Under Biden, foreign governments continue to subsidize their labor and flood our market with cheap imports, suppressing American wages. Trump stood firm against these tactics, so the middle class thrived under his leadership. **Help Companies invest and create jobs** During Trump’s presidency, particularly before the pandemic, we saw historically low unemployment, high workforce participation, and a narrowing pay equity gap. These weren’t empty statistics; they were real gains felt by everyday Americans—Hispanic Americans, Blacks, women, people of all races and backgrounds. Trump’s corporate tax cuts, though perhaps not immediately obvious to the average American, played a crucial role in this middle-class prosperity. When corporations have more money, they reinvest in their workers, ensuring wages remain competitive and jobs stay right here in the United States.
---
|
**Energy Independence means Economic Growth** Trump’s push for energy independence was another cornerstone of his agenda. By deregulating the fossil fuel industry, allowing drilling on federal lands, and withdrawing from the Paris Climate Agreement, he made the U.S. energy independent for the first time in decades. This led to lower energy prices, more jobs, and increased national security. Contrast that with Biden’s policies: the closure of American pipelines, higher energy costs, and a reliance on overseas energy production. While the long-term potential of green energy is essential, the middle class is paying the immediate price through skyrocketing utility bills and increased heating costs. While blunt, Trump’s “drill, baby, drill” approach shows a clear understanding of how energy independence benefits the middle class by lowering costs and enhancing prosperity. **Small Businesses are our Nation’s Economic** Trump was also a steadfast supporter of small businesses. Through the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), he provided critical relief during the pandemic, helping businesses survive and retain employees during an unprecedented economic crisis. By cutting red tape and offering real support to small business owners, Trump ensured that America's backbone—the middle class—had the resources to recover and thrive. Trump will introduce fresh, innovative policies targeting the middle class in his next administration. Imagine the immediate impact of eliminating taxes on hard-earned tips, abolishing taxes on car loans, and ending the ludicrous tax on Social Security income. These bold ideas would have dramatic benefits for hardworking and retired middle-class Americans. **Please Stop Helping Us** Meanwhile, Vice President Harris continues her dangerous rhetoric about increasing taxes on corporations and repealing Trump’s tax cuts, which benefited 85% of Americans. Her blatant pandering to the Black community through “forgivable loans” and empty promises reveals her desperation. The Black middle class has awakened, and they’ve had enough. As they will tell Harris themselves: “Stop helping us.” Black men don’t want handouts; they want the government to step aside so they can succeed on their terms. That is the American Dream. **America needs a Builder** At his core, Donald Trump is a builder. Whether constructing a golf course or a skyscraper, he knows how to maximize his available tools. He brought that same mindset to the American economy during his presidency, prioritizing middle-class prosperity. His policies aimed to reduce costs, expand opportunities, and ensure every American could experience the wealth and success they deserve. _**Now more than ever, America needs Donald Trump. We need his economic toolkit and unshakeable commitment to putting the American worker first. It’s time to put America first again.**_

# [Agatha Christie wrote romance novels under the name Mary Westmacott.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| M ystery stories require a meticulous structure, and emotions typically don’t drive the plot. This worked out well for Agatha Christie, who liked her public persona to be somewhat guarded, especially after her infamous [1926 disappearance](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) caused a media ruckus. But Christie found a way to express herself more deeply while still maintaining her privacy: She wrote several semi-autobiographical romance novels under a pen name, [Mary Westmacott](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). The alias allowed Christie to be emotionally vulnerable — and the books received rave reviews.
---
“The Westmacott [novels] always said things that Agatha couldn’t express any other way,” biographer Laura Thompson wrote in _Agatha Christie: A Mysterious Life_. These books gave Christie an outlet to explore her fraught relationship with her first husband Archie Christie, reflect honestly (and sometimes harshly) on motherhood, and unearth past trauma. In the Westmacott novel that most closely parallels her own life, _Unfinished Portrait_(1934), a woman reeling from losses similar to those experienced by Christie meets a handsome painter on an exotic island who listens to her painful life story while creating her portrait.
The Westmacott books were a valuable, anonymous outlet to Christie from 1930 until 1949, when her identity was revealed in the “Atticus” gossip column of the _Sunday Times_. She published two more books under the pseudonym after that, but insisted that her real name stay out of the promotion.

## Louisa May Alcott wrote thrillers under a pen name.
Author Louisa May Alcott became a household name — and developed a wholesome reputation — from her classic coming-of-age novel _Little Women_ and its sequels _Little Men_ and _Jo’s Boys_. But Alcott had a hidden bibliography that remained a secret for more than 50 years after her death. Under the name A.M. Barnard, Alcott wrote [around 30 thrillers](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smfdns&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), known then as “sensation stories,” centered around fiercely independent heroines. Her secret identity was first uncovered in 1945, but Alcott was highly prolific and used multiple pen names, so researchers are still discovering new works by the author, including 20 stories and poems that were unearthed at the beginning of 2024.

She published two more books under the pseudonym after that, but insisted that her real name stay out of the promotion. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Detective novels written by Christie 66 | | Age gap (in years) between Christie and her second husband, Max Mallowan 13 | Age gap (in years) between Christie and her second husband, Max Mallowan 13 | | Performances of Christie’s “The Mousetrap” during its more than 50-year run 29,500 | | Year James Bond creator Ian Fleming took over the “Atticus” gossip column 1953 | Year James Bond creator Ian Fleming took over the “Atticus” gossip column 1953 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Louisa May Alcott wrote thrillers under a pen name. Author Louisa May Alcott became a household name — and developed a wholesome reputation — from her classic coming-of-age novel Little Women and its sequels Little Men and Jo’s Boys. But Alcott had a hidden bibliography that remained a secret for more than 50 years after her death. Under the name A.M. Barnard, Alcott wrote , known then as “sensation stories,” centered around fiercely independent heroines. Her secret identity was first uncovered in 1945, but Alcott was highly prolific and used multiple pen names, so researchers are still discovering new works by the author, including 20 stories and poems that were unearthed at the beginning of 2024. # [Public Education is a Foundation for Life](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2024%2F11%2F04%2Fpublic-education-is-a-foundation-for-life%2F%3Fjetpack_skip_subscription_popup&sr=0&signature=14e96746b75dbcd198bd5f3b6a8d1c71&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| | By **Elizabeth Farnham** on November 4, 2024
---|---
(_Originally published by the Gettysburg Connection on November 2, 2024.)_
When my mother left the second time, I cried in my father’s arms.
He tried to comfort this seven year old as best he could, but the grim reality soon settled in. He would have to find a daycare for my three year old brother and hire after school babysitters for me. He managed both tasks, but every weekday was a mad scramble as he readied children for school, dropped off the little one at daycare, put in a full day of work, retrieved the little one, fixed dinner, helped the older one with homework, made them wash up, and finally, sent them to bed. Meanwhile, my mother was out singing for money.
Despite having a husband, two children, a house, and a dog, my mother often felt unfulfilled, and why not? She had married at nineteen, shamed by purity culture for having premarital sex with my father, and strongly discouraged to live on her own. The only acceptable solution by society’s standard in those days was to marry my dad, but four years into the marriage and three years into parenting meant she had missed learning about her adult self. So when a dashing young man promised a traveling singing career, she left us. Eight months later my dad took her back, but one fateful day at a State Fair, another man invited her to his singing troupe, and so she broke our family, forever.
While my family seemed shattered in a million pieces, it was public school that kept me together. No matter the fighting of my parents, the chaos of spending every other weekend with her, or the bad mouthing everyone in the family engaged in, my teachers dutifully educated me on new mathematical operations, science, history, how to read and write better, and modeled how to treat other people. Every day, they took my attendance, taught me something new, called on me with the raised hand, and kindly noted my progress. One year, after I accused a teacher of writing a nonsensical word “noone” on the board, she instructed me to pull my desk to the middle of the room. It was then the gap between the two words that formed the phrase “no one” became apparent. Responsibly, she sent me to the school nurse where I promptly failed an eye exam, then took a note home to my father. Soon, I was sporting Strawberry Shortcake glasses and no longer making baseless accusations.
Later still, when I was adjusting to a new stepparent, home, bus ride, and school, it was new teachers who welcomed me warmly and made me feel like I belonged in those brightly-colored halls. They taught me astronomy, cooking, French, how to swing from the uneven bars, and how to use a bandsaw. School librarians recommended books then showered me with recognition for having borrowed so many. No matter the rough adjustments in family life, public education distracted me, relaxed me, and kept my interest so strong that I was soon inviting my dad to awards ceremonies so that he too could have a piece of happiness.
Even though I didn’t participate in sports, new worlds of competition, speed, and prowess opened up to me through extracurricular activities like Latin certamen and trivia clubs. Answering questions was FUN, but more importantly, public-speaking and voluntary research were practiced and improved. And one day, I skipped a year of college, and another day, I graduated from college, unlike either of my parents. Public education had given me everything my family couldn’t – stability and the skills to accomplish long term goals. No matter what family crisis popped up, public school steadied and readied me for anything I chose because it is more than reading, writing, and arithmetic.
Public education is a foundation for life.
Because public education is never to discriminate against its students on the basis of race, color, religion, language, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, or disability, it is ostensibly the guaranteed access for generations of Americans to quality instruction that can improve their skills, health, and relationships. And our hard-earned tax dollars allocated for it can never go to private or parochial schools where the same levels of transparency and accountability don’t exist, but where they still enforce purity culture.
Someday, I hope marriages will stop ending in divorce, not because of Project 2025’s nightmare agenda to end “no fault” divorces, but because people won’t feel forced to marry the wrong people in the first place. Until that happens, I take solace in public school groups for students of divorced families. These groups give students the opportunity to not suffer alone, but open up to one another, to get through the difficulty together, and to forge a new way ahead.
And isn’t that exactly what we want to teach our children?

He tried to comfort this seven year old as best he could, but the grim reality soon settled in. He wou... | or | | | or ---|---|--- | | By Elizabeth Farnham on November 4, 2024 ---|--- (Originally published by the Gettysburg Connection on November 2, 2024.) When my mother left the second time, I cried in my father’s arms. He tried to comfort this seven year old as best he could, but the grim reality soon settled in. He would have to find a daycare for my three year old brother and hire after school babysitters for me. He managed both tasks, but every weekday was a mad scramble as he readied children for school, dropped off the little one at daycare, put in a full day of work, retrieved the little one, fixed dinner, helped the older one with homework, made them wash up, and finally, sent them to bed. Meanwhile, my mother was out singing for money. Despite having a husband, two children, a house, and a dog, my mother often felt unfulfilled, and why not? She had married at nineteen, shamed by purity culture for having premarital sex with my father, and strongly discouraged to live on her own. The only acceptable solution by society’s standard in those days was to marry my dad, but four years into the marriage and three years into parenting meant she had missed learning about her adult self. So when a dashing young man promised a traveling singing career, she left us. Eight months later my dad took her back, but one fateful day at a State Fair, another man invited her to his singing troupe, and so she broke our family, forever. While my family seemed shattered in a million pieces, it was public school that kept me together. No matter the fighting of my parents, the chaos of spending every other weekend with her, or the bad mouthing everyone in the family engaged in, my teachers dutifully educated me on new mathematical operations, science, history, how to read and write better, and modeled how to treat other people. Every day, they took my attendance, taught me something new, called on me with the raised hand, and kindly noted my progress. One year, after I accused a teacher of writing a nonsensical word “noone” on the board, she instructed me to pull my desk to the middle of the room. It was then the gap between the two words that formed the phrase “no one” became apparent. Responsibly, she sent me to the school nurse where I promptly failed an eye exam, then took a note home to my father. Soon, I was sporting Strawberry Shortcake glasses and no longer making baseless accusations. Later still, when I was adjusting to a new stepparent, home, bus ride, and school, it was new teachers who welcomed me warmly and made me feel like I belonged in those brightly-colored halls. They taught me astronomy, cooking, French, how to swing from the uneven bars, and how to use a bandsaw. School librarians recommended books then showered me with recognition for having borrowed so many. No matter the rough adjustments in family life, public education distracted me, relaxed me, and kept my interest so strong that I was soon inviting my dad to awards ceremonies so that he too could have a piece of happiness. Even though I didn’t participate in sports, new worlds of competition, speed, and prowess opened up to me through extracurricular activities like Latin certamen and trivia clubs. Answering questions was FUN, but more importantly, public-speaking and voluntary research were practiced and improved. And one day, I skipped a year of college, and another day, I graduated from college, unlike either of my parents. Public education had given me everything my family couldn’t – stability and the skills to accomplish long term goals. No matter what family crisis popped up, public school steadied and readied me for anything I chose because it is more than reading, writing, and arithmetic. Public education is a foundation for life. Because public education is never to discriminate against its students on the basis of race, color, religion, language, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, or disability, it is ostensibly the guaranteed access for generations of Americans to quality instruction that can improve their skills, health, and relationships. And our hard-earned tax dollars allocated for it can never go to private or parochial schools where the same levels of transparency and accountability don’t exist, but where they still enforce purity culture. Someday, I hope marriages will stop ending in divorce, not because of Project 2025’s nightmare agenda to end “no fault” divorces, but because people won’t feel forced to marry the wrong people in the first place. Until that happens, I take solace in public school groups for students of divorced families. These groups give students the opportunity to not suffer alone, but open up to one another, to get through the difficulty together, and to forge a new way ahead.
