name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Our final campaign stop tonight, the Hovde Bus Tour, President Trump in Milwaukee, JD Vance in Racine, campaigning for Derrick Van Orden, and more. | | | | |
---
| | | | | One more day until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
---
| **Join Our Final Campaign Rally Tonight** Our final stop on the campaign trail will be tonight at Tavern H in Racine with Eric Hovde and Ron Johnson. I hope to see you there.
---
| | | |
---
| **Hovde Bus Tour** I joined our next United States Senator, Eric Hovde, on his bus tour this weekend. Our stops in Kenosha and Elkhorn made clear that Southeastern Wisconsin is fired up and ready to send Eric Hovde to the Senate.
---
| I also got to introduce Grandma Steil to Eric Hovde and Ron Johnson during our stop in Elkhorn!
---
| **Trump in Milwaukee** President Trump returned to Milwaukee on Friday evening. It was a sold out crowd and everyone was fired up to turn Wisconsin red.
---
| We also want to show our appreciation to the law enforcement officers who helped ensure we had a safe event on Friday and put their lives on the line to protect our communities every day.
---
[Click Here to Watch More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=a88e44b850&e=e907534017)
| **JD Vance in Racine** Last Monday, we welcomed JD Vance back to Southeastern Wisconsin when he visited downtown Racine.
---
[Click Here to Watch My Remarks](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=00b2e82db6&e=e907534017)
| JD Vance and the Trump campaign understand that we have a big opportunity to pick up Republican votes in Southeastern Wisconsin.
That’s why they’re spending so much time in our area of the state. **And that’s why we’re going to win on Tuesday!**
---
| **Working to Re-Elect Derrick Van Orden** I joined law enforcement in La Crosse to campaign for Derrick Van Orden.
---
| Derrick Van Orden backs the badge. And that’s why he’s law enforcement’s choice in Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District.
Western Wisconsin needs to send Derrick Van Orden back to Congress!
---
| **Steve Scalise in Kenosha** It was great to welcome Steve Scalise to Kenosha this week!
---
| Steve Scalise and House Republicans are united in working to grow our House Republican majority. I appreciate his support!
---
| **Election Night Party** On Tuesday, after you’ve voted and help get your friends to the polls, **I want to invite you to join our Election Night Party in Sturtevant**.
---
| I’m grateful for your support.
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

name: Janti Soeripto, Save the Children
subject: Earthquake Update: Here’s what I saw on my visit to Türkiye
body:
Your support is making a difference.
|
---
| | | | | | | | | [](https://click.alerts.savethechildren.org/?qs=9c30a188440a666bc08e1f13ac7299490c2013a8c5803930a881f1a3cad2037b63d05383647868c8313d86d1ce71c0e3185aaa3d7375a75e8186b205c0868274)
---
| | | | [](https://click.alerts.savethechildren.org/?qs=9c30a188440a666bc08e1f13ac7299490c2013a8c5803930a881f1a3cad2037b63d05383647868c8313d86d1ce71c0e3185aaa3d7375a75e8186b205c0868274)
---
Friend, following the devastating earthquakes in Syria and Turkiye, I visited Antakya, Turkiye. The damage from February's earthquakes is almost unfathomable: What was once a beautiful, historic, thriving city center is now a pile of rubble.

On my trip, I met with children and families who were displaced by this disaster, and I'll be honest, their stories are heartbreaking. Many have lost loved ones or are recovering from injuries sustained during the quakes and aftershocks. More still saw their homes and everything they owned destroyed. Parents are at their wits' ends worrying about where their traumatized and terrified children will sleep each night, what they will eat and how they will ever recover from this devastating disaster.

In total, 2.2 million people in Turkiye were left homeless by the earthquakes. Because Turkiye is host to the largest population of refugees in the world, many who were forced to flee life-threatening conflict are now displaced for the second, third or fourth time. This only compounds children's trauma and the long-term threat to their health, education and safety.

**I realize it 's a lot to take in - both the visible damage of shattered cities and the invisible damage which, particularly for children, is going to take a lot longer to repair. **

**But knowing there are generous people like you out there gives me so much hope in moments like this.** Thanks to your support, Save the Children had the resources to respond to these earthquakes quickly and effectively. In addition to providing emergency shelter, hygiene kits, warm clothing and other essential supplies, we've set up child-friendly spaces where children can get the psychological support they urgently need right now.

Of course, the road to recovery is long. When an emergency like this strikes, our teams are among the first to respond and the last to leave - we remain as long as it takes to help children and their communities recover. By supporting Save the Children, you can help provide fast and efficient aid to communities facing crises in the United States and around the world, when children's lives and well-being are most at risk.

**As our emergency response efforts in T urkiye and Syria continue, and as we work to ensure we are prepared to respond to whatever crisis erupts next, we're asking for your generosity. [Please, will you donate to Save the Children now to make sure we can continue to provide lifesaving resources and care to children in crisis?](https://click.alerts.savethechildren.org/?qs=9c30a188440a666b842aaf4f607c7269275794b360decf71b35b4d5d332eb14599c11a6d8c4f623cb9375b3e5319b775ace9497efe868c93e7739c0e2d688dcb)**

Thank you so much for everything you do to help children around the world grow up healthy, educated and safe.

Janti Soeripto
President & CEO, Save the Children

Dear Peter,
Time is almost up—just _one day left_ to be part of something truly extraordinary.
Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has made history by endorsing Donald Trump for President. Their unified front aims to end division and restore America, symbolized in a powerful mosaic of their handshake **that will hang on Bobby’s wall.**
_And now, you can be a part of this iconic moment._
[By contributing just $47,](https://www.mahanow.org/mosaic-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mosaic_4_11_4_24_1&n=5) not only will you help elect President Trump as the 47th President of the United States, but you’ll also become a part of a powerful mosaic — capturing the unforgettable handshake between RFK Jr. and President Trump.
This mosaic will commemorate the moment two patriots, one Independent, one Republican, joined forces for the greater good of our country. This partnership will work to end the forever wars, protect our civil liberties, get corruption out of our government agencies, and _Make America Healthy Again_.
Your photo will stand as a symbol of unity and your commitment to restoring America.
**Don’t miss this opportunity** to have your picture featured in this unforgettable mosaic. Join us in celebrating this turning point in our nation’s history.
[**Secure your place in history now.** _Contribute $47 today and let your image shine alongside this landmark moment._](https://www.mahanow.org/mosaic-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mosaic_4_11_4_24_1&n=6)

Thank you for standing with us!
Team Kennedy

Friend -- The video below, which includes all you really need to watch of Sen. Gillibrand debating Republican nominee Mike Sapraicone, will make very clear why they had to exclude me from the debate stage, and why my campaign for U.S. Senator has been so urgently needed. You can rest assured that whatever happens tomorrow, our fight will not end here. It can't. Jose and I have assembled through this campaign, the most amazing group of people, including you, and also many retired military and intelligence experts, who are truly qualified to formulate policy, while the majority of our national candidates are so mediocre (I'm being diplomatic) that we know we cannot place the future of mankind into their hands. | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/donate?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241104_donate&n=2 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.sareforsenate.com/donate?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241104_donate&n=2)
---
So, we really need to pour it on today and tomorrow, and I need your help! The final FEC deadline is tomorrow, and my campaign needs $13,000 to close the gap. We have been plastering the state with palm cards, door hangers and yard signs, and will be mobilizing votes until the polls close, and we'll be watching them count the vote after the polls close in every possible precinct. It is time for "We the People" to make the people who are supposed to work for us, work for us, and fear that we will no longer put up with their corruption! The rest of the world is depending on us.
So, I'm asking each of you, if you haven't already given your legal limit of $3300 since June 26, to make a donation today of ANY amount! It will make a difference. Thank you!!
-Diane

body:
People have been asking our campaign why we haven't stopped already - is it too late to give to make a difference?
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2181%2E135344%2EtngRIG)

Friend --
By now you know that no one (and I mean NO ONE) likes having to send the number of fundraising emails we've had to send to raise the kind of money we need to win this Senate race.
And like you, I am counting down the days until I can stop invading your inbox with these requests.
But, unfortunately, today is not that day.
People have been asking our campaign why we haven't stopped already -- is it too late to give to make a difference?
The answer to that question is no. It is not too late. In fact, it's really important that you contribute one more time if you're in a position to do so.
But before I share a link to give, let me share a few of the places your contribution will go toward helping us win this race.
We need to plus-up our last minute digital advertising efforts targeting infrequent Democratic voters and persuadable voters who lean Democratic before they cast their ballots.
We need to pay organizers daily to supplement our volunteer calls and door knocks to those same audiences, as well as pay for more literature, pizza for volunteers, and hot chocolate for students standing in line at University of Michigan, Michigan State University, and other college campuses.
And we have to be prepared for anything that may come our way after the polls close.
So yes -- your contribution is still important. And I can promise you that's true because otherwise I would not be asking. So please:
[**Use this link to contribute $5, $50 or whatever you can afford today. We will put your donation right to work reaching the voters we need to win this race.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241104-1-900&t=2&akid=2181%2E135344%2EtngRIG)

| **ONE DAY.** Tomorrow is Election Day, folks. After months of hard work, thousands of miles traveled, and hundreds of events we can see the finish line. But we cannot give up yet – we have so much more ground to cover as things really heat up—[**and we need your support to make it happen!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=ce0b5aa718&e=0fced71d8c)
---
| **We need to raise another $5,000 between now and Election Day.** We are going the extra mile to try to reach constituents who haven’t voted yet, need help with their election plan, or may need transportation to their polling location. We need to do everything to make sure voters know they have a better choice. We are running a true grassroots campaign all thanks to your generosity, time, and dedication. We wouldn’t be where we are at without your help.
---
| Together, we are fighting for a better future for our community and nation. To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our congressional district, we’ve launched our billboard campaign, are releasing TV ads, and have been running radio ads left and right.
---
| Our opponent doesn’t have what it takes to represent the people of the sixth congressional district. He is a proud Trump MAGA loyalist. My focus is revitalizing the economy, creating jobs, and ensuring fair wages and protecting workers. I support women’s right to choose, workers and their right to collectively bargain, increased funding for public schools, expanded and optimized broadband, equitable access to technology, and respect for personal privacy and healthcare choices. I am committed to transitioning to renewable energy, tackling climate change, and advocating for a diplomatic resolution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. My platform offers practical solutions and progressive leadership for a brighter future in Virginia’s vast, beautiful sixth congressional district.
---
| Do you know what my opponent brings to the table?
---
| ❌ Voted against the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act❌ Voted against the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act❌ Voted against the American Rescue Plan❌ Voted against the Affordable Insulin Now Act❌ Voted against the PAWS Act❌ Voted against the Ending Forced Arbitration of Sexual Assault and Sexual Harassment Act❌ Voted against the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act❌ Voted against the Protecting Older Workers from Discrimination Act❌ Voted against the Lower Drug Costs Now Act❌ Voted against the Equality Act
---
| As you can imagine, the list goes on and doesn’t get any better. My opponent proudly stands with a convicted felon, Marjorie Taylor Greene, Matt Gaetz, and Speaker Mike Johnson. The sixth congressional district deserves so much better.
---

[**CLICK HERE TO DONATE NOW!**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=4acc706647&e=0fced71d8c)[

---
| [**Can you donate $50, $100, or $250 dollars to help us defeat Ben Cline and reach more voters?**](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=535e16f98a&e=0fced71d8c)

subject: Your 2025 Hillsdale College Calendar
body:

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your
2025 Hillsdale College calendar.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWwNz3BW-N

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I'm
reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your 2025
Hillsdale College calendar.

I know, I
know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since
you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you
had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

Claim
your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before November 30 by
clicking on this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63747015:WwNz3BW-N:m:3:2627245898:2EF26FCFF1E589C6AE713894566BE8AC:r

As you
know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism.
You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled
by an administrative state that operates without the say of our
elected representatives.

It is,
therefore, completely unaccountable to "we the people."

This
collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the
federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where
you live!

One
particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools…

At these
schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and
actively undermine parents.

In higher
education-especially at taxpayer-funded state
universities-bloated administrations push ideologies that teach
young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But
thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting
influence. We stay true to our mission…

…to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings
of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed,
as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have
redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But
we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

Just in
the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to…

Teach
4 million Americans in Hillsdale's free online courses, including
"Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution,"
"The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest
course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the
Constitution to citizens nationwide-especially younger Americans,
especially thousands of K-12 students.

Provide an American classical education to young students
nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence
and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, Hillsdale's monthly digest of
liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope
you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar so that when
you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the
important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember,
your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny
of government funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: Please contribute to the DNC today. Here’s why
body:
Let me start with the obvious.
---
Democrats! Let me start with the obvious: I know that we're all feeling anxious about tomorrow and the days that will follow. I've heard from a lot of people asking whether it is too late to do anything that will shape the outcome of this election. The answer to that question is... no, it is not too late. I am campaigning in California, where Kamala Harris will win handily, but there are a number of races that will determine control of the House of Representatives. There are volunteers and organizers in states across the country -- many funded by the Democratic Party -- working to get out the vote in close races up and down the ballot. And I know that the DNC can still use contributions today, that they can put to work tomorrow and help with whatever comes after the election. The point is, that we all have a role to play today. Yes, today. When we’re in it together, we can accomplish a great deal. That remains true today, and it's how we're going to win victories up and down the ballot tomorrow. It's not too late to make a difference: [**Please contribute $3, or whatever you can afford to the Democratic National Committee today. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: It’s been a wild ride.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that more than 400,000 people would back me up and donate to support me
#

Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben.
You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=1&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
...ended up where I am now. Running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country, with everyone watching to see how we do tomorrow night.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=2&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
Let me take you back to the beginning. It all started in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=3&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=4&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=5&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
I deployed to al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest hit Marine unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=6&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=7&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=8&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
I decided to run for U.S. Senate, and I’m up against Kari Lake. The “MAGA Queen.” She’s spread more lies and conspiracies about our elections than anyone in the country, after Trump himself.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=9&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that more than 400,000 people would back me up and donate to support me, either.
And with just one day to go, I never thought it would come down to this. We’re in a neck-and-neck race. Lake and I are tied, and our Senate Majority hangs in the balance.
I know you’ve already done so much to help me, Peter. But I need you one more time.
[**Please — if you could chip in $5 to my campaign today it would mean the world to me. Races this close come down to turnout, and we need all the resources we can get now as we rush to reach our voters and get them to the polls.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241104-1-160&t=10&akid=3527%2E734936%2Ew3zoIc)

I decided to run for U.S. Senate, and I’m up against Kari Lake. The “MAGA Queen.” She’s spread more lies and conspiracies about our elections than anyone in the country, after Trump himself. Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out. When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home. When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that more than 400,000 people would back me up and donate to support me, either. And with just one day to go, I never thought it would come down to this. We’re in a neck-and-neck race. Lake and I are tied, and our Senate Majority hangs in the balance. I know you’ve already done so much to help me, Peter. But I need you one more time. name: PoliticsPA
subject: Good news for PA Dems and Republicans
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

**Tomorrow night, the entire nation watches the Keystone State.**

This segment explores what to expect from Pennsylvania on Election Night – from the process of delivering timely, accurate results, building trust in the system, and how this election could shape future election code reforms.

Former Election Director of Dauphin County **Jerry Feaser** and Election Director of Mercer County **Thad Hall** shared insights you won't want to miss ahead of tomorrow's election.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Fmr. Election Director Jerry Feaser** explained PA's shortcomings with its early voting process. "It is challenging because of all of the paperwork that's involved to do our version of 'early voting.' If we really had an early voting process in PA, it would be very smooth." [[Watch]](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=719af66be4&e=b7b3eddce2)

**Mercer County Election Director Thad Hall** talked about the operational challenges of not pre-canvassing ballots. "I'm having to pull resources away from voters in polling places that need our assistance. It diminishes my ability to help our precincts on Election Day."
[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bfd1aba443&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Lancaster Commissioner ****Ray D’Agostino** said,**** “This was detected, it was stopped, and the investigation is ongoing,” confirming the county's election processes remain secure following the staff's detection of a batch of 2,500 suspicious voter registration applications last week. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4a001abcf6&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* **Good news: a divided nation finds common ground.** Over half of likely voters believe November 5, 2024, will be the most pivotal Election Day of their lives. [[Quinnipiac](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1492a9f601&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* More of the state’s registered voters see natural gas drilling as boosting the economy, **with 51% in favor** , compared to 33% who view it as environmentally harmful. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0670e987b0&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* 43% of PA respondents **say they are “worse off”** financially than a year ago. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1ff3b0626b&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* New CNN/SSRS and Quinnipiac polls **confirm a deadlock** between Harris and Trump in PA. [[PoliticsPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ca972c37f6&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* In the U.S. Senate race, only 1% are Trump-Casey and Trump-Other voters, with **virtually no Harris-McCormick** or Harris-Other voters. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f4ab912075&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **All Eyes on PA – Here's What You Can Expect on Election Night**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8bd1c77ea8&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._

This segment dives into 2024 policy priorities should the GOP retake control of the PA House, and big reforms planned for the Auditor General's office in another term.

PA Auditor General **Tim DeFoor** and PA House Minority Leader **Bryan Cutler** shared insights you won't want to miss ahead of tomorrow's election.
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=038202d2b5&e=b7b3eddce2 "Tim DeFoor & Bryan Cutler Talk 2024 Policy Priorities – Keystone Candidate Forum")
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e150f25126&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4924386641&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9a00c50c49&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1c1b08c0b6&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b3af96528b&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Tomorrow is Election Day, and many Minnesotans have yet to vote or return their completed Vote By Mail ballot. This guide will answer common questions for Election Day and help you prepare for a smooth experience at your polling place!
---
## Where is my Election Day polling place?
---
You can find your Early Voting locations and Election Day polling place at [iwillvote.com](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.T4f1s0H8aL8dqpmq959YtCL7oWWm_hB-2AWslfFXnBOih1Bpspujyd_-Vj76f3-0ECQSz0AKLscLscNMjMQ8z8LQ1I1o2FnpthqhEJQPDAfhjzG6DDb4l3VDv8f-_4jfkjGEf2UPv8U7V4PDWpG7ySSQ1skBBWP94bQuKPIE9bGT6pOk3pMPgzW5Xf3iffZfXBSU7RBTKV-KTnh3mc6tuiZvLdyahqOA1wENmg7oxicSrObxwc1hzyPduCp71T9-iMXBDrJRBoc0QDvie1uxWH4cr9W8AXGE0-hGxpsU2fM/4b6/8ZURc2nfS1ePuK-i5DzmBA/h1/h001.esjr1DxgMAnnlT6plN3oTHR9Pd19Zgsh3v_5M1pjIHA). Enter your home street address and ZIP code, then select either "Early vote" or "Election day".
---
[ iwillvote.com ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.T4f1s0H8aL8dqpmq959YtCL7oWWm_hB-2AWslfFXnBOih1Bpspujyd_-Vj76f3-0okRbazj0Iu4h1i5718tQ8__Z8FCzBPi85Ohn642kTXOsTRNzH-5d8D1sRTNWU8o3wYtCI6dCrWsGfGUfJp0q1J3P7SGEyzNFYF39puNNZmL6f4paqne7xOr59utEs5-gHTDILjBFypLvHX2djWWtFrQrJIbuPF3QiLrkf3QjyEV0slr5kCKK-XygiNT2d9rvSgT8RAUYQyhrGaJ6Zs8y_5XAqLb4hs6g_G1-jf6ivwo/4b6/8ZURc2nfS1ePuK-i5DzmBA/h2/h001.uJUEx2Pqe06ohU4iCto83vQzA0JtNvOmD4mF8HJdDHI)
---
## When are polls open on Election Day?
---
All polling places across Minnesota are open from **7:00 am to 8:00 pm** on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. If you are in line by 8:00 pm, stay in line and you will be able to vote.
---
## When can I return my Vote By Mail ballot?
---
You can return your completed Vote By Mail ballot today, Monday, during regular hours or tomorrow, Tuesday, until 8:00 pm. **Please return your completed envelope to the location listed in your paperwork.** This may be your county elections office or a municipal elections office in some jurisdictions. **Questions about voting?** Contact our hotline at 1-833-335-8683 ([1-833-DFL-VOTE](tel:18333358683?link_id=4&can_id=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-dfl-election-day-voter-guide&email_referrer=email_2516605&email_subject=your-election-day-voter-guide)).
---
## Your completed absentee ballot must be returned by 8:00 pm on Election Day, November 5
---
Under updated Minnesota state law, all absentee and Vote By Mail ballots must be returned to the issuing local elections office by 8:00 pm on Election Day. Make a plan to return your ballot by hand or vote on Election Day. If you drop it in the mail, it may not be received by the deadline. **Do not return a Vote By Mail ballot to your local precinct polling place on Election Day, they will not accept it.**
---
## **Do I need to bring ID to vote in-person?**
---
**You do not need to bring identification to your polling location during early voting or on Election Day if your voter registration is current and active.** You can check your registration status at the [Minnesota Secretary of State](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVbBeBf7aGi-vR0JAJIAQiE4PczRGrxhroY1c1Bu3KnDCRJqMM-dDhX0CgPvp_YTdjGhwmlVnQGZ0X8VEXMRXrKKQKYIupAuGjpMFy_xAEx_8BgqsXSliFB0GvxQeRUYpb6psDotnY5z5TdimEZWgPpXFTmr-hrqnulHQMrtBlFPRN7z3cZpsoJpUXtL_Z-6E-VxaDafqHxxa-njr1gbxzsmz3fwUeyAD9BkfWKbVVj349Lh6h45GthJK4sGi31LZ96N_W7BtQl4OPPQlJdcw7uBWa888d38_UkBuhNAY5qy4/4b6/8ZURc2nfS1ePuK-i5DzmBA/h3/h001.bCwA3wz_LVhdO8ufzOyrr71nl_J_enjALqukjD5owSM). You must have been successfully registered at least 21 days before Election Day and not have moved or legally changed names since. **You will need to bring ID only if you: **
* Need to register at the time you vote (during both Early Voting or on Election Day);
* Have not voted in four consecutive years or more;
* Have moved outside of your precinct since registering to vote, or need to update your registration for another reason;
* You pre-registered less than 21 days ahead of Election Day.

If you need to bring ID, [review instructions on same-day voter registration from the Minnesota Secretary of State.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMeZg7zC-4KR-3uZoVMJd5Rem7nSK-q__AYCaOWKT6shXSY54ADsFZz7AvMDCojkflo61vLWJJF7f-2ZfQUqb66abgN6nb7Fd0AGJCw56G5JBGROOPTl9g-69AllmdNA44tHDPbQxvy5hTZqhEwy_9-PCkgxaO3yvf5pJpUyO5_J3kGgUQ1j5upfSKeK9K8NNqmGeDfWJAXdi-Z8VKa7BjWV9iT7ne6sScq0miRJHmUnKLlisfj6ij3KN0Rq6Ek1yoTyff1Sq7qpbcdRq_35njCxsM-VwGHd5wunF2yr-nDAqQ4W7KSlvU1vMf06UUfzaP05WwqymI3BQQXeKenFjFGc/4b6/8ZURc2nfS1ePuK-i5DzmBA/h4/h001.qzmVfd0ysuZzvjD_FNwyHo-XXj4hJrmXnE_xEfMMqs4)

## What if I need a drive to the polling place?
---
**The Minnesota DFL Voter Protection Team is here to help!** We have nearly 300 trained drivers standing by on Election Day. If you would like to schedule a ride for Election Day the day before on Monday, [sign up online to book your drive in advance.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRTm4QDbJmHdSzHQwMBFf1rMRb58Z_FsJhPw6yDkuFarAeK8h-SeIz04OOnBeOMQJGtVnU4Dh7DL-4KKOr6hfY61CeSWrKxKH9MYg3Gstv9Oymoq7CdmylYuXyxSwIIdHHW8Cv00-na5_udFM8WOqKYZTvQiPPm-s3WU9UchiWnf5pNcIA4X9J6cpblHPAnE3aQtDlDY5le39CVKX9_OOwTAncP7FFTTrchfCKeumlv1rwVncNFDECiKAX4Wi9hoJ_E2Rb8dincfgOgrVDk2HuVXVJ7E7I9q4XB6I8HzaWlFhwzxOtV8epN-m0WLtVRl3sE/4b6/8ZURc2nfS1ePuK-i5DzmBA/h5/h001.nJ6wiRQGZ0MIUgL9FW4UcJLkA4cmSKlK0KA6NKiBCjg) If it's already Election Day, contact our hotline at 1-833-335-8683 ([1-833-DFL-VOTE](tel:18333358683?link_id=8&can_id=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-dfl-election-day-voter-guide&email_referrer=email_2516605&email_subject=your-election-day-voter-guide)) to schedule a drive as soon as available.

clean_body: This guide will answer common questions about what to expect on Election Day and how you can prepare best for a smooth experience at your polling place! | | Tomorrow is Election Day, and many Minnesotans have yet to vote or return their completed Vote By Mail ballot. This guide will answer common questions for Election Day and help you prepare for a smooth experience at your polling place! Where is my Election Day polling place? You can find your Early Voting locations and Election Day polling place at . Enter your home street address and ZIP code, then select either "Early vote" or "Election day". When are polls open on Election Day? All polling places across Minnesota are open from 7:00 am to 8:00 pm on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. If you are in line by 8:00 pm, stay in line and you will be able to vote. When can I return my Vote By Mail ballot? You can return your completed Vote By Mail ballot today, Monday, during regular hours or tomorrow, Tuesday, until 8:00 pm. Please return your completed envelope to the location listed in your paperwork. This may be your county elections office or a municipal elections office in some jurisdictions. Questions about voting? Contact our hotline at 1-833-335-8683 (tel:18333358683?linkid=4&canid=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-dfl-election-day-voter-guide&emailreferrer=email2516605&emailsubject=your-election-day-voter-guide). Your completed absentee ballot must be returned by 8:00 pm on Election Day, November 5 Under updated Minnesota state law, all absentee and Vote By Mail ballots must be returned to the issuing local elections office by 8:00 pm on Election Day. Make a plan to return your ballot by hand or vote on Election Day. If you drop it in the mail, it may not be received by the deadline. Do not return a Vote By Mail ballot to your local precinct polling place on Election Day, they will not accept it. Do I need to bring ID to vote in-person? You do not need to bring identification to your polling location during early voting or on Election Day if your voter registration is current and active. You can check your registration status at the . You must have been successfully registered at least 21 days before Election Day and not have moved or legally changed names since. You will need to bring ID only if you: Need to register at the time you vote (during both Early Voting or on Election Day); Have not voted in four consecutive years or more; Have moved outside of your precinct since registering to vote, or need to update your registration for another reason; You pre-registered less than 21 days ahead of Election Day. If you need to bring ID, What if I need a drive to the polling place? The Minnesota DFL Voter Protection Team is here to help! We have nearly 300 trained drivers standing by on Election Day. If you would like to schedule a ride for Election Day the day before on Monday, If it's already Election Day, contact our hotline at 1-833-335-8683 (tel:18333358683?linkid=8&canid=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-dfl-election-day-voter-guide&emailreferrer=email2516605&emailsubject=your-election-day-voter-guide) to schedule a drive as soon as available. tel:18333358683?linkid=10&canid=12471c8e444f80358077c9724aea85a0&source=email-your-dfl-election-day-voter-guide&emailreferrer=email2516605&emailsubject=your-election-day-voter-guide How do I register to vote when I vote? Under Minnesota state law, you can register to vote the same day you vote, whether Early or on Election Day. Have questions? Our Voter Protection Hotline is here to help answer your voting questions Whether a voter decides to vote early via absentee ballot or go to their polling place on Election Day, the Voter Protection team works to ensure that every eligible vote counts. name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: Time Is Running Out – Vote Trump & Save America!
body:
Only hours remain to secure victory. Find out how you can help today and tomorrow!
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| ****************
###
**__****_WE HAVEN 'T WON YET! _**Some states still have early voting today, Monday, November 4th. In states without early voting today, tomorrow--Election Day, Tuesday, November 5th--is the final chance to vote for President Trump and other Republicans to save America. **The bottom line is, make sure YOU VOTE and get OTHER TRUMP VOTERS to the polls, too. **The details about how you can accomplish these activities are below, divided up by state, as there are different Get Out The Vote opportunities in different states.
---
| |
---
| ******** **** **********FIRST: Make Sure YOU Vote!**
If you haven't voted yet, make your plan **_now_** to ensure you can get to the polls tomorrow-and **be prepared to wait in line as long as necessary to cast your ballot.** If you have friends and family who have not voted yet, take them to the polls when you go. Making a plan means finding out where you vote, what time the location is open and when you can go, what you need to bring with you, and how you will get there. You can find that kind of information on your Secretary of State's website or you can look at Ballotpedia:
* [Early Voting](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161a6)
* [Election Day](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161a8)
**
SECOND: Get OTHER Trump Supporters to Vote!
** You are a potent weapon in our effort to win, did you know that? It's most often the person-to-person contact that makes the difference between winning and losing. The first item you'll find below are links to educational resources that will help you, should you need well-referenced information about the candidates. After that, we've divided the Get Out The Vote opportunities up into three different groups, so be sure to read through the opportunities listed in your group. There is the Georgia group, the Swing States group (PA, MI, WI, NV, AZ, NC, and MT), and the All Other States group. Find your group and then help us re-elect President Trump and win the House and the Senate, so that we can SAVE AMERICA!! **EDUCATIONAL RESOURCES FOR EVERYONE**
Kamala Harris' policies are a danger to our nation's future. Share the facts with our [Kamala Info Page](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161aa)[,](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161ac) [Trump Info Page](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161ae)[,](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161b0) and even our Jeopardy-style [Kamala Quiz](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161b2) to educate voters.You will also want to share our ad titled, ["Will Your Daughter be Next?"](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161b4) that shines a light on Kamala Harris' deadly open border policies. Driven by her reckless agenda to erase our borders, she has enabled violent illegal aliens to enter our country freely--resulting in the brutal murders of American women and girls. President Trump also [released an ad about this](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161b6) that every voter needs to see.
**GEORGIA GET OUT THE VOTE**
**Relational Organizing: **Use our app to figure out which of your lean-Republican, Georgian friends have not yet voted. Then, using the app, you need to text and call those people to get them to vote. Go to [WinElectionsGA.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161b8) to sign up, download the app, and get started. **SWING STATE GET OUT THE VOTE (PA, MI, WI, NV, AZ, NC, and MT)**
**Relational Organizing: **Use our app to figure out which of your lean-Republican, swing state friends have not yet voted. Then, using the app, you need to text and call those people to get them to vote. Go to [WinElections.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161ba) to sign up, download the app, and get started. **ALL OTHER STATES GET OUT THE VOTE**
**Phone Banking:** From your home, you can connect with voters who need that reminder to vote Trump. Join at [CallForTrump.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a621ecbf/1edb9794a62161bc). There is only today and tomorrow to persuade them to vote and we need every vote to be able save America! **__****__**
---
| |
---
| ******** **** While people often claim that each election is the most important one we've ever faced, the reality is that each election has become evermore critical to the existence of our nation. As the government leviathan continues to grow, as it is further weaponized against those who stand up to the powerful, as minor and major freedoms-even those guaranteed by the Constitution-are smashed and incinerated, each election legitimately becomes the most important election of our lives. **We truly, truly need every voter who supports Trump and the Republicans to cast their vote. They cannot sit at home this time. **Please make this a priority today and tomorrow. Imagine how you will feel if Kamala Harris is announced as the winner. If that scares you, then help us Get Out The Vote!
For America!
Jenny Beth Martin **__****__**

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96525635/510283402/1604068332?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Watch_241104_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGQyZjY4Ni1iYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mqqqm8bZmDe2E4bvB384hCyYfEPxOh0x6VO-S1aAJ64=) Derek,

Back in March, I launched my Warner’s Ones to Watch program to help support Democratic Senate candidates across the country. When I did, I wrote to you: _"I really do believe that if this grassroots movement bands together to support our vulnerable Senate Democrats up for re-election, we can win in November."_

**Well, Derek, Election Day is tomorrow and the truth is, I stand by that – no matter what political pundits say – because this election isn’t over until we’ve done everything we can to make sure every eligible voter can make their voice heard before the polls close. And there’s still time to fight.**

**_[Rush a $5 donation to join me in the fight to keep the Senate blue tomorrow>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96525636/510283404/1604068332?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Watch_241104_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGQyZjY4Ni1iYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mqqqm8bZmDe2E4bvB384hCyYfEPxOh0x6VO-S1aAJ64=)_**

Over the last eight months, I’ve talked to you about some pretty remarkable candidates: Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, Tammy Baldwin, Jacky Rosen, Bob Casey, and Tim Kaine.

If you were to google any of their names right now, you’d see some scary headlines. Sherrod Brown is trailing his Trump-backed opponent in the polls... Tim Kaine is being outspent by his opponent, Hung Cao... Jon Tester is tied with Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate...

The thing is, this isn’t the first time we’ve been warned of a "red wave" in the Senate, and it certainly won’t be the last. We’ve stopped it before, and I know we can stop it again. But it’s going to take all of us stepping up **right now** to do so.

| | Happy Monday! Welcome back to the final edition of the weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update during the 2024 cycle! These past few months have been incredible, and tomorrow, NJ-07 will head to the ballot box. Tomorrow will be the culmination of the hard work of so many of you reading this email, and many more beyond that. Over the past year, we have built a team and campaign to be proud of. While there are many people to thank, I would like to highlight four incredibly talented, dedicated, and kind individuals that I have had the pleasure to work with each and every day - our Field Directors: __**Isabella Kovar, JJ Cahill, Luke McManimon, and Owen McTernan**__. These four have not only been assets on the ground working with our interns, volunteers, county organizations and local campaigns, but have been excelling at keeping the ship running behind the scenes. I am grateful and fortunate to have been able to call them my team and my friends. Election Day is only __**TOMORROW**__ away! We have left it all on the field. Make a plan to vote. [Find your polling location](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=40571155da094197b008b687d4d39315&_e=fOC0WbpY6FTvGyn19dActiNv9VLjX1x5Z3dzm4NDHN5dDegWL1baZhUPazqigZaawsQ8knvBgOurWxJSsUvMfMDVtPxhVVpgP_C8gxdtidmhN6TkOtbmoew-cT185Sd3nDP2Floon1iaaWAhq2IUUW9Wx6VmgBvEwGeTCVrFFUSByBn4tWRKcayoY8eOOzjmJw_srUBQiEC6VnVhzh83GDZhY52rmpKUygOUZjjUc6E%3D). Go to the polls. Vote! Over __**208,000**__ voters across NJ-07 have already cast their vote - nearly 35% of all registered voters in the District! Our Republican team has WON the Early vote, and drastically cut into the Democrats' advance vote lead. We are in great shape headed into tomorrow. Please consider volunteering at our final, all-day phone banking operations tomorrow. We will be pushing Republicans and our allies to the polls to vote for Tom Kean, Jr.! This past week, Tom spent time across the district at events, knocked on doors, and sharing his closing message with the voters of NJ-07. It was a long week, filled with highlights and milestones, all of which I will cover below. Our Field Team spent the week on final volunteer and local campaign launches, expanding our Our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) field plan, chasing outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, and encouraging early voting. If you have a vote-by-mail ballot, it must be post marked by tomorrow to be counted, or returned to a secure dropbox by 8pm to count. Polls will be open across NJ-07 tomorrow from 6:00am to 8:00pm. clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to the final edition of the weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update during the 2024 cycle! These past few months have been incredible, and tomorrow, NJ-07 will head to the ballot box. Tomorrow will be the culmination of the hard work of so many of you reading this email, and many more beyond that. Over the past year, we have built a team and campaign to be proud of. While there are many people to thank, I would like to highlight four incredibly talented, dedicated, and kind individuals that I have had the pleasure to work with each and every day - our Field Directors: Isabella Kovar, JJ Cahill, Luke McManimon, and Owen McTernan. These four have not only been assets on the ground working with our interns, volunteers, county organizations and local campaigns, but have been excelling at keeping the ship running behind the scenes. I am grateful and fortunate to have been able to call them my team and my friends. Election Day is only TOMORROW away! We have left it all on the field. Make a plan to vote. . Go to the polls. Vote! Over 208,000 voters across NJ-07 have already cast their vote - nearly 35% of all registered voters in the District! Our Republican team has WON the Early vote, and drastically cut into the Democrats' advance vote lead. We are in great shape headed into tomorrow. Please consider volunteering at our final, all-day phone banking operations tomorrow. We will be pushing Republicans and our allies to the polls to vote for Tom Kean, Jr.! This past week, Tom spent time across the district at events, knocked on doors, and sharing his closing message with the voters of NJ-07. It was a long week, filled with highlights and milestones, all of which I will cover below. Our Field Team spent the week on final volunteer and local campaign launches, expanding our Our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) field plan, chasing outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, and encouraging early voting. If you have a vote-by-mail ballot, it must be post marked by tomorrow to be counted, or returned to a secure dropbox by 8pm to count. Polls will be open across NJ-07 tomorrow from 6:00am to 8:00pm. You can find your polling place . If you are in line by 8:00pm you must be allowed to cast your vote. Please do not leave. Our team has established a Voter Integrity hotline to report any issues or concerns. The number is 732-335-7300. The lines will be monitored beginning at 6:00am when polls open. You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our . On a personal closing note, it has been an honor to serve Tom for the past year in my role as Campaign Manager. I first met Tom when he was a then-State Senator and spoke at my Eagle Scout Ceremony in 2015. Tom spoke about how a reverence to public service is an honorable quality. He spoke about how Eagle Scouts understand this and work to serve their community each and every day. In my mind, Tom upholds the same qualities I learned in Scouting. Both Tom and Rhonda are kind, caring, and compassionate individuals who always put others before themselves. Tom serves with humble leadership, lifts up those around him, and cares deeply about helping others. I cast my vote for Tom Kean, Jr., and I hope you will do the same. Let's win,\- Kean MacLelland | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | Tom made stops in Scotch Plains , Clark, New Providence, Bernards, Readington, Bridgewater, Westfield, Berkeley Heights, and Mountainside just to name a few! Tom also participated in an interview with Newsmax yesterday morning. Our door knocking program covered towns like Milford, Alexandria, Flemington, Raritan, Clinton Town, Clinton Township, Readington, Hackettstown, Washington Borough, Pohatcong, Greenwich, Lopatcong, Oxford, Mansfield, Byram, Stanhope, Sparta, Bridgewater, Bedminster, Raritan Borough, Bernards, Bernardsville, Warren Township, Hillsborough, Westfield, Clark, Scotch Plains, and Rahway , just to name a few! I would like to give a special thanks to IBEW Local 102 for the second week in a row for their efforts in the Field. IBEW held a labor launch in Clark where they knocked on over 1,500 doors. We are very proud of our campaign's labor coalition this year, and will work to continue to advocate for their priorities every day in Washington. Please send them your thanks! As I send this email, we have volunteers, interns and campaigns in the field knocking on doors ahead of tomorrow. Because of these collaborative efforts, we knocked on over 11,500 doors (and counting!) for GOTV week. The energy on the ground has been incredible. Since Labor Day, we have sent over 1,300,000 text messages, made over 208,000 phone calls, and knocked on over 57,000 doors. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with organized phone banks this week. We focused on pushing Republican voters to utilize early voting, and chase remaining mail in ballots. This week, and with the projected numbers from tonight's phone bank, we will be able to call over 25,000 voters across all six counties. We also sent out over 325,000 text messages to residents and voters, and will send an additional 150,000 messages over the next 24 hours. Absolutely incredible. | Hi Friend! Happy Election Day Eve!
---
Tomorrow, history will be made. Despite mainstream media spinning a “neck and neck” narrative, early voting data indicates that America is showing up and liberty is making a comeback.
We are also facing all manner of election exploitation. Ballot dropboxes being firebombed, election processes being unlawfully changed, nationwide software “glitches”, foreign interference, fraudulent voter registrations, noncitizens receiving ballots, agitation rising at the polls, and the list goes on.
What are we to think about this state of affairs? Will we see a repeat of 2020? No. Unlike the last election, this time, patriots are far more engaged and prepared. Every day is a battle - but it is a battle we are winning.
### Here’s how we’re helping hold the line:
**The Ballot Dropbox Transparency Project** \- Use of ballot dropboxes is down by nearly 80%! Why? Voters are choosing to vote early in person, bad actors know that watchful eyes are everywhere, and trafficking channels are being exposed and shut down. Case in point, this video from Steven Crowder. Worth the watch!

### Voting on Election Day!
A few recommendations for voting on Tuesday:
* Get excited! You are helping make history! Your choices matter!
* Arrive EARLY. Most polls open at 7a. [You can check your polling hours here](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.uLk7BvKZ-RXsZLYERm90D8SW3wc5XuSNtTAANV97BijXIBfD5t-vous47t_gYvUq_T9vlmV2lmF1OsXSyMpjHhidEif4nCJuK1IRnQpdZO5lWwWHvRWA-2eUSVlQ2ZCVPNGgfnkold7dDc1N0S42z4UljY3XUDo37d8D2aEkT0G9yIocc6HBwqcypeR3AqAXKMvfyAB2VDft4jwCDgH3Uh_Vw1_gNDyHQp-eyPzgnBU38j249Bw4wCwUv1NNLVyMi8MGUCT0mHfOLnmQIYqtXuOT6XdDEKZYYAyxMjfMbUs/4b6/1RzUcg8sQrWzuNB48QDNjA/h11/h001.aJXo8UYPlCDvKcmhcwQY-ml9s621GOyEPPd5-CduIQc).
* Bring water (and snacks). Your wait may be long - but it is worth it!
* Do not wear political attire. Wearing anything “political” is considering to be electioneering and will not be allowed inside the polling place.
* Vote the full ballot! Many people only vote for the office of the President, but there are other critical races on every ballot! Federal races for the Senate and House, state races, local races, special issues - cast your vote for all of them. [You can check out a sample ballot in your area here.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.uLk7BvKZ-RXsZLYERm90D8SW3wc5XuSNtTAANV97BijzaINi8kVNAdEntA9J8weD8wKMr0xHNBNYhMA6mxnPcvJ4L-GKJ-2uaWOqIYZUUwTdkUKahLMnfE4NFz118K2UoMpqOZEOv1am7jqiFLpobX9dh6o61OTcbsCw3WlIQHmqn_4Jd7S3wKckxQgzcVpaP63fvmMTZv46WbJexKs_fbPdgMwoyPhlm9eWorglEvminT1SLmqkFpSOcKKXVi1_ScYtmkuj00eeUkyTlE6rqg/4b6/1RzUcg8sQrWzuNB48QDNjA/h12/h001.mIPE_SuBoGTwNfEuT1iAeyOEdmUQHhG3hhAExX4bcvU)
* Do not leave without voting. This is likely the most important vote you will ever cast. Your country needs you!

### What Can You Do Right Now?
It’s all hands on deck right now! Here are three simple but extremely important ways to engage right now:
1. **Call or text everyone you care about and remind them to vote**. Sample script: _“Hi there! I’m reaching out because I care about you - and tomorrow’s vote will impact your future. If you haven’t already, please vote. You can find your polling location with the online search phrase “Where do I vote?”. And if you need a ride, give me a call!”_ 😀
2. **Help your family and friends steer clear of fake news.** Election Day will bring lots of confusion and misreporting. Mainstream news will do ... what it does, but there will be many live streams that you can recommend on X, Rumble, and YouTube. True the Vote has teamed up with [Steven Crowder’s Election Live Stream of the Century](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.9dvqWuZBK2wbyKCCZlLJteK18bQNuhhthnXmACbBElEKk5tydAfG8NBINCPtewNVfQjSC3i4DMbDKMxhtPnUOJd2BvcP1nG1GQaAL7ow5zKZHMcdUNi2DxL_xoFoqkL1BM9wHyBwZITnevgNLCbKIyb6RAEbrr2jscSpggDy4SzbsQT7dTYimhzoSyqce0nmQEuS9E0Cfb70u00Morh2Bg90yAtxfDi1h5Fzox8kWehWFLRF2QBoqyXE2djC_HvT/4b6/1RzUcg8sQrWzuNB48QDNjA/h13/h001.rrTPmQH05k19_Qi1xT2EJ21bUWv0EA-zIh0VD7nks7I), so you’ll see me there Tuesday evening. You can also follow us on all social platforms @TruetheVote or @VotoHonesto.
3. **MOST IMPORTANT OF ALL - PRAY.** God has His hand on our Country. Pray that He will deliver us from Evil. Intercessors for America is hosting prayer sessions and voter prayer. [ You can find more info on their events here.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.sV4MFbzBllccGzy2svLCohU6PBwOxMMrGDSWW6e_iyXQCDKD7FkNECFRiJ1oKMdmcWNtcaDaH34VL-kUC77rpFUAf7oQja0CYX8NWCLIR8BL-PEEnXs4IESNd2F4qCjL-ulTlfPJsC4ipIvmGad_aIp6QA2Fpw-vj6gc5vNRB9Qvlw1NS959PoNajRTyWVrHqz7ck8EpDILE13-hjRz5Nqmh5CZxao6wO12HGX506Qw/4b6/1RzUcg8sQrWzuNB48QDNjA/h14/h001.U-JpRfgdozX64t-J87OtIgwGHwIdLOvdHQca-HnB7XA)

Friend: As the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, I was raised to fight hard, do what’s right, and make the change I want to see.
That's what pushed me through waiting tables at Caesars Palace to help pay for college, becoming the first in my family to graduate, and working as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field.
It's what motivated me during my first-ever campaign for Congress in 2016, when I flipped a highly competitive district from red to blue. And in my campaign for Senate in 2018, when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds – becoming the second woman senator in Nevada's history.
It's why you can _always_ count on me to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans. **But right now, I'm facing the fight of my life – and I need your help.**
**Republicans and dark money groups are spending $75 MILLION to unseat me and flip Nevada red. subject: Tomorrow is Election Day
body:
Make a plan to vote
| | |
---
|
---
| Tomorrow is Election Day! Get out and vote!
---
| Friends and Fellow Conservatives,
Ed "The Trucker" Durr here! Tomorrow is Election Day! We can worry about the gubernatorial election starting Wednesday. Before that I need you to do four things: 1. If you haven't already voted by mail or early go vote for Donald Trump and the ENTIRE Republican ticket tomorrow. 2. Take at least one like-minded neighbor who has not yet voted to the polls with you. If the line is long, you'll have company. 3. Make a plan! It is possible there will be a wait, there were long lines at polling places across New Jersey during early voting. Take a bottle of water, maybe a snack, be prepared. Polls are open from 6:00am - 8:00pm. 4. Be sure to vote the ENTIRE Republican column. As I have traveled the state I've heard grumbling, "This one isn't conservative enough" or "That one isn't Republican enough." We're past that point! Any Republican is BETTER than the alternative. Now we need to elect REPUBLICANS all the way down the ticket. Following those four steps above will help We the People deliver a mandate for President Trump to govern.
Conservatively yours, Ed The Trucker

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8105%2E5257348%2Et4fH6L ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, this
is Eve, Adam’s wife. And yes, it’s Adam and Eve — what can we say, it was
meant to be.

Tomorrow is Election Day, when voters across California will have the
chance to vote for the man I know and love deeply. And with your ongoing
support, I’m hopeful that my husband will become California’s next U.S.
Senator.

I’ve been lucky enough to be by Adam’s side through so many campaigns —
some that ended in sweet victory, and others that ended in defeat. Through
it all, Adam has remained committed to his values and his endless pursuit
of making a difference for the hard-working people of our state.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2024_abs_em.7WX_lH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241104_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=8105%2E5257348%2Et4fH6L ]Adam and his wife Eve

Us on the campaign trail... not TOO long ago...

Derek, I said
this about Adam when he launched his campaign for Senate last January:
Adam is a decent, moral person. What you see is what you get. He comes
across that way when you see him on TV, and that’s the way he is at home.
He is scrupulously honest — always following the letter of the law, doing
the right thing.

Which is why it so infuriates and upsets me when I see him villainized by
Donald Trump and by Fox News.

In recent weeks, Trump has turned up the volume and frequency of his
baseless attacks against Adam. He is pretty tough and has weathered the
storm well, but I’ll admit it — the viciousness of what he has endured
concerns me.

That’s why I’m hoping we can join together to vote against Donald Trump —
and vote for someone who will stand up for what’s right, no matter what.
That’s my husband, Adam.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=nov2024_abs_em.SALZ0e&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241104_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8105%2E5257348%2Et4fH6L ]Tomorrow is Election Day, the culmination of all our hard work. Before
then, I’m hoping you can pitch in to Adam’s campaign to boost the
last-minute efforts to turn out every voter we need to secure big wins
tomorrow.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

You can check your voter registration and find voting information, including a sample ballot, at Vote 411.org [https://www.vote411.org/] , a nonpartisan project of the League of Women Voters Education Fund.

I owe it to my stellar campaign team who have worked so hard, to my family who have made so many sacrifices to make this happen, and to my future constituents who deserve better representation to make sure we left everything out on the field when polls close on Tuesday at 7 pm.
Your support right now will get food and water to our volunteers who are greeting voters at the polls, pay for our field staff to knock doors on Election Day, and help get out every last vote we need to win this tight race and flip this seat: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pereles-for-mo-ad3?refcode=last-minute]

Now let’s go win this—because We Can Do Better .
- Joe

| Dear friend,
Election Day is TOMORROW! We need to finish this out strong and not leave anything out on the field. Rob had a very busy week and is sprinting through the finish line. Knock on those last doors, make those final phone calls, and send those last texts to all your friends, family, coworkers, and complete strangers to give NEPA the representation we deserve!
Below, is the list of all the drop-boxes and County Boards of Elections for you to drop off your mail-in ballot. **DO NOT PUT YOUR BALLOT IN THE MAIL TODAY.** It will not arrive in time. If you have not received your mail-in ballot, go to your County BOE and request an emergency reprint and fill it out on the spot. If you can’t make it, go to the polls and vote provisionally. If you cannot get to the polls, someone will pick you up and drive you to your polling place. If you’re in this predicament please reach out to me at (570)793-1487 or [**frank@robforpa.com**](mailto:frank@robforpa.com?subject=Ride%20to%20the%20Polls%20on%20Election%20Day&body=).

_We are less than one day away from Election Day (just 24 hours!), which means that not only does every hour matter, but every single minute within each hour matters a lot!_

I know it feels like this Election Cycle has lasted forever, but we are officially in the **FINAL MOMENTS.** We are in the endgame now - **[so we need everyone to pitch in.](http://links.harriganfornc.com/u/click?_t=687026f8d8f7415aa539c5385c376b1f&_m=3db38be2308e4f9fb39373198fa9fbe4&_e=UBC9qV-BJQ3GobCjrBfXLYFz8IoYaImkWEZ84Pi8OZfklVukX0rKUtuZ20G0vbPmKR_lBF13a28o_wwq9v1-8Gdefb2lAtPUshw90er3ISYfGTYwCS0FvgRq8dLk4_XGq0IdZ3_Anj22Vmy3Ui8LSk0y1ujKeQvxLlQAw4zkiwpdwjju_kEeLIZPWMZQnBLvkqUnPiO7kzdcP4lbpKX6SLPTS2Gvp1UBMp5Tv_mPxHbbRQnpkQyMKxKICptneKht5QIXSPHxDrrDsnvcwM-ITmR0NVCYwvUEu2PYZ4b31H7rLtkQni3knrh3lAZIB2WU-LreTeSi39nQUK_ARFKX3U0bdMn3GZnDqXghh1YZ2bE%3D)**

name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Shelby County Republican Party News, Nov 4, 2024
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

Tomorrow is the big day!

Here are a few things you can do to help us sprint through the finish line.

While we are confident President Trump will win Ohio, we need every possible down ticket vote we can get to secure the future of our state and our nation. Please get yourself and every conservative you know to the polls tomorrow. (Slate Card attached) The goals and objectives of the two parties have never been more opposite each other. Please vote straight Republican.

(1) Vote: Half of Shelby County Republicans have already voted, but that means we still have half to go.

(2) Get others to the polls: Attached is a list of Shelby County Republicans who have not voted yet. Please scan the list looking for people you recognize, and give them a reminder to get to the polls on Tuesday. Please consider offering them a ride if that might help. We need to get every possible person to vote!

(3) Consider deploying for a couple of hours throughout the day to a route that leads to a polling location as a display of support for Republican candidates. (Polling location list attached) Wave your flags and yard signs. Please don’t do anything to disrupt the flow of voters to the polls. Just find a legal spot on the way to, or in eyeshot of, a polling place and show your support for Republican candidates. I promise, in Shelby County you will get more joyful honks of support than various signs of disapproval. Have fun with this!

(4) Pray. For our poll workers! For our voters! For our candidates! For our elected officials! For our nation! And that God would be glorified in the midst of it all!

Our next monthly meeting is Tuesday, Nov 19th, at 6:00 pm at Calvary United Baptist Church, 9480 County Road 25A, Sidney. Please come join us for what we anticipate will be a tremendous time of celebration!!!

We’re almost there!

Cheers...Dan
(937) 206-2970
[cecilda.usaf@gmail.com](mailto:cecilda.usaf@gmail.com)

name: Sri Kulkarni
subject: Where things stand on election eve...
body:
What can we do in the last 36 hours?? | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f4d00dbd0207/the-best-hour-you-can-spend-in-the-last-7-days-not-money-not-cold-calls-6267841?e=b4b662832c)
---
| | | | |
# What can we do in the last 36 hours??

Hi ,
With the polls too close to call in all 7 swing states, anyone who says they know what’s going to happen tomorrow is just speculating. What we do know is what we have done and [what we can do](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=d475a89efd&e=b4b662832c).

**1) What we’ve done:** Over the past month, more than **2,000 volunteers** across the country have matched a total of **120,000 voters** (not counting the 160,000 voters matched in Wisconsin) to build a voter turnout network which will be tested tomorrow. We still have **20,000 voters** personally known to our volunteers across **6 swing states** within our network who have not yet voted. We are working furiously to turn them out today. (If you want to help with this effort, please reply to this email)

**2) What we still can do:** There is still time to find people in your own networks who haven’t voted. If you are not part of our existing 2,000 volunteers, join us on Reach today by downloading the app here [https://reach.vote/download](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=ccd2c7badb&e=b4b662832c) and using the campaign key **W6H4RT**. If you already have the app or want to use the web version, click here: [https://app.reach.vote/join/W6H4RT](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=4547160d9f&e=b4b662832c) Once you join Reach, you can _look up any voter in any swing state (plus Texas and Colorado) and see instantly whether they have voted or not_. If they haven’t, call them immediately and make sure they have a plan to vote!

**BONUS: COLLEGE CAMPUS TURNOUT PROGRAM**
If you have kids or relatives who are studying at a university right now, we have a special program for them, because 18-24 year olds are the least likely to vote. There are at least 200,000 students at these universities alone who have not yet voted, and they could swing the election away from Trump if we could reach them. Reach lets us do that. _We can automatically show any college student all their classmates who have not yet voted so they can reach out to them on Instagram, Discord, Tiktok etc. and make sure they know where to go tomorrow_. If you know students at any of the following universities, please contact us immediately: **Duke, UNC, ECU, Penn, Penn State, Temple, Drexel, Pitt, Michigan, Michigan State, University of Wisconsin, ASU, Arizona, or UNLV.** Please connect us with any students you know at these schools ASAP.

Once again, thank you all for all your support and hard work. We are close to the finish line. Let’s all pray hard and work hard for this last day and hopefully the right thing will happen tomorrow night.

Sincerely,

Sri

# Get Out the Vote for Rose!—and #KickLaMalfaOut
---
| Tell everyone you know about Rose’s priorities and why you support her: **your personal outreach is the most effective way to motivate people to vote**.
* **Reach out to 3, 5, 7 people who might not vote—as many as you can—and urge them to vote for Rose.**
* **Text, email and talk to your friends and family** about Rose’s campaign and their opportunity to kick LaMalfa out. Rose’s priorities are summarized here: [https://roseforcongress.com/priorities](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=f0caae198a&e=8c53948e4c)
* **Get on the phone. Knock on doors.** We’ll train and support you! Sign up on the [website](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=75fee4ac0b&e=8c53948e4c) or call Bruce McLean at 530-636-3609.

|
# Rose for Congress News
---
| **Rose and our campaign team have been **[**spreading the word**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=975290ea56&e=8c53948e4c)** across the North State about why a vote for Rose is a vote for all of us.**
---
[](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=d6f5920203&e=8c53948e4c)
|
# Share This Message From Rose
---
|
# WHY I’M RUNNING
I’m running to represent the North State in Congress because living in Redding for the past 10 years, I’ve seen how precarious many of our lives are—how many of us struggle to afford healthcare, to find living wage jobs, to get an education, and even to access clean drinking water.
I’m running because I’ve seen that Doug LaMalfa, who has represented this district for 10 years, is doing nothing to address these issues. In fact, he typically votes against legislation that would help our communities.
I’m running because for far too long, America’s abundance has flowed disproportionately to the wealthiest, the most powerful and the highly privileged. Well I say, no longer.
In the opening to the U.S. Constitution, the founders called out “promote the general welfare” as a primary aim. It’s time for Congress to return to that goal. That is why I’m running an anti-poverty, pro-family campaign that’s focused on bread-and-butter issues and seeks to create a community of care that unites us across differences.
In short, I’m running in pursuit of the common good.
---

body:
This is it—we are less than 34 hours away from the most important election of our lives. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/15daysremaining-8330016?e=3818d77efc)
---
|
# Hours Left—This Is It, We Need You!
---
|
This is it—we are**less than 34 hours** away from the most important election of our lives. Everything we’ve worked for comes down to these final hours, and I couldn’t be more inspired by the energy and support this campaign has built. We’re on the verge of something incredible, but I need you now more than ever to help us push through to victory!
We’ve got the momentum, we’ve got the passion, and we’ve got the people. But to flip this seat and make real change, we need to go all in. That means reaching every single voter before Election Day. This is our final opportunity to **knock doors, make calls** , and remind folks to turn in their ballots.
Here’s how you can help in these critical last 34 hours:
* Donate to fund our last-minute outreach. **$25** helps us reach an additional **500 voters** , and every dollar counts right now.

* **Volunteer** to knock on doors or make calls. This is the most direct and impactful way to make sure our supporters get out and vote.

This is the moment that will decide our future, and it’s up to all of us to make it happen. We’ve come too far to let up now. Can you pitch in **$25, $50, or whatever you can** to help us reach every last voter in these final hours?

---
[Donate Now](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=a8d7c8b221&e=3818d77efc)
|
If you can’t donate, I’d love to have you join me and our incredible team on the ground. Whether you’re knocking doors or making calls, your effort could be the key to turning out the votes we need. **Text our volunteer coordinator at 303.601.1821**
We’re so close to making history, but we need every bit of energy and effort in these last hours to win. Let’s go all in and give it everything we’ve got—together, we can do this!
Thank you for your unwavering support and commitment to our shared vision for the future.
In solidarity,
River Gassen
Democratic Candidate for U.S. Congress, Colorado - 5

P.S. **Less than 34 hours** —that’s all we have to flip this seat! Every donation and every hour you can spare to volunteer will make a difference. Please donate or sign up to help us knock doors and make calls!

The time has come to secure real tax relief for you and your family. Election Day is tomorrow, and Measure #4 is on the ballot... | | | | | |
---
[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=05458c3f4e&e=d842fb25cc)
| | | | | Peter,

Tomorrow is our last chance to secure the tax relief and reform North Dakota has been waiting for.

**Measure #4 is on the ballot, and with your vote, we can finally eliminate the unfair property tax system and put money back into the hands of hardworking North Dakotans.**

For years, our legislature promised tax relief but failed to deliver. Measure #4 brings a clear solution that benefits every North Dakotan by ending property taxes once and for all, while ensuring that our communities keep the resources they need. Together, we can achieve tax relief and a better future for North Dakota.

Here’s how:

✅ **A Plan for North Dakota** : North Dakota is uniquely positioned to implement this reform without raising taxes, cutting local funding, or losing essential services.

Lobbyists and special interest groups want YOU to keep paying more an more in property taxes...

Despite their opposition, we’ve consistently extended an invitation to debate this issue publicly so that North Dakotans can make an informed decision.

**Measure #4 is about empowering our communities and our citizens, not taking away from them**.

The time has come to secure real tax relief for you and your family. Election Day is tomorrow, and Measure #4 is on the ballot.

By voting **YES** , you’re voting to end the unfair property tax and allow our communities to thrive without the burden of property tax.

Together, we can achieve tax relief and a better future for North Dakota.

🗳️ Vote YES on Measure #4 tomorrow!

Let’s WIN!
