There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Are you ready to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110424_1&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Election Eve
body:
Who is going to win? What’s fascinating is that I’ve gotten reports of confidence from both sides. Both sides think that they’re going to win. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=fd1023cbae&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=37ab9beb20&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Hello, I hope that you are gearing up for Election Day. I voted early. What is going to happen on Tuesday? The first thing to know is that there’s a good chance we won’t know who won by the end of the night, so try to be patient. Who is going to win? What’s fascinating is that I’ve gotten reports of confidence from both sides. Both sides think that they’re going to win. The Republicans are in “who is going to take what job” mode. And Democrats who are looking at the early votes cast are confident that they’re going to pull it out, albeit narrowly. Their strategies are somewhat different. The Democrats are trying to get out their voters and leaning on field teams and organizers. It’s sensible given their monetary advantage. Republicans are reaching out to low propensity voters who are Trump-aligned but haven’t participated recently – hunters are one example. Trump won in 2016 largely by getting new voters to show up. You might think that well has been drained but the Republicans are testing it out again. “If the usual voters show up, the Democrats are confident they’re going to win. If new voters show up then Republicans think it’s going to be theirs,” is how one person put it. I was on CNN this week trying to prod the Harris campaign. I thought that Trump was going to win for quite a while – Kamala’s main path is to win Michigan, Wisconsin and Pennsylvania. The sunbelt states of Arizona, Nevada, Georgia and North Carolina seem to be slightly tougher terrain for her and better for Trump. I thought that passing up Joe Rogan was a missed opportunity, personally. It’s a massive audience that’s predominantly male – kind of a gold mine. The expectation is that the Republicans will win control of the Senate – they only need to pick up one seat aside from West Virginia – and the Democrats are slightly favored to win the House. In addition to the results that most people will be watching, I’ll of course be seeing how the Forward-endorsed [candidates](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5137ab6540&e=0f227c2ae3) fare as well as the ballot initiatives to open up the primaries across the country. This year I’ll be heading to Forward Party’s [Election Night](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a2fea5b5b2&e=0f227c2ae3) event in Philadelphia – it should be a phenomenal gathering. Will it be festive or funereal? We’ll all find out soon enough. As always, do what you can. If you’d like to donate to Forward so we can have better choices in our politics, click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=1e83c4d79f&e=0f227c2ae3). Try to keep a level head, we'll all still be here solving problems no matter how this week goes.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=36d21c3a45&e=0f227c2ae3)

**Tomorrow ➡️ Abortion is on the ballot.** **Abortion is on the ballot in ten U.S. states,** and we know that when people get to vote directly on abortion rights, abortion wins. Voters have sided in favor of abortion rights _seven times,_ in traditionally red and blue states alike. [**Tomorrow, abortion is on the ballot in Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Maryland, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New York, and South Dakota.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96540951/510332805/-766440161?sourceid=1150011&utm_campaign=25emkab-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=givingtuesday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmNhYzBiYS1jYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FSzWC1qutnDf0L6KjVcUic-1IFKHo23iUM1oY8x4nZU=&emci=3f6918ce-d197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1bcac0ba-ca9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237) We know abortion is a winning issue, but _ONLY if we show up,_ use our voices, and vote to protect reproductive rights.

[**Share this information with a friend or forward it to your family members and friends now.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96540953/510332809/-766440161?sourceid=1150011&utm_campaign=25emkab-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=givingtuesday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmNhYzBiYS1jYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FSzWC1qutnDf0L6KjVcUic-1IFKHo23iUM1oY8x4nZU=&emci=3f6918ce-d197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1bcac0ba-ca9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237) Make sure the people in your life know how critical their vote is tomorrow. | [**LEARN MORE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96540954/510332810/-766440161?sourceid=1150011&utm_campaign=25emkab-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=givingtuesday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmNhYzBiYS1jYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FSzWC1qutnDf0L6KjVcUic-1IFKHo23iUM1oY8x4nZU=&emci=3f6918ce-d197-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1bcac0ba-ca9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237 "LEARN MORE")

---
[70 YEARS OLD AND STILL HITTING THE GYM!](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=4)
Dear Peter,
The choice is yours.
We can choose to Make America Healthy Again, with a leader like Robert F. Kennedy, Jr....
...pictured here upside down...
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=5)
...and here after one of his afternoon workouts...
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=6)
Or you can vote to maintain the status quo, and keep folks like Admiral Rachel L. Levine in her position as the Assistant Secretary for Health for the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=7)
If you’re still undecided about which way to go, then consider the responses Mr. Kennedy received when someone posted his workout routine on social media. It caused quite a stir!
Here are a few of the comments....
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=8)
Sorry General...RFK, Jr. doesn’t want you to feel too bad about yourself!
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=9)
On behalf of RFK, Jr., thank you Zuby.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=10)
Patrick, be nice. We all know with a little exercise and healthy habits, anyone can get in shape!
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=11)
Yes RetirementUnity.com, that’s the goal!
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=12)
SMX, you’re right on. But we also have to deal with our toxic food ingredients!
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=13)
Philip, you probably should lay off the Duke’s Mayo. Just sayin’.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=14)
Why thank you stagnot. Keep it up!
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=15)
Thank you all, and Paladino, Mr. Kennedy has his eyes all over you. LOL.
It’s going to take all of us to Make America Healthy Again! Are you ready?
[Join our Make America Healthy Again movement today with your gift of $25, $35, $55 or more right now! ](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=16)
[America has a ton of workouts in front of her! ](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=macho_man_11_3_24_1&n=17)

USO Supporter,
As Veterans Day approaches, we are proud to introduce a special way to honor those who have selflessly defended our freedoms -- the USO Military Heroes Honor Wall.
This wall is a digital tribute space where you can share the stories, photos and memories of service members who have made a difference in your life. Whether you want to celebrate a loved one who served, memorialize someone who made the ultimate sacrifice or simply pay tribute to those who inspire you, this space is for you.
**That 's why we're reaching out to you today to ask: [Will you share your tribute now to show your support for our heroes ahead of Veterans Day?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/2dpGh-w37dJY/cHk0cjkxWUg5VnlKNCtGbkw3ZGRJN1puSTh0Um4wWVZWTU1kUFRsTWJPLzQ5OGN5T2RpRHRVQUZaMkFmN2xDVWJ3M3g3dDVBNDV0ZXQ4eDZtRHFjOXpNTHRId25KOURjYUtaMnNDOTY1SVU9S0/OUZtOFNSUnhSRHhkaFplelBMdVRzeStvVTI2QzJ0NENqUUlLa1oyTlJMTkVDMWVQN01zUGJjSDl1UUhIQmJVVjM4V0ZORmxQY3JoL2dGbXE4by92NW9XUkIrNlVwZll4S0)**

My opponent, Tim Sheehy, is a wealthy outsider handpicked by Mitch McConnell to defeat me. He wouldn’t give a second thought to defending Montana’s way of life. He wants to privatize health care, transfer off public lands, and supports a nationwide abortion ban because he just doesn’t get Montana.
But he’s got the weight of Mitch McConnell’s super PAC allies backing him, and they’re already spending _millions_ to try and turn me into something I’m not—because they know they can’t beat who I am.
So here’s the truth: **We’ve got a lot of work ahead of us, and we can’t afford to lose.**
I’m defending more than just my Senate seat. I’m defending the Montana way of life, where your word is your bond and a handshake still means something. Montanans deserve a senator who knows the unique challenges they face, and will always put them first in Washington.
Tim Sheehy doesn’t care about any of that. He just wants to turn this state into his personal playground for the rich, and if he wins, it’ll be hardworking families and rural communities that pay the price.
**We can’t let that happen, but protecting Montana's Senate seat will require a whole lot of grassroots support.**

name: David Pan
subject: Your Choice Between Two Visions for the Future
disclaimer_text: Paid for by David Pan for Congress 2024](https://eot
body:
Putting trust in the American people

| | | | | [](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/AL5aGPF2uPIqRbIdDsD1RQ~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpC4DjP0UgMTI5NzQyNTFjNGU4YWMwYjBmOGZmNWI2NmJkMDA0ZDJEImh0dHA6Ly93d3cuZGF2aWRwYW5mb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb21XBXNwY2V1QgpnDuP7KGfS9DeIUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABrnQ~~)
---
| | A few days ago, on October 28, my opponent announced on his website that “federal tax dollars return to Anaheim as part of nearly $15 million” that he was able to secure for local community projects in the 2024 federal budget. In this model of government, we send our money to Washington, and then our lawmakers work to get it back in the form of grants to local government and non-profit organizations. Those organizations then spend this money in ways that they think would be best for certain groups of people. My opponent’s main argument for staying in office is to participate in this tax and spend merry go round in which our money is taken by the federal government and then filters back down to us through programs designed by government. In this process, billions of dollars are lost along the way through fraud, waste, and poor government decision-making. But more importantly, the current system takes away our freedom to shape our own lives with our own money and gives this power to the federal government to manage our lives for us.

I believe that we as taxpayers are better off keeping this money so that we can spend it ourselves. Rather than continuing to fund a massive government bureaucracy, my plan is to phase out all our welfare and entitlement programs, which currently cost over $4 trillion per year, and return this money to the people as a universal basic income of $16,000 per year for every citizen 21 and over. Through our spending choices, we can then support the small businesses that can then provide the goods and services that we ourselves decide we need the most. Rather than the $15 million that my opponent brought back this year, my plan would bring back billions of dollars every year into the district directly into people’s pockets. Rather than guaranteeing federal government jobs, this money would support the local economy.

This year you have a choice between two fundamentally different visions for our future. While my opponent wants to continue to operate a system in which government takes our money and spends it for us, I want to dismantle this system so that the people themselves regain their freedom to make the fundamental decisions about how to manage their lives. Eliminating the fraud and waste of the current system, my plan would dismantle the entire massive bureaucracy that has been created with our tax dollars. Rather than forcing people through the complicated procedures of this bureaucracy to get a small slice of their money back, my plan returns this money to the people directly and simply, based on the principle of equality and the idea that we can trust people to know what to do with their own money.

In the end, our current bureaucratic system is based on a distrust in the ability of common citizens to make their own decisions. I believe in the American people, and that is why I trust them with the freedom and responsibility to shape their own lives and to build their own futures, as well as to care for themselves and for their families, their friends, and their neighbors. If you agree with me, please vote for me and add your voice to mine to start building this new future.

To the voters of the 46th congressional district, thank you for welcoming me into your homes and community events with warmth and encouragement. I am committed for the long term to your interests in lower taxes, school choice, more security on your streets and in your homes, and affordable groceries and a bountiful table for family meals. In short, I want to support your hopes and plans for your future.

I respectfully ask for your vote. It would be an honor to serve as your congressman.

You can find out more about my campaign and make a donation at [DavidPanforCongress.com](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/Cp62jzbEbUhXSoWUZeVMRg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpC4DjP0UgZWQwYjAxNzg3MWY4NWNhNmU4NzIzMWIwNWQ0ZGJmYzZEHmh0dHA6Ly9EYXZpZFBhbmZvckNvbmdyZXNzLmNvbVcFc3BjZXVCCmcO4_soZ9L0N4hSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAGud).

| Stand Up for Massachusetts: Your Vote Is Crucial!
---
---
| Tomorrow marks one of the most consequential elections in recent history--a pivotal chance to show the Democratic supermajority in Massachusetts that their unchecked policies come with consequences at the polls.
The Democratic supermajority's failure to address the migrant crisis has saddled taxpayers with over $1 billion in spending this fiscal year alone, with no end in sight. High taxes and heavy regulations under their leadership have driven businesses and families out of the state, fueling an exodus of residents from Massachusetts. Meanwhile, a disturbing lack of transparency on Beacon Hill keeps voters in the dark about how elected officials stand on key issues, hiding extensive spending on the migrant crisis and other pressing matters from public scrutiny.
Our Republican candidates are prepared to deliver real solutions to the issues that matter most to Massachusetts voters.

subject: Join Us for the Thank You Party!
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Gloria Witt for Congress
body:
As we stand on the eve of Election Day, I want to pause and thank each and every one of you. | | | It’s Your Party!
---
|
---
|
---
Dear Friends,As we stand on the eve of Election Day, I want to pause and thank each and every one of you. This campaign has truly been powered by people like you, reaching **hundreds of thousands of voters** across Virginia’s 5th District. Thanks to your incredible commitment, we’ve deployed a **quarter of a million dollars in paid media** , on TV, radio, digital, and in person. We’ve knocked on doors, dialed phones, sent out nearly 100,000 handwritten postcards, and filled mailboxes with our message of progress and unity.No matter what happens tomorrow, know this: **we have already won** in so many ways. With all your efforts, we’ve made this race competitive, **defying every expectation**. You’ve proven that grassroots power can stand up to entrenched interests and reach every corner of our district.So, I want to personally invite you to [**join us at the Official Thank You Party tomorrow evening**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6728ff22a0b24c377701f574&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fshare%2F1HY4hNMJ6E%2F&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_6728fa2ac47f3173a8e44b4e&l=en-US&s=17gDeiHUo9LBNn2P2voPcsIKtHs%3D). Let’s come together to celebrate all that we’ve achieved as we watch the results roll in. Your hard work, dedication, and support have been nothing short of inspiring, and it’s only fitting that we celebrate this night _together._ Thank you for standing by me, for believing in this campaign, and for working so tirelessly to bring our message to the people. [**Let’s keep this momentum through tomorrow!**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6728ff22a0b24c377701f574&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fgloria-witt-for-congress-1&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_6728fa2ac47f3173a8e44b4e&l=en-US&s=09G_fZOTH8zLeOhKsDFilDeM6ys%3D)
---
With determination,Gloria Witt

| We got an alarming polling update, Peter, and I wanted you to know: Eric Hovde has officially taken the lead for the first time in public polling — a new poll from Trafalgar shows me down by one point, 49-48. This moment has been building up for months. He and his Republican allies launched a $100 million ad blitz to close the polling gap and buy this seat, and they’ve never been closer to succeeding. I don’t mean to be alarmist, Peter, but we’re running out of time to fight back. Republicans are outspending us on the airwaves and all signs show my self-funding megamillionaire opponent surging. This incredible grassroots team has helped me defy the odds before, but I’m going to need more supporters chipping in and standing with me now than ever in order to defend this crucial Senate seat. [So, will you split an urgent donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign to help me close the polling gap to my right-wing opponent and win this toss up race? I conducted a very unscientific poll on my various social media platforms this weekend.
I asked of those planning to stay home, vote third party, vote for Trump, or not vote at all:

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..TDagWis59b9qSYNYqemu4QOy-oLhAkTlCMxQZGnWdvA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=151159286)
"If Kamala Harris came out tomorrow with a commitment to embargo /'Israel and join South Africa's case against them, would you change your vote to Harris?"
On Xitter, 66% said yes.
On Threads, 68% said yes.
More than 200,000 people saw that poll. Enough to change the results of the election tomorrow.
Across all of the various platforms, where I've amassed more than 750,000 followers, the average percent of non-Harris voters saying they would vote for her if she changed her position on Israel was 66%. Two-thirds.
_**This message is for that 66%.**_
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8eab3653-a2c3-4d97-a32f-06d8957dc5b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
What's happening in Gaza is morally sickening. I know that. I've [written about that ](https://substack.com/redirect/466495b2-facf-421f-b011-4ed7a3594757?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)extensively. The occupation of Palestine by white Europeans should have never happened and must be undone.
As much as you ache for justice in Palestine and Lebanon, you must remember that those aren't the only lives you're being asked to vote for next week.
Do not set aside the war in Ukraine, where Russian aggression will either fail or expand depending on the involvement of the United States.
When Russia annexed Crimea in 2014, more than 15,000 people died. Since the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, **[one million people have been killed.](https://substack.com/redirect/892de237-fec7-4c37-b6fe-5a57ad7ee323?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/892de237-fec7-4c37-b6fe-5a57ad7ee323?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Trump and his cronies, who are almost all known Russian assets, would abandon our allies and cede Ukraine to Putin, who will continue to expand his war across Europe and thrust us into a new world war.
There are lives at stake here at home, too.
In the time since Trump's supreme court overturned decades of precedent on Roe v Wade, [64,000 women and girls were impregnated by rape](https://substack.com/redirect/85d007a7-cc65-49ac-9fba-dc09ae00cc9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in states that have now banned abortion.
Women and girls [are already dying](https://substack.com/redirect/bdbe9f2d-60b9-4629-a947-bbe596b9e115?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of these oppressive laws, and the GOP wants to[ further restrict women's rights](https://substack.com/redirect/ec51fd7d-6b7f-400c-a287-46d167da1e73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by changing laws about marriage, divorce, and rape.
Jill Stein's VP recently[ declared he supports a federal abortion ban](https://substack.com/redirect/b60ce6cc-b889-4684-93ba-1aa65deb4bfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If you're supporting that, then you don't give a shit about women and girls.
Where is their justice if you don't vote?
Idaho recently [banned the COVID-19](https://substack.com/redirect/b6ee5da6-fa57-439d-bfef-b6cffb8775d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) vaccine in multiple counties. COVID-19 vaccines [saved](https://substack.com/redirect/ae103098-9747-463a-95d8-4452ed951a02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than 15 million lives during the pandemic.
Trump supporters, including RFK Jr, have already personally attacked and promised to hang Dr. Peter Hotez, who develops low and no-cost vaccines for the developing world. He's saved tens of millions of lives. He is my friend. He is a good man.
Trump has vowed to put [nut jobs like RFK JR](https://substack.com/redirect/0701f440-e909-4563-8164-c1cc2cbc1018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in charge of the CDC, filling our medical leadership positions with antivaxxers, killing hundreds of thousands to even [MILLIONS ](https://substack.com/redirect/7b23d110-dfcc-487d-a5c2-a9a8f207b43a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of people. Where is their justice? How is your non vote saving them?
[Trump has promised ](https://substack.com/redirect/7b23d110-dfcc-487d-a5c2-a9a8f207b43a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)\- and will almost assuredly see through - plans to forcibly remove MILLIONS of immigrants, some who have spent decades in the United stares working hard and paying taxes, raising families and building a better America.
Where is their justice if you vote for the guy who put kids in cages and passed a [Muslim and refugee ban](https://substack.com/redirect/da05fd93-88f7-48fe-8b5f-42aa9de1cf9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
If you're making your argument about climate change -- stop.
Jill Stein couldn't give a fuck about climate change. Maybe when she first started her political career she had noble ideals, but that was five, six, seven lost elections ago and now she cares more about expensive dinners and traveling the world on the dime of idiots than she does actually governing.
I'm a climate scientist. I'm voting for Harris. Because we MUST [stay in the Paris Agreement](https://substack.com/redirect/d057594e-763d-4661-9e9c-902b766e1a08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- which Trump [pulled us out](https://substack.com/redirect/79f20992-e866-40d1-b147-bf5efbfe921f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of once already.
We MUST continue to fund the sustainability initiatives in the Inflation Reduction Act, which trump has vowed to repeal.
Trump has even promised to dissolve the EPA, eliminate efficiency standards and[ get rid of NOAA](https://substack.com/redirect/b4a7a371-25cd-4af7-8b9e-cd658eee533a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- the agency that manages our country's weather and climate data. What happens when he destroys the National Weather Service? Do the lives lost there help Gazans??
If the only issue you are voting or NOT voting for is GAZA, which is pretty much the only position where Harris is dead wrong on, then you're saying the lives of all these other people don't matter. Women's lives don't matter. Immigrants lives don't matter.
And when they start rounding up people who criticize Trump, [as he's already said he'll do](https://substack.com/redirect/f4bee697-69f1-41e7-8253-2ae5ec2dd8af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), are you going to be on the front lines to becoming a martyr?
Because I've done that shit already and I will not be walking into the gulag because you felt comfortable enough in your own privilege to ignore the overt attacks on the civil rights of every person around you.
We are faced with difficult choices every single day. Sometimes the options aren't great, but you have to do what's best for the most amount of people.
Four years ago, I faced a pretty shitty choice.
Tell everyone that Florida is lying about Covid-19, end my career, put my family in danger, get arrested, my child arrested, being terrorized relentlessly for years...
Or say nothing. Keep my own family safe. Protect the career that I had crawled out of the swamps of poverty in Mississippi to make, keep my children from being traumatized.
I chose you. I chose your safety, your families.
Do not betray everyone who has fought this violent, fascist movement by sitting this one out.
Florida was the testing grounds for much of what Trump intends to do nationally.
A vote for anyone but Harris is a vote not only to condemn Palestine, but to condemn everyone here, too.
Unless you're ready to be a martyr or a refugee, help us save this country tomorrow so that we can fight to save Gaza on Wednesday.
Vote for Harris.
* * *
Because I know some will interpret this as me minimizing what's happening overseas:
There is no act more morally egregious than genocide, and I do not seek to minimize the injustice and evil committed against Palestinians in this post. There is more than just _that_ genocide on the ballot.

Election Day is tomorrow!

Tomorrow is the day all of our hard work has been leading up to, _and it’s time for each and every one of us to show up at the polls and cast a vote for progress._

What we do tomorrow matters – not just here but for our entire country. From the White House to the Senate to the House of Representatives, **voters everywhere will face a choice between progress and extremism, between democracy and dictatorship.**

Everything from reproductive freedom, economic stability, environmental protections, and access to quality, affordable healthcare will be on the ballot. We won’t mince words: In one way or another, our families, our neighbors, and our communities will be impacted by the outcome of tomorrow's election.

We also still have a few bills to pay to close out this election. I’ve put in every dollar and ounce of energy I can afford this year. | | | | | Thank you for all your support! Hi Pennsylvania, Election Day is TOMORROW, and we want to make sure you – and every Pennsylvanian you know – has what they need to cast a ballot because this may just be the closest election in commonwealth history. **Please forward this guide to your friends and family, share the links in your group texts, and make sure your community has what they need to make their voice heard!**
* * *
# 1\. Ways to vote in PA tomorrow
## If you received a mail-in ballot but haven't returned it yet...
**It is too late to return it by mail. **Completed mail-in ballots MUST be _received_ , not just postmarked, by the county elections office by 8:00 p.m. (ET) on Election Day. You have a few options to make sure your ballot is received on time and counted:
1. **Complete your mail-in ballot and submit it via a secure dropbox** or at your county elections office tomorrow (November 5th) before 8:00 p.m. You can find locations for both at [IWillVote.com/PA](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96547700/510355528/-1612268846?state=PA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjFiNjJlZC1kMjlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBCnl8v3wJGA6K24z_nJ2G4KBeim-pEXPtNRoaDDj20=&emci=01c4b44e-d29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=4f1b62ed-d29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=5643323). _You cannot return your completed ballot at your regular polling location._

2. **Bring your uncompleted mail-in ballot AND envelopes to your polling place tomorrow.** You will turn them in to an election official, and then you will vote in person. See below for details on voting in person.

3. **If you lost your mail-in ballot, you can vote in person tomorrow.** You will be given a provisional ballot, and election officials will confirm they never received your mail-in ballot. See below for details on voting in person.

## If you are voting in person...
Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET tomorrow (November 5th). Any voter in line at 8 p.m. must be permitted to vote but no other voters may join the line after 8 p.m. [Confirm your polling location at IWillVote.com/PA >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96547702/510355530/-1612268846?state=PA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjFiNjJlZC1kMjlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zBCnl8v3wJGA6K24z_nJ2G4KBeim-pEXPtNRoaDDj20=&emci=01c4b44e-d29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=4f1b62ed-d29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=5643323)
* * *
# 2\. Save This Phone Number
866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683)
While we don't expect most folks to have issues with voting in person tomorrow, should you or anyone you know need support, the Election Protection hotline has trained volunteers at the ready to help. Other language options:
* Spanish: 888-VE-Y-VOTA (888-839-8682)
* Arabic: 844-YALLA-US (844-925-5287)
* Bilingual assistance in Bengali, Cantonese, English, Hindi, Korean, Mandarin, Tagalog, Urdu or Vietnamese: 888-API-VOTE (888-274-8683)

* * *
That's it! Everything you and every other Pennsylvanian needs to make their voice heard in this critical election. Thanks for being a leader in your community who makes sure people turn out to vote! Team Ehasz 🚁

# What’s at Stake Tomorrow
---
|
Dear Friends,
This past weekend, I received the tremendous honor of being named Humanitarian of the Year by the Hospital Association of Southern California. While I am grateful for this recognition, it also reminded me of the significant work that remains in our healthcare system. As I accepted this award, I reflected on my humble beginnings in Pakistan and how America has enabled me to live a dream life, providing my family with opportunities I once could only imagine. This is why this election means so much to me.
Over the past two years, I have been deeply involved in this political journey and have dedicated the last four months to helping my friend Kamala Harris get elected. I want to ensure that America remains a beacon of hope, leaving our children with more opportunities and freedoms than we inherited. I’ll never forget Kamala’s visit to my home a few months ago; as she spoke with my daughter about her hopes for the future, I felt immense pride as a father, but I also worry about what another four years of Trump chaos would mean for my daughter's future.
As a doctor, I am equally concerned about what a second term of a radical Trump administration would mean for my patients and our healthcare system. I see firsthand the devastating impact of the current system on my patients' lives. Many struggle to access quality care, and chronic illnesses are on the rise, straining our economy. We need to support policies that enhance access to healthcare, protect women’s health and reproductive rights, and prioritize mental health care. By supporting Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party, we can build an equitable healthcare system for all Americans.
Please donate what you can to ensure the campaign finishes strong, and most importantly, make sure you vote. Let everyone in your network know who you support and why this election is so crucial.
Thank you for standing with us.In solidarity,

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | What’s at Stake Tomorrow | Dear Friends, This past weekend, I received the tremendous honor of being named Humanitarian of the Year by the Hospital Association of Southern California. While I am grateful for this recognition, it also reminded me of the significant work that remains in our healthcare system. As I accepted this award, I reflected on my humble beginnings in Pakistan and how America has enabled me to live a dream life, providing my family with opportunities I once could only imagine. This is why this election means so much to me. Over the past two years, I have been deeply involved in this political journey and have dedicated the last four months to helping my friend Kamala Harris get elected. I want to ensure that America remains a beacon of hope, leaving our children with more opportunities and freedoms than we inherited. I’ll never forget Kamala’s visit to my home a few months ago; as she spoke with my daughter about her hopes for the future, I felt immense pride as a father, but I also worry about what another four years of Trump chaos would mean for my daughter's future. As a doctor, I am equally concerned about what a second term of a radical Trump administration would mean for my patients and our healthcare system. I see firsthand the devastating impact of the current system on my patients' lives. Many struggle to access quality care, and chronic illnesses are on the rise, straining our economy. We need to support policies that enhance access to healthcare, protect women’s health and reproductive rights, and prioritize mental health care. By supporting Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party, we can build an equitable healthcare system for all Americans. Please donate what you can to ensure the campaign finishes strong, and most importantly, make sure you vote. Let everyone in your network know who you support and why this election is so crucial. Thank you for standing with us.In solidarity, Dr. Asif Mahmood | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Dr. Asif Mahmood. All rights reserved.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96548841/510359707/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwYzA0YzMtZDU5YS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oZ31erV_Zy0dwtiJehoqJADJXTGa1kFYuMmOUHbqTVw=&emci=e891e055-d29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=780c04c3-d59a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In the final days of the 2024 presidential election, Trump and his allies are spreading lies and conspiracies about the election, priming their supporters to distrust the results if Kamala Harris wins.
**The list is staggeringly long, but before we share it, we need a moment to ask for your help. **
With election lies spreading and polls closing in less than 48 hours, COURIER’s mission to fight right-wing misinformation is more important than ever. After the polls close and the results come in, we’ll still be here, publishing our fearless, factual coverage and combating the flood of misinformation that’s sure to follow.
[**Can you contribute $25 or more today to ensure our swing state newsrooms have the resources in this critical moment for democracy?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96548842/510359708/-260044646?refcode=20241104-EM-ElectionLies&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwYzA0YzMtZDU5YS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oZ31erV_Zy0dwtiJehoqJADJXTGa1kFYuMmOUHbqTVw=)
Alright, buckle up! Here are just a few of the most toxic election lies being spread by Trump and his allies on the far right:
* **Democrats are “importing” undocumented immigrants and getting them to vote for Harris:** Speaker Mike Johnson and Elon Musk spread lies on X that Democrats “want to turn illegal aliens” into voters, and that "the goal all along has been to import as many illegal voters as possible.” This is patently false – only U.S. citizens can vote.
* **Michigan has more registered voters than residents eligible to vote:** Elon Musk claims that Michigan has not purged its voter rolls, leading to a higher number of registered voters than eligible residents. Michigan Secretary of State Joselyn Benson shot these claims down and took Musk to task for “intentionally try to cast seeds of doubt in the minds of citizens about the sanctity of our elections.”
* **Haitian immigrants have voted several times in Georgia:** RNC members and Elon Musk spread fake videos of “Haitian immigrants” claiming they voted for Harris in several Georgia counties. The videos were actually Russian propaganda shared by “useful idiot” Republicans.
* **People are ripping up ballots cast for Trump in Pennsylvania:** The viral video was shared by right-wing influencers on X and was also debunked as a Russian.
* **Trump will only lose the election if it’s rigged:** Donald Trump has spread this lie at several of his rallies since the start of the campaign, with zero evidence to support the idea.
* **Democrats are focusing voter registration efforts on undocumented immigrants:** Trump has repeatedly said this lie at his rallies. Only citizens can vote in American elections.
* **Kamala Harris has secret information about how the election will turn out:** Trump suggested after Harris canceled rallies for television interviews that Harris “knows something we don’t” about the election.
* **Pennsylvania has received thousands of fraudulent ballots and voter registration applications:** Trump made this claim on Truth Social. Election officials in Pennsylvania have debunked the claim.

We’re only halfway through, but it should be clear why we urgently need your support. [**Please contribute $25 or more to help protect our democracy from this dangerous misinformation after Election Day.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96548844/510359710/-260044646?refcode=20241104-EM-ElectionLies&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgwYzA0YzMtZDU5YS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oZ31erV_Zy0dwtiJehoqJADJXTGa1kFYuMmOUHbqTVw=)
* **There was “unscrupulous behavior” in the 2020 election:** Trump still has not let go of his 2020 election loss and has promised retribution to those who “cheated.”
* **JD Vance: Trump did not lose in 2020:** After avoiding the question for months, VP pick JD Vance said he did not believe Trump lost in 2020, blaming “tech companies.” Dozens of court cases proved that the 2020 election was free and fair and that Trump’s lies were baseless.
* **Voting machines are unreliable and states should move to paper ballots:** Trump made this baseless claim on Joe Rogan’s podcast, and Rogan seemed to agree with Trump. Federal election guidelines recommend that jurisdictions use paper ballots, and 90% of jurisdictions already do.
* **Trump is going to win despite Democrats cheating:** Fox pundits and Trump himself are predicting a margin of victory so large that Democrats won’t be able to “cheat.” Polls show the race is neck and neck.
* **Touch screen voting machines in Kentucky are flipping votes:** Republicans claimed that voting machines are switching votes from Trump to Harris. Local election officials in Kentucky have refuted the claims.
* **Republicans should destroy voting machines “like the Boston tea party:”** For Trump official Mike Flynn called on Trump supporters to destroy Dominion voting machines in order to “stop the steal.” Dominion voting machines were shown to be secure in their lawsuit against Fox News.

Peter, this is just the tip of the iceberg. While these claims are easily dismissed as ridiculous, we’ve seen firsthand how destructive these lies can be to our democracy.
**It was this kind of misinformation that fueled the violence on January 6th, 2021.**
This is why COURIER exists. Election lies and conspiracies thrived on social media and in email inboxes in 2020. COURIER will work in those spaces after Election Day to correct the record and provide fact-based local news that keeps people informed.

Peter, the vote each of us casts this year will determine whether democracy and freedom will prevail. Whether as a country, we’re going to move forward or backward. Whether we’re going to choose hope or hate, unity or division. _It’s that simple_. I have long said that America is and always has been a nation of possibilities. Nowhere else in the world could a kid with a stutter and modest beginnings in Scranton, Pennsylvania, and Claymont, Delaware, grow up to sit behind the Resolute Desk in the Oval Office. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz understand that this nation must continue to be a place of possibilities -- not just for the few but for all of us. **[So, in the final days of this election, I hope you will join me in promising your whole heart to electing Kamala and Tim. Their team still needs to reach out to the millions of voters who will decide this election, and they’re counting on you to pitch in an hour or two to help.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241104_b16_jb_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-whs&t=2&akid=254%2E2563979%2EnPPG0r)** | | [VOLUNTEER TODAY](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241104_b16_jb_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-whs&t=3&akid=254%2E2563979%2EnPPG0r)
---
Asking Kamala to be my vice president was the best decision I made in my whole career. Over these last four years, we've not just gotten to know each other, we've become close friends. She's tough, she's experienced, and she has enormous integrity.
**She will be a president our children can look up to. A president we can all be proud of.**
But each of us has a part in the American story. We cannot do this alone.
So if you've already voted, I ask you to talk with your friends, family, and other folks in your community about the stakes of this election. Tell them what this moment in history means to you. Tell them their voice is just as powerful as yours. And tell them that you need them to make their voice heard, too.
**[Even a few conversations could make the difference on Election Day. You can use this link here to find ways to get involved and start talking to voters today.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241104_b16_jb_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-whs&t=4&akid=254%2E2563979%2EnPPG0r)**
There is nothing we cannot do when we do it together. Let’s win this,
Joe

| It's finally here, Georgia! Election Day begins in less than 24 hours, and here at Greater Georgia, we're contacting voters up until the VERY last minute - to remind them to make a plan, swamp the vote, and make it TOO BIG TO RIG for President Trump.
After years of organizing for this cycle, our GOTV operation has been in full swing for the last month. We've been hard at work targeting diverse communities and young Georgians. Over the last several weeks, we've also watched the early voting data closely, making real-time adjustments in our GOTV strategy to mobilize Republicans in key areas, including south and northwest Georgia. Through phone calls, text messages, postcards, and digital ads, we are working around the clock to push Republicans to the polls.
The great news is that the early voting period concluded with record turnout, driven by overwhelming enthusiasm in Republican counties. But we need to win Election Day, too, which is why we're asking every conservative to make a plan and SWAMP the vote tomorrow. | Earlier this month, Greater Georgia launched a get-out-the-vote (GOTV) campaign urging conservatives to vote for Donald Trump. The campaign, which includes digital ads, text messages, postcards, and phone calls, is targeting the same voters that Greater Georgia has been engaging for months - including minority voters, young voters, and newly registered voters. Greater Georgia is also investing to mobilize conservatives in the counties impacted by the devastation of Hurricane Helene, as well as voters in must-win northwest Georgia counties. | OTHER EVENTS Walton County GOP BBQ October 10, 2024 Greater Georgia attended the annual Walton County GOP BBQ, where Chairwoman Loeffler caught up with old friends, local elected officials, and law enforcement leaders. In her remarks, she called on Republicans to bank their votes and do their part to put President Trump back in the White House.

| Fulton County Republican Women Meeting October 9, 2024 At the Fulton County Republican Women's monthly meeting, Chairwoman Loeffler talked about the stakes of the 2024 election, and how women have the power to decide them. She also discussed Greater Georgia's voter registration efforts, and our campaign to oust Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis.

| Our America Hispanic Heritage Month Celebration October 7, 2024 Chairwoman Loeffler was invited to be the keynote speaker at Our America's Hispanic Heritage Month celebration at Versace Caribbean Restaurant in Lawrenceville. In her speech, she discussed the pivotal role Georgia's Hispanic community will play in the 2024 election, and spoke about the historic opportunity that the Hispanic community had under President Trump.

| Buckhead Young Republicans Phone Bank October 3, 2024 Greater Georgia joined the Buckhead Young Republicans for a phone bank ahead of the October 7th voter registration deadline - where volunteers, interns, and club members came together to call thousands of Georgians who weren't yet registered to vote. The effort was part of a final push to reach new voters, educating them about the importance of their vote and empowering them to make their voices heard.

| Visiting Valdosta and Augusta with President Trump September 30, 2024 President Trump was among the first on the ground after Hurricane Helene devastated our state, and Chairwoman Loeffler was proud to join him for his visits to Valdosta and Augusta. He brought aid, offered words of support, and raised over $8M to help the impacted communities - while the best Kamala Harris could offer Georgians was $750.

Election Day begins in less than 24 hours, and here at Greater Georgia, we're contacting voters up until the VERY last minute - to remind them to make a plan, swamp the vote, and make it TOO BIG TO RIG for President Trump. After years of organizing for this cycle, our GOTV operation has been in full swing for the last month. We've been hard at work targeting diverse communities and young Georgians. Over the last several weeks, we've also watched the early voting data closely, making real-time adjustments in our GOTV strategy to mobilize Republicans in key areas, including south and northwest Georgia. Through phone calls, text messages, postcards, and digital ads, we are working around the clock to push Republicans to the polls. The great news is that the early voting period concluded with record turnout, driven by overwhelming enthusiasm in Republican counties. But we need to win Election Day, too, which is why we're asking every conservative to make a plan and SWAMP the vote tomorrow. Click == to find your Election Day voting location - and help get President Trump over the finish line! | | | LATEST FROM GREATER GEORGIA Getting out the vote for President Trump | == | Earlier this month, Greater Georgia launched a get-out-the-vote (GOTV) campaign urging conservatives to vote for Donald Trump. The campaign, which includes digital ads, text messages, postcards, and phone calls, is targeting the same voters that Greater Georgia has been engaging for months - including minority voters, young voters, and newly registered voters. Greater Georgia is also investing to mobilize conservatives in the counties impacted by the devastation of Hurricane Helene, as well as voters in must-win northwest Georgia counties. Read more about the campaigns == and ==. | Exposing non-citizens on Georgia voter rolls | == | Also this month, Greater Georgia chairwoman Kelly Loeffler called on Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger to release the results of his non-citizen voter roll audit. Although the Secretary initially refused to do so, he finally released the results amid pressure from our organization. We learned that non-citizens did, in fact, successfully register and cast ballots in Georgia, although they have now been removed from the voter rolls. Read more about the effort and the findings of the non-citizen audit ==. | Chairwoman Loeffler serves as a statewide poll watcher | == | Chairwoman Loeffler also announced this month that she would be serving as a statewide poll watcher. Over the last few weeks, she has visited several early voting locations in DeKalb and Fulton Counties, where she watched early voting take place. She observed a smooth process - where laws were being followed and issues were being handled quickly and professionally. Watch Chairwoman Loeffler's full message on poll watching in DeKalb County ==, and Fulton County ==. | Chairwoman Loeffler campaigns for President Trump | | | | Chairwoman Loeffler has also been busy on the campaign trail for President Trump. She was honored to address audiences at three rallies this month, including one just yesterday in Macon. She also spent time campaigning with Lara Trump and the Women for Trump Coalition, and stopped in to visit with some incredible Trump Force 47 volunteers in Athens. Her message to Georgians has been simple: SWAMP the vote for President Trump! Watch a clip of Chairwoman Loeffler's rally remarks ==. | | | IN THE NEWS | == Chairwoman Loeffler appeared on Fox News last week to discuss Georgia's record-breaking early vote. She also explained how the 2024 election is different from 2020, pointing to Greater Georgia's work in registering more than 40,000 conservative voters and mobilizing diverse communities. You can watch the full interview ==. == | After finishing her shift as a poll watcher in Fulton County, Chairwoman Loeffler spoke to the media - emphasizing the strength of our election laws, which have made it easier to vote and hard to cheat. She encouraged Georgians to vote with confidence - knowing they have a team of poll watchers and attorneys on the ground who are upholding the law. You can watch a clip of her interview ==. | == | After casting her early vote for President Trump in Fulton County, Chairwoman Loeffler joined Georgia leaders for a press conference to discuss the importance of early voting. They also discussed how Greater Georgia and the Georgia GOP have worked tirelessly for the last four years to invest in election integrity, voter registration, and GOTV to avoid a repeat of 2020. Click == to view photos from the press conference. | == | == | Greater Georgia was also featured in several news articles this month. Click on the images above to read some of our other featured stories! | | | OTHER EVENTS Walton County GOP BBQ October 10, 2024 Greater Georgia attended the annual Walton County GOP BBQ, where Chairwoman Loeffler caught up with old friends, local elected officials, and law enforcement leaders. In her remarks, she called on Republicans to bank their votes and do their part to put President Trump back in the White House. | | | UGA College Republicans Meeting October 9, 2024 Chairwoman Loeffler was excited to speak with the University of Georgia College Republicans, where she took student questions and reminded them about the power they have in this upcoming election - to vote for President Trump, for their own futures, and to save the American Dream. | | | Fulton County Republican Women Meeting October 9, 2024 At the Fulton County Republican Women's monthly meeting, Chairwoman Loeffler talked about the stakes of the 2024 election, and how women have the power to decide them. She also discussed Greater Georgia's voter registration efforts, and our campaign to oust Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis. | | | Our America Hispanic Heritage Month Celebration October 7, 2024 Chairwoman Loeffler was invited to be the keynote speaker at Our America's Hispanic Heritage Month celebration at Versace Caribbean Restaurant in Lawrenceville. In her speech, she discussed the pivotal role Georgia's Hispanic community will play in the 2024 election, and spoke about the historic opportunity that the Hispanic community had under President Trump. | | | | Buckhead Young Republicans Phone Bank October 3, 2024 Greater Georgia joined the Buckhead Young Republicans for a phone bank ahead of the October 7th voter registration deadline - where volunteers, interns, and club members came together to call thousands of Georgians who weren't yet registered to vote. The effort was part of a final push to reach new voters, educating them about the importance of their vote and empowering them to make their voices heard. | | | | Visiting Valdosta and Augusta with President Trump September 30, 2024 President Trump was among the first on the ground after Hurricane Helene devastated our state, and Chairwoman Loeffler was proud to join him for his visits to Valdosta and Augusta. He brought aid, offered words of support, and raised over $8M to help the impacted communities - while the best Kamala Harris could offer Georgians was $750. | | | | | | | | | GET INVOLVED Greater Georgia's work is critical to defending conservative values, and it is only possible through the hard work and support of strong, grassroots volunteers. # [Choose Democracy](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2024%2F11%2F04%2Fchoose-democracy%2F%3Fjetpack_skip_subscription_popup&sr=0&signature=0ac864aa62d8003938aa6e51013ba3b5&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| | By **Elizabeth Farnham** on November 4, 2024
---|---
On Tuesday, November 5th, 2024, America will either vote for Democracy or Authoritarian Rule.
There is no other choice.
Every sacrifice that veterans of the Armed Services of the United States ever made will either be validated or mocked.
Every right that American Women have ever fought for will either be expanded or denied.
Every form of equality that Civil Rights marchers worked for will either be vindicated or eradicated.
Every historical Truth that public school educators ever taught will either be promoted or buried.
Every national secret will either be protected or exploited.
Every benefit any Unionized worker ever battled for will either be asserted or withdrawn.
Every measure of Gun Safety that caring citizens ever enshrined into law will either be enforced or forsaken.
Everything is on the line.
Because it’s not just about Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Gun Safety, Public Education, Universal Healthcare, or Immigration Reform.
It’s about our very lives.
Do we live in Freedom to elect our leaders, to create the families we choose, to maintain the families we create, to learn objective Truth, to receive healthcare, or to welcome the stranger?
Or do we perish under a petty tyrant, denied love, our children slaughtered by rampant gun violence, suffering lies upon lies, denied healthcare, and demonizing immigrants?
The choice is ours. Yours.
Vice President Kamala Harris is competent, caring, committed, educated, experienced and has America’s best interests at heart. I absolutely support her.
Convicted felon Trump only cares about himself. My opponent only supports him.
I have already voted.
I implore you to do the same.
Please vote for:
Vice President Kamala Harris for President of the United States - [https://kamalaharris.com/](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.wordpress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=9bd2b95470e8ad7e72d6d1c2389b3f23e32025348660f6ee9882b234d0b9c670&blog_id=213069660&post_id=788&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=f9222d1fb7d7fda33302b1aa7180360d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9iZXRoZmFybmhhbWZvcmNvbmdyZXNzLnVzMTIubGlzdC1tYW5hZ2UuY29tL3RyYWNrL2NsaWNrP3U9ZmI3ZTc4NzcxOTc0ODQyMmJhNzc5YTlmMyZpZD01OTVkMGNkMzRhJmU9MDZlZWM1MmUzYw=)

| | It would be fair to wonder why someone would want to be in Congress. **For me, it is simple: we have made great progress but there is still more work to be done for you.** Representing Washington's 2nd District is one of the greatest privileges of my life. Together, we have made remarkable progress for our community — from 1 million Washingtonians being insured under the Affordable Care Act, to bringing millions of dollars to the state to rebuild and advance our infrastructure. Our work is paying off. **I am asking for your vote because together, we can accomplish even more for Northwest Washington.** Some of my top priorities for next term include:
* **Protecting reproductive freedom:** Abortion rights are under attack with attempts to ban medications, close clinics, and even criminalize patients who have sought care out of state.
* **Lowering prescription drug prices and ensuring access to health care:** I believe health care is a right and I support universal coverage, but even with good insurance the costs are too high. For years drug companies have tried to block competitive pricing. We recently passed landmark legislation that allows Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices, caps out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors, and caps insulin copays at $35 per month for Medicare enrollees, all while cutting the deficit by $300 billion.
* **Supporting our veterans:** I worked to pass a bipartisan extension of a transportation program helping veterans travel to see their doctors, improving access to care for those living in remote communities. I am going to continue pushing legislation that will provide veterans with job skills training, give business owners a tax credit to hire veterans of the Iraq and Afghanistan wars, and help get more homeless veterans into permanent housing.
* **Improving affordability:** We must raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour by 2025. This simple step would give 32 million workers a raise and lift over a million people out of poverty. We need reinvestments in career and technical education and training so that our students and workers are trained for good, family-supporting careers like ones in aviation, manufacturing, and engineering.

These issues along with many others – like protecting our democracy, tackling the climate crisis, and getting fentanyl off our streets – make a real, tangible difference for you and your families. **That is what is at stake in this election. I hope you will join me in voting our values by Tuesday, November 5th:**

clean_body: Making a real, tangible difference in my community. | | | | It would be fair to wonder why someone would want to be in Congress. For me, it is simple: we have made great progress but there is still more work to be done for you. Representing Washington's 2nd District is one of the greatest privileges of my life. Together, we have made remarkable progress for our community — from 1 million Washingtonians being insured under the Affordable Care Act, to bringing millions of dollars to the state to rebuild and advance our infrastructure. Our work is paying off. I am asking for your vote because together, we can accomplish even more for Northwest Washington. Some of my top priorities for next term include: Protecting reproductive freedom: Abortion rights are under attack with attempts to ban medications, close clinics, and even criminalize patients who have sought care out of state. Lowering prescription drug prices and ensuring access to health care: I believe health care is a right and I support universal coverage, but even with good insurance the costs are too high. For years drug companies have tried to block competitive pricing. We recently passed landmark legislation that allows Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices, caps out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors, and caps insulin copays at $35 per month for Medicare enrollees, all while cutting the deficit by $300 billion. Supporting our veterans: I worked to pass a bipartisan extension of a transportation program helping veterans travel to see their doctors, improving access to care for those living in remote communities. I am going to continue pushing legislation that will provide veterans with job skills training, give business owners a tax credit to hire veterans of the Iraq and Afghanistan wars, and help get more homeless veterans into permanent housing. Improving affordability: We must raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour by 2025. This simple step would give 32 million workers a raise and lift over a million people out of poverty. We need reinvestments in career and technical education and training so that our students and workers are trained for good, family-supporting careers like ones in aviation, manufacturing, and engineering. These issues along with many others – like protecting our democracy, tackling the climate crisis, and getting fentanyl off our streets – make a real, tangible difference for you and your families. That is what is at stake in this election. I hope you will join me in voting our values by Tuesday, November 5th: You can still register to vote in person during business hours and any time before 8:00 p.m. on Election Day. You can either return your signed ballot via U.S.P.S. mail(no stamp needed) or at a dropbox. Ballots postmarked by Election Day will be counted. You can still vote in person. In-person services and accessible voting devices are available through your local elections office or voting center until 8:00 P.M. on Election Day. | | Peter,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _just around the corner_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. Hi friends – before the big day that we’ve all been waiting for arrives, I want to take a minute to share with you some of what I’ve heard out on the campaign trail over the past year.

I’m so excited to elect Kamala Harris.
I’m so anxious about our future.
I want to protect democracy.
I’m doing this for my daughter.
I’m doing this for my mom.

I feel all these same feelings, and I feel honored that people share them with me. And as we head into the most important Election Day of our lifetimes, I have one request for you: channel those feelings into one last bit of action before polls close tomorrow.
Call a friend. Text a neighbor. Message a high school friend on social media. Join a virtual phone bank. Whatever it is, do something that helps get us across the finish line. [https://go.kamalaharris.com/]

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96552788/510373154/1610638071?refcode=em20241104mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=9fdaaecb-da9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmRhYWVjYi1kYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bKjj_FMQNqzFyQ6ya5DIa2wJ9NeJ5kOQUaMLNLHA6n8=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

Our race was the closest in the country, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96552794/510373159/1610638071?refcode=em20241104mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=9fdaaecb-da9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmRhYWVjYi1kYTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bKjj_FMQNqzFyQ6ya5DIa2wJ9NeJ5kOQUaMLNLHA6n8=)

### [Judicial Watch sues Oregon to force state to remove ineligible voters from voter rolls ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70954&L=33762&F=H&&hash=e15440402ce22cedd0d19e915ca506c3be13bf93f1a9ab6e51268c9184282d86) Just the News Conservative watchdog Judicial Watch on Wednesday announced a lawsuit against the state of Oregon, that would force it to remove ineligible voters from its voter rolls, as mandated by the National Voter Registration Act.

The voting act requires states to make a “reasonable effort” to remove voters who have either died or changed residences from their voter rolls. The voters are removed if they fail to respond to address confirmation notices, and do not vote in two consecutive federal general elections. name: John Avlon
subject: RE: Action is the Antidote to Anxiety
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030]
Friends,
We are just hours away from the most consequential election of our lifetime.
The stakes could not be higher for our country or our community.
The choice is stark: not just at the top of the ticket but here in New York’s First District. There are times in our history where a generation is called to step up and defend American democracy. This is one of those times.
And history is made by determined optimists, happy warriors who work together to overcome tough times and build a better future.
These next days offer us the opportunity to make sure that we hand America to the next generation better than it was handed to us. I know many of you are anxious. But take it from me: the best antidote is action.
How do we see things on the ground? You probably saw my campaign manager Bryan's note. I'm so proud of the infrastructure we've built and the energy we are seeing across the district.
We’re seeing record turnout in Suffolk County and across America. From everything I'm seeing, voters are energized. They know the stakes. They're doing what they can.
But in these last 24-plus hours (hours!), we need to do more.
If you haven't yet - you can still help us make a huge difference.
Volunteer to knock on doors, phone or text. [https://www.mobilize.us/nysdems/event/715622/?referring_vol=6598131&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=SharerRole.ORGANIZER]
We need to earn this victory and it could come down to just a few thousand votes.
What we know is that our vote matters here in NY-01. We could determine whether Democrats retake the House.
And regardless of who wins the presidency, the House is going to decide so much. If Kamala Harris wins, we can do so much together to rebuild the middle - starting by taking direct action on affordability. Restoring the state and local tax credit. Making it less expensive to have kids and buy a house. And of course, protecting reproductive freedoms nationwide.
But if, God forbid, Donald Trump wins the White House, a Democratic House is essential to the defense of American democracy. We can't afford to give him a rubber stamp.
We're seeing real energy here up and down the ticket. In these closing hours, I'm reminded just what "happy warriors" can really do. Campaigning with energy, courage, and joy.
Thank you for being with me on this journey, and of course for fighting the good fight with me.
-John
PS: Our field program is the best in the state and among the best in the country. We are still expanding it to get every last vote. If you can pitch in now, it really still does make a difference - allowing us to contact more voters and get out more votes. Please consider contributing, one last time. clean_body: Please give us a chance to try: | | | We are writing to ask -- humbly -- if there is anything at all we can say to convince you to make your first contribution to Kamala Harris's campaign before midnight tonight. Please give us a chance to try: What if we told you that as you read this, we are getting outspent and attacked in several key battleground states? What if we told you that if we were able to increase our budget by just a bit, we’d be able to reach and turn out a lot of persuadable Democrats who don't vote frequently -- and that that could be the margin of victory? And what if we told you that if everyone reading this email contributed even $10, we'd have the resources we need to win this race? Unfortunately, not everyone gives. So, Vice President Harris is counting on people who understand the stakes of this race to step up today. Yes, today. Fellow American - Election Day is TOMORROW, and your vote makes a difference. _Much of America has already voted, and many folks are headed to the polls tomorrow!_

Ensure you have a plan to vote and encourage your friends, families, and colleagues to get out and exercise their right to vote!

* * *

[](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=eebd78772498417eb7fbd15de0cf2b1a&_e=vvEFh1A7yFiD515slaWIHsimgKQDFwQeoXBz2pHlOfQtkJ6RVI1NmpCyUpQsavDvfW7PUNyn6pxu-NzRdcut2l6txMGH-zBQmHnJ3do3jxZA-t6fGpFx7qHAr3Jj59i38UBnLxUigB73fpZvxekEgNVVSARzY7VQRrNLZPGhopB5KeLgCAFIi6hBkR1uR58XvlGdg5EVofohWf8Ugcr53SITAS7ShxAQMX0hkiyCgIajAsrBHxwbIXtnoAFaWu6SltPCTMNSRU-Qci6h1zyi12MraFtfvp_xe0poz07KAB9Z4xkptRFjXFFuNHhqYt5CF8dytnnsVGOH05tozcEzJcfPFY7Zno8UUcAzx8Bg6rvkqYBgLHBGPbZoKe9OYaou6T6it_C-hULGnYzMGgC0tA%3D%3D)
