| | Dear Fellow American,

I want to share with you a free video that explains the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution and how it works today.

[**It 's called "The Electoral College Explained."**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=704521d698d24b4fb32fa7debecc0680&_e=zi9KJeC1oymPUp02klNAoz-vuYdqGDXtC420mdp0t17rzlVDGVj_d4H9CbafF7VQHRO_snyoY_YaIlMHHLKATLt7wxe3hwetV4n_2ajKca5itojkdqWIoemMc9uBYksHJn97hX5Pl72hKWMkV5GknvpL3QmOIO72ZH2G2uM-Qe_eNbU0spkJ1xNKQYRq_TV3vCEBygTer-wx02pSm3QoRl8uCX1IRgUwINMjP3qF10TI02aZMPV-r-Ss0WIWOD1f9KksA-xjMwQtOI-UHqsyYcD2JDSY8l48mMdt_qNuQCSj_U2oz4jh3n1BH4oyNh_ZbEK4gR_C6h2J8rq8rRlMY6mdM4LwrI7JNRo9kebpPARfUJjP_rr11UDexDSaRMJLipFPaSBlYfKQEx0scVdSrQ%3D%3D)

[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=704521d698d24b4fb32fa7debecc0680&_e=zi9KJeC1oymPUp02klNAoz-vuYdqGDXtC420mdp0t17rzlVDGVj_d4H9CbafF7VQHRO_snyoY_YaIlMHHLKATLt7wxe3hwetV4n_2ajKca5itojkdqWIoemMc9uBYksHJn97hX5Pl72hKWMkV5GknvpL3QmOIO72ZH2G2uM-Qe_eNbU0spkJ1xNKQYRq_TV3vCEBygTer-wx02pSm3QoRl8uCX1IRgUwINMjP3qF10TI02aZMPV-r-Ss0WIWOD1fRevkDLpOUmHExnkrvWDqASnJx7jcDDSPXBtUuJiZGjDFG25C6uGj5HUXSpMSDMm2AIL67O1I43KBYQTLaeys8MIqz-96c_g-jaHuusVQL_2npqebD3AzjEK1asNVPSYCbhkdQLEYKuvgoPnuVs3Log%3D%3D)
Most Americans need to understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government.

But after you watch this video, you'll learn...
* Why the American Founders created the Electoral College and how the two-party system changes the way it functions

* How the Electoral College prevents political campaigns from focusing only on urban--and not rural--voters; and

* What presidential elections would look like without the Electoral College and how the national popular vote could lead to a _decrease_ in election integrity.

As you can see, this free twelve-minute video taught by Hillsdale College politics professor Kevin Portteus is packed with critical information so many Americans don't know--even patriotic Americans who love this country.

They may understand that the Electoral College is important but can't explain why.

**It 's not their fault. **

Too many schools nationwide have abandoned teaching about these important constitutional principles in favor of critical race theory, transgender ideology, or whatever Marxist ideology they dress up in some new "woke" lingo.

**But it 's _never_ too late to learn. **

After watching "The Electoral College Explained," one viewer commented on YouTube, _" This makes so much more sense now. Thanks!"_

**Here 's a link to watch the video.**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-video**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=704521d698d24b4fb32fa7debecc0680&_e=zi9KJeC1oymPUp02klNAoz-vuYdqGDXtC420mdp0t17rzlVDGVj_d4H9CbafF7VQHRO_snyoY_YaIlMHHLKATLt7wxe3hwetV4n_2ajKca5itojkdqWIoemMc9uBYksHJn97hX5Pl72hKWMkV5GknvpL3QmOIO72ZH2G2uM-Qe_eNbU0spkJ1xNKQYRq_TV3vCEBygTer-wx02pSm3QoRl8uCX1IRgUwINMjP3qF10TI02aZMPV-r-Ss0WIWOD1fVLFBytELeJx9CHJK0fjENcgGnV5YgsudJ-9YEYFatuu3M6U04Hq0P6SvvfvNcwJ0iJlxiuHiD0o03jkikyZaMcHoFEcARDTUaOFr2pxa4PLaX1pU_x5-zXdUK5IhZmGMzYHxTVETvol_3avSFZob5A%3D%3D)

When you watch, you're guaranteed to understand everything we stand to lose if we replace the Electoral College with a national popular vote.

And when the far-Left works to keep Americans ignorant of our institutions--and why they are important--your willingness to learn is one ESSENTIAL way you'll fight for our country on the battlefield of education.

Thank you.

Warm regards,

Labin Duke, Th.M.
Associate Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

Democrats should be FREAKING OUT about Nevada, team!!

Then, early voting numbers showed that **Republicans are absolutely dominating in Nevada** – the state that experts predict will decide not just the Senate but the White House, too!

**Now, the Senate Leadership Fund – the top GOP super PAC for Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans – just BLINDSIDED us with a last-minute, $6.2 MILLION investment in Nevada to pummel Jacky with attack ads every second between now and Election Day. **

Tomorrow is Election Day, Peter.

While we wish we had more progressive options on the ballot this year and

countless seats in state and local office. It’s crucial that we elect as
many new progressive candidates and re-elect as many of our Justice
Democrats incumbents as possible, including Representatives AOC, Rashida
Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Summer Lee, Delia Ramirez, Ayanna Pressley, Greg Casar,
Pramila Jayapal, Ro Khanna, and Raúl Grijalva.

first and fight for the bold, progressive change our communities and
country deserve.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Joe Kent
subject: Do you know what GOTV means?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_
body:
Friend, GOTV is one of the most critical parts of any campaign. It stands for "Get Out The Vote," and right now, campaigns across the country are ramping up their GOTV efforts. My campaign is no exception. We have dedicated volunteers making calls and knocking on doors, and I'm proud to be right there on the front lines with them. Unfortunately, much of my district is rural, and there are a lot of doors we won't be able to reach before time runs out. Fortunately, we have MMS messages and paid phone operations working hard to reach Republicans throughout the district, reminding them to vote. Will you make a special donation to help fund this operation at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/AsFwIU763763AbVT7VWXkyoZuw/cgeBNCGQyruV9M444FRtFQ)? It's too late for additional TV or radio ads, and it's too late for mail to reach voters by Election Day. But with your help, we can still reach them through texts and live calls. I know you understand how important this race is. It's not only about defeating a radical, left-wing Democrat--it's about making sure Republicans keep control of Congress so President Trump's agenda has a chance to succeed. If I don't flip this seat, it's highly likely that Democrats will take control of the U.S. House. That means "47" could spend the first two years of his presidency bogged down in obstruction, investigations, and impeachment hearings. They may even refuse to certify his election. We can't let that happen. Please support my final GOTV push with a last-minute contribution at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/9h3QlB8RsAMAC5Y1awEVgQ/cgeBNCGQyruV9M444FRtFQ). Respectfully, Joe Kent [](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/eQoEhXBVsWij75uUuAIHng/cgeBNCGQyruV9M444FRtFQ) _Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_

When I first announced my candidacy for re-election to the U.S. Senate, I had a strong faith that we’d be successful — not because of any poll, but because my life experiences have taught me that Virginians are stand-up people, not tear-down people.
In good times and bad, Virginians are not mean-spirited, pessimistic, name-calling complainers. We are upbeat, can-do, roll-up-our-sleeves, and get-the-job-done people.
We stand up for what’s right. And most importantly, we stand up for each other.
That’s what I’ve tried my very best to do in my career in the U.S. Senate, as mayor of Richmond, and as Governor of our great Commonwealth. And if you’re willing to help me out on this final day of campaigning, it’s what I’ll continue to do as your U.S. Senator in 2025 and beyond.
With just one day left to get out the vote, I need to ask for your support: Will you pitch in a few bucks to help me reach every single Democrat across our Commonwealth and get them to the polls? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

I believe we’re going to win tomorrow. I believe the people of Virginia will help send Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House. And I believe our Commonwealth and our country’s best days are ahead of us—because of you.
Thank you for your support,
Tim Kaine

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan has abandoned everyday people
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Tomorrow is election day and it’s time for a reality check – Jim Jordan’s record in Congress is as disastrous as you’d expect from someone who’s spent 17 years doing absolutely nothing to serve our community.
Let’s take a little trip down memory lane, shall we?
Jim Jordan voted against capping the price of life-saving prescriptions. Because helping seniors and families afford their meds is just too much to ask, right?

He’s voted against every single Farm Bill. Yes, every. Single. One. So much for supporting the backbone of Ohio’s rural communities.

Jordan voted against the PACT Act – a bill designed to provide healthcare for veterans exposed to toxic substances while serving our country. Imagine turning your back on the very people who’ve risked their lives for our freedoms.

He’s also consistently voted against funding for education, which hurts not just students and teachers, but the future of our entire state.

And let’s not forget his “no” votes on extending protections under the Americans with Disabilities Act, essentially telling disabled people they’re on their own.

Jordan has opposed reproductive rights, joining efforts to strip away the basic freedoms women deserve to make choices about their own bodies.
To be honest – Jim Jordan has voted against everyday people 97% of the time so much over the last 17 years that the first draft of this email read more like a book so we cut it down to just give you the highlights.
Will you chip in $25, $50, or more to help us make our final push and make sure every voter knows Jordan’s real record? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_votes_against_link1]
Meanwhile, what has he focused on?
Sham investigations, grandstanding for the far-right, and cozying up to MAGA billionaires who couldn’t care less about Ohioans.
Now, let’s talk about us .
We’re building a campaign centered around real solutions—not noise.
I’ve met with community leaders, veterans, teachers, farmers, and everyday Ohioans who are tired of being ignored by someone who only shows up for Fox News.
We’re working on initiatives that bring jobs to the district, lower prescription costs, and protect Social Security and Medicare from extremist cuts.
Unlike Jim Jordan, I believe in representing all of Ohio’s people, not just wealthy donors.
I’m fighting for a future where our seniors, veterans, and working people don’t have to wonder if their representative has their back—because they know I do.
This is our chance to show that we’re not going to settle for complacency or chaos any longer.
We need you to r ush a contribution now so we can amplify our message by getting that OSU ad up on TV in front of more voters. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241104_jordan_votes_against_link2]
Let’s do this!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Dear Peter,
With one day left before Election Day, our MAHA movement needs your help to share one or more **“MAHA Voices”** videos with other Kennedy supporters who may need some gentle inspiration to vote for President Trump.
Visit [**this website**](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=b1WCR8DlBNFCtbdtyo4SWMHOIOAWEgsQ7QoTUwEMNwXIZ2gFlvXCxO5xZ7DVqUaKR6x3NuabMnxPCgNDiTj3RF6UpBBQuk1CV4p_av2I6QMwGuI06U82eoeE1srGREWY&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maha_voices_11_4_24&n=5) to view and download your favorite **“MAHA Voices”** videos and share them on your social media channels. You can also [**visit the MAHA Voices X page**](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=p3aueJUqNTtbnW_9W72RDCPxX3gbtR4z1id0iwm7IW8dIlglMLxxU1RNhhABU4FxTBE9zzacSCCeWBxBDQg28Fx8A-yIrNAejEF9p4eNs5pQ56YBwmRbXTeOqCt9IwvT&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maha_voices_11_4_24&n=6) @MAHA_Voices to quote tweet or retweet these videos.
**What is MAHA Voices?**
The Make America Healthy Again Voices video series is 10+ video stories of Kennedy supporters who now support President Trump. The storytellers come from many walks of life — including former diehard Democrats with Trump Derangement Syndrome, former Independent Never Trumpers, younger and older people, Caucasian, Black, Asian, and Hispanic people, immigrant and U.S.-born citizens, men and women.

# November 4, 2024
---
| Election Interference - It's Real!
---
| What a campaign this has been - and thank you so much for your support!
As we come to the end of our 2024 campaign, my team planned one final blitz of texts with a message about gangsters running freely in our country. This text message would include a picture with a link to an article about these gangs that have been ushered into our country by my opponent's party.
When our tech guru tested the text messages, he found that our website had been reported as SPAM, so that the enclosed link wouldn't work. Now who would have reported our website as spam???
Blatant election interference?
This on top of a political operative grabbing the website peterhernandezforcongress.com, and redirecting anyone who visits that website URL to an ActBlue donation site for Lofgren!
---
| | [](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018AtF4r0Xxjeb9gI45xg5Qh9LmLyWZABuZnA2zqtCZX8Kf6NxZOKSnqrWv7DBGJjwWzoDwVHLqVxRb4-zmTDOs7FTZsRyml1uCGc6LgmLpkx2Mr3pOOoYF8K--mMAfJpaeX2YLUC3VM22glQYNuaydz7Nz4yopNpE0ghxUvPG31nGNVkCRA9j6wY2Di8iaCB2SiKsdaLhp4A=&c=xF52oAK4BG83z58rkSUOVf2oHA2qTRtTjCyOFmPDql2eHAzvZp9F8Q==&ch=NZXZgAD56CuYKb5Et2XZI2wRl5RbtibWeakCKYE6ToCcuQ4I_yojtQ==) |
---|---
### Here's the intended text message pointing to an article about how gangs like Tren de Aragua are taking over apartment buildings in cities all over our country, demanding rent from residents, and beating up the real property managers who attempt to collect rent.

These gangs running free are an unintended consequence of the open border policy brought to you by Lofgren's Democrat party.

They seem willing to destroy our national sovereignty and security in order to maintain their grip on our government.

body:
Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

| |

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=9b957638aaf647bda91f1f991b03ec3f&_e=8ZSNde_Ap_XwkMDxc02Zlj0alD5oHTWxjk_XRwKPrRg35Y4vwdolLePx2e6X3l_BpwShrifJnub4UL3w_2E8adfRprHRkEPBz9hqFIPEm8iIqWKxYcBheDr7M7zR20fuvLyCvfLg92BLHAiTIK1K7KMG-Tn2uOY0QJ_W3OOI_wLzc5gkjCYF8Z_D6PSbSr9_ggsIAXm_TG8KZn_-TyFSSIAnlXPyq8eklBlIIFRl2bdi-tFsvh1-49Imf7K-jpFZ42Re7iuO8RtkstF74VD0fw-hQR-H33qi-T_5hph9QdvdHAEYzmWOfsIMZJi79KMMNSbktdpkKZI1l9-rcDvGb9OjuwOvLoEKQRqeEwb2UCcDeLpGEaHgnZMRDR83dWfCAz-7esI6YW4qiBdYJRc3bihxKfLRRu-rYtRVDyKTk-DYKA3Zi7gkNwUnEEsS6Wkd "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign? | | | | | Friend, There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory. Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. # On the Eve of Change
---
| My dear friend Peter,

Here we are—on the eve of an election that we have all been eagerly awaiting and working toward. By this time tomorrow, the future we’ve envisioned together could be within reach, and we’ll know the impact of our collective effort to build a stronger, fairer, and more inclusive Coastal Georgia. I feel so much hope and gratitude in this moment, thanks to each of you.

Before a single vote is counted, I want to say _**THANK YOU!**_

Your unwavering support has shown me that this journey was never one I walked alone. We are a team, a community, a movement for change, and it has been my greatest honor to walk this path with you.

So tonight, I ask you to reflect with me on all we have accomplished and to hold close the dream that brought us here. Tomorrow, Coastal Georgia votes and we’ll complete this chapter together.

Let’s make history together!
_-Patti
_

name: Thomas Carle
subject: The Big Day is Upon Us!
body:
Well, Everyone,
The time has come to cast ballots and pony-up! The cake is likely baked by
now - but, you never know - if you get an opportunity - do your best to
promote our ideals!

I thank you all for passing along information for me, volunteering and
contributing! You have helped to make this campaign both viable and
competitive!(and fun!) It has been rewarding to meet and share ideas with
those of you that I have met, and I look forward to a future of doing it as
an elected representative for you!

In a recent article in the Olean Star, the reporter characterized this
contest as 'David versus Goliath'. Yes, Dems are outnumbered in the
district - in round numbers by 50,000, so its a mountain to climb!

Then you have those voters that do not affiliate with the two major parties
- they number 136,000! That tells me that it is 'up for grabs' and as long
as we are sharing info and having conversations - we have a chance to flip
this seat! And if we do, I will do everything that I can to ensure that we
keep it for another cycle, while we lay the groundwork for improved
representation going forward!

I appreciate all of you for what you have helped me to do! Many people in
our district have also volunteered for other candidates - terrific! Every
race is important to the overall well-being of our town, county, state,
nation and planet! I would totally encourage everyone that can to run for
office! Locally, for school boards, on up - candidates are what drives
majorities, and Republicans have been doing this for years - and Democrats
need to start!

Not to be 'gloomy' but, if you are reading this, you know that if we don't
get it right - the Day One Dictator, orders the military to take care of
his opposition, followed by mass deportations, tariffs, loyalists replacing
non-partisans, no guardrails and an already stacked Supreme Court. We all
want better for our kids and grandkids than a forever - Trump dynasty!

In case you need some talking points, let's recap the past week -

As much as I wanted that Tesla EV - I cancelled my thoughts on it when Elon
began donating 47 million a month to DJT! Now, he is campaigning to be in
the cabinet promising hardship for all as the efficiency czar and
promising to cut 2 trillion from the USA budget. And let's not mention all
of his contracts with the government already or his regular conversations
with Putin. Uh, no - this alliance cannot happen in a democracy or where
there is a rule of law! Another reason to vote Blue!

Then, RFK Jr as what? An advisor on Health or Vaccinations - what? You
have to be kidding! Vote Blue!

Picking on Puerto RIco - c'mon! DJT reduced and cut their disaster funding
after the two hurricanes, and now, he supports their verbal bashing! Vota
Azul!

Then there's the attack ad on Kamala on transgender operations - turns out
that it was a part of DJT policy in 2019, and the Republican party amended
it, to read 'when medically necessary'! Yet, they spent 300 million in ads
on it, saying it was her policy - but, it was theirs! Blue!

On top of all that, the Speaker of the House(also, architect of 2020
issues), Mike Johnson, is all about eliminating the Affordable Care
Act(Obamacare) which would mean 100 million people with pre-existing
conditions have to jump back into the risk pool - remember that fiasco? In
this case, voters with ailments, and serious issues, diabetes, cancer,
heart disease and disabilities, must exercise their right to vote! Blue!

And then what happens to the 45 mm people that are straight up insured
through Obamacare? Sorry, DJT - an idea about a concept, of a working
theory of a possible strategy, is not a comprehensive health
insurance/coverage plan! Blue!

Lastly, what then happens to the negotiated reductions of prescriptions?
Gone! No more inexpensive insulin, prescription cap on annual spending or
reduced price pharmaceuticals! Blue!

Oh, wait, there's more - Mike Johnson also said they would rescind the
CHIPS and Science Act - until he heard himself say the quiet part out loud
and is now, walking it back to 'we just want to make it better'! Who is he
kidding? Blue!

So, if we get this election right - we do not have to worry about all of
that, or Project 2025, or DJT becoming our King....let's be sure to
energize our fellow Democrats, and encourage every one of the reasonable
people that are a little to the right, to join us!

For our Republican allies, we promise to humanely tighten the borders, we
promise to keep reducing inflation and the costs of goods, increase
affordable housing, protect the 2nd amendment while we address gun
violence, and whatever else it takes to have you help us turn this nation
around to a more unified 'tribe', under a big tent!

The stakes are high! If DJT and Langworthy-types win, America loses! So,
back the Blue!

Our own citizens, that share common ground with us, could vote us right out
of a Democracy! That is why you and I are here, right now, being
politically active! Let's encourage someone else tonight and tomorrow to
help us!

Thank you again! One day to go.....catch you on the other side! Stay
positive! Go Blue!
Tom

So when we saw that **AAPI voters have surpassed their 2020 early vote totals** , we couldn’t have been more proud! This community is turning out in force, and together we’re going to elect the first South Asian President of the United States when all the votes are counted. 💪🏽

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: My decision . . .

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2169%2E135344%2E-TCOQ0)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241104-3-900&t=2&akid=2169%2E135344%2E-TCOQ0)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails ahead of Election Day, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Getting ourselves into a position to win this race has taken a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we had to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs. But we still have a little ways to go, so I am asking:**
[**Will you consider donating $24 or whatever you can to my campaign as we're now in the final sprint.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241104-3-900&t=3&akid=2169%2E135344%2E-TCOQ0)**

name: Jill Stein for President
subject: Ranked-choice voting changes the game
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
It's time for real democracy.

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, If you’re like us, you’re probably sick and tired of hearing the propaganda that voting for Jill Stein and other Green candidates means you’re “spoiling the election” or “wasting your vote.” The political and media establishment promotes “spoiler” hysteria to scare people away from voting for what they actually want, and to keep people voting for a two-party system that doesn’t serve their interests. But what they don’t want people to know is that there’s a simple upgrade to our voting system that would make “spoiler” hysteria obsolete: Ranked-Choice Voting. For years now, polls have shown that a huge majority - roughly 60% - of Americans believe the two-party system doesn’t represent them, and we need a new major party. Yet despite their unpopularity, the same two parties maintain a stranglehold on power by campaigning on the same message: “The other party is worse, so you have to vote for us as the lesser evil.” Instead of earning votes by working to improve voters’ lives, they can extort votes by threatening that the other side will be worse. This two-party trap has led our country to a bad place: endless war and genocide, social and economic breakdown, climate collapse, and a democracy on life support. But it doesn’t have to be this way, and ranked-choice voting can change the game.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ranked_choice_voting&n=1)
---
With ranked-choice voting (RCV) you can vote for your favorite candidates without any worry about "wasting your vote," "splitting the vote" or "spoiling" an election. It’s simple: You can rank your 1st choice, 2nd choice, and so on, and if your 1st choice doesn't win, your vote goes to your 2nd choice. This process continues until one candidate wins a majority - and they can't win with less than 50%, which has happened in 4 of the last 8 Presidential elections. Decade after decade of lesser-evil voting has enabled both establishment parties to do less and less for the people and cater to the demands of their wealthy elite donors. RCV can break this vicious cycle by freeing people to vote FOR what they actually want, rather than AGAINST what they fear. That would give voters real choice and real power. In the Green Party, we’ve been fighting for ranked-choice voting for decades, but the politicians in power refuse to pass it because they don’t want you to have a real choice. And that’s one more reason they don’t deserve your vote. In fact, there’s been a concerted effort to suppress RCV by politicians like CA governor Gavin Newsom, who in 2019 vetoed a popular bill to expand use of RCV in California. Despite establishment opposition, the movement for RCV has made steady progress, passing forms of RCV in over 50 cities and counties across the country, as well as the state of Maine. Communities that use RCV have higher turnout and happier voters. That's because RCV is a win-win-win for voters: it promotes majority rule, discourages negative campaigning, and means voters don't have to worry about "splitting the vote." RCV is a gamechanger, but it’s also just a first step towards revitalizing our democracy to empower the people. Another critically-needed reform is proportional representation for legislative elections, a type of system used in most democracies around the world where if a party gets 25% of the vote, they take 25% of the seats. Proportional representation produces governments that are more representative and responsive, and allows for healthy multi-party democracy where the true diversity of a society can be fairly represented. As the movement for RCV gains momentum, however, we have to be careful about attempts to co-opt voters’ enthusiasm for changing the broken system. In recent years, we’ve seen a well-funded effort to conflate RCV with “Top 4” primaries, which began in CA and WA as “Top 2” primaries. Now there are ballot measures in several states that include variants of “Top 4,” which are marketed as “open primaries,” along with a distorted and diluted form of RCV. The problem is, similar to “Top 2,” the “Top 4” system requires “jungle primaries” that put candidates of all parties together and eliminates all but the top 4 vote-getters, which massively tilts the playing field towards well-funded, establishment-backed candidates with the resources to turn out a large primary vote. To make things worse, these primaries don’t even use RCV, making them no better than elections under the existing broken system. A better name for “Top 4” primaries would be “limited-choice voting,” when what we need is the opposite: more voices and more choices. But this well-funded “reform” appears to be aimed at co-opting the movement for RCV to further entrench the two-party system and pay-to-play politics. And while genuine RCV can be a stepping stone to proportional representation, “Top 4” would perpetuate the system of single-seat elections, which would be an obstacle to enacting proportional representation. For all these reasons, in 2024 **we fully support ballot measures for genuine ranked-choice voting** in Oregon (Measure 117) and multiple cities including Washington DC (Initiative 83), Richmond CA (Measure L), Oak Park IL and Peoria IL; and **we oppose measures for “Top 4” primaries** in Colorado (Proposition 131) and Idaho (Proposition 1), and “Top 5” in Nevada (Question 3).
---
It’s clearer than ever that we urgently need a voting system that frees us all to vote for what we want, not just against what we fear. Democracy needs a moral compass, and that compass is our values. If we can't vote our values, we're lost at sea. It's time to break free from the 2-party trap and bring real democracy to America with ranked-choice voting. Every vote for our campaign helps to build the demand for a world where we can all forget the “lesser evil,” and vote for the greater good like our lives depend on it - because they do.
---
Thank you for everything you do to power up this movement for real democracy! In solidarity and gratitude, The Stein/Ware 2024 Team

# What’s at Stake Tomorrow
---
|
Dear Friends,
This past weekend, I received the tremendous honor of being named Humanitarian of the Year by the Hospital Association of Southern California. While I am grateful for this recognition, it also reminded me of the significant work that remains in our healthcare system. As I accepted this award, I reflected on my humble beginnings in Pakistan and how America has enabled me to live a dream life, providing my family with opportunities I once could only imagine. This is why this election means so much to me.
Over the past two years, I have been deeply involved in this political journey and have dedicated the last four months to helping my friend Kamala Harris get elected. I want to ensure that America remains a beacon of hope, leaving our children with more opportunities and freedoms than we inherited. I’ll never forget Kamala’s visit to my home a few months ago; as she spoke with my daughter about her hopes for the future, I felt immense pride as a father, but I also worry about what another four years of Trump chaos would mean for my daughter's future.
As a doctor, I am equally concerned about what a second term of a radical Trump administration would mean for my patients and our healthcare system. I see firsthand the devastating impact of the current system on my patients' lives. Many struggle to access quality care, and chronic illnesses are on the rise, straining our economy. We need to support policies that enhance access to healthcare, protect women’s health and reproductive rights, and prioritize mental health care. By supporting Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party, we can build an equitable healthcare system for all Americans.
Please donate what you can to ensure the campaign finishes strong, and most importantly, make sure you vote. Let everyone in your network know who you support and why this election is so crucial.
Thank you for standing with us.In solidarity,
Dr. Asif Mahmood

This is why this election means so much to me. Over the past two years, I have been deeply involved in this political journey and have dedicated the last four months to helping my friend Kamala Harris get elected. I want to ensure that America remains a beacon of hope, leaving our children with more opportunities and freedoms than we inherited. I’ll never forget Kamala’s visit to my home a few months ago; as she spoke with my daughter about her hopes for the future, I felt immense pride as a father, but I also worry about what another four years of Trump chaos would mean for my daughter's future. As a doctor, I am equally concerned about what a second term of a radical Trump administration would mean for my patients and our healthcare system. I see firsthand the devastating impact of the current system on my patients' lives. Many struggle to access quality care, and chronic illnesses are on the rise, straining our economy. We need to support policies that enhance access to healthcare, protect women’s health and reproductive rights, and prioritize mental health care. By supporting Kamala Harris and the Democratic Party, we can build an equitable healthcare system for all Americans. Please donate what you can to ensure the campaign finishes strong, and most importantly, make sure you vote. Let everyone in your network know who you support and why this election is so crucial. Thank you for standing with us.In solidarity, Dr. Asif Mahmood | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Dr. Asif Mahmood. All rights reserved.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96562794/510407787/-1193939285?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_GOTV_241104_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWYzNjM1MC1mMDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kUgz1zn0zFM87elxQaaC1yA2xIKkrP3uHyPLTQJlWc=) Derek,

I imagine that many of you are feeling quite nervous about tomorrow. Frankly, that’s fair. It’s a big day.

As my team and I prepare, I wanted to quickly paint you a picture, but before I do, [_**I’m asking if you can pitch in $5 towards our $10,000 Election Day fundraising goal.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96562796/510407789/-1193939285?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_GOTV_241104_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWYzNjM1MC1mMDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kUgz1zn0zFM87elxQaaC1yA2xIKkrP3uHyPLTQJlWc=)

Let’s look at what we’ve accomplished under President Biden and our Democratic Senate majority: we lowered prescription drug costs and capped insulin for seniors on Medicare to $35 a month. We passed the _PACT Act_ , giving millions of our men and women in uniform the care they deserve after being exposed to burn pits and other toxins. We passed the Inflation Reduction Act – our largest investment in climate policy ever. And we got our historic infrastructure bill signed into law to repair our nation’s roads, bridges, railways, and more.

Plus, the General Assembly here in the Commonwealth is also under Democratic control, thanks to you. The Democratic majority has blocked dangerous GOP bills that would’ve instituted a near-total abortion ban in VA and weakened voting rights.

Derek,
Donald Trump’s presidency was an absolute disaster for the American people for many reasons. One of them is that he appointed sycophants to his cabinet, instead of qualified public servants who would deliver for families.
Let’s take a walk down memory lane:
Betsy DeVos was Trump’s Secretary of Education. Not only did she advocate for gutting public education, she also sided with for-profit colleges over the students they cheated. AND, she had huge sums of money invested in some of those same institutions.
Ben Carson had no business being the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, yet Trump appointed him anyway. When Katie questioned him in a 2019 hearing, he revealed that didn’t even know basic housing terms like REO (Real Estate Owned)—he thought she was talking about Oreos.
Trump’s #1 criterion for appointments was loyalty to him, instead of expertise and competence, and a second Trump administration could be even worse:

subject: Here’s how your support will still make an impact before polls close tomorrow evening →
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, dlcc
body:
State legislative races are often decided by a handful of votes. Right up until polls close, campaigns are making calls, knocking on doors, and driving voters to their polling places to get out the vote. | | |
---
| |
---|---
Did you know that late money goes toward filling last-minute budget gaps in the states? **State legislative races are often decided by just a handful of votes. subject: I wanted to reach out before Election Day tomorrow
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I know it may be hard to think about, but nothing is guaranteed.
#

Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords.
It’s hard to believe, but when we wake up tomorrow, it will be Election Day. A day we’ve been working towards together for so many months.
I appreciate you so much for being a part of this movement for gun violence prevention.
We endorsed 342 gun safety candidates this election cycle, including Vice President Kamala Harris. The team at GIFFORDS and I will be cheering for these candidates tomorrow, and I hope you will too.
I feel so much hope about the gun violence prevention movement we have built together. It’s stronger today than it has ever been.
But the truth is, we have to be prepared for multiple outcomes once results start coming in tomorrow. I know it may be hard to think about, but nothing is guaranteed.
No matter if we hold the Senate or take back the House, and no matter who is the next president of the United States, our mission at GIFFORDS PAC to end gun violence in our nation will remain the same.
[**The only way we can achieve a future free from gun violence is with the support of people like you. That’s why today, I’m asking you to contribute $3—or any amount you can afford—to GIFFORDS PAC. As we gear up for the work ahead post-Election Day, your contribution will help fuel our work to keep our communities safe from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-nov24.MBs8nS&refcode=em241104-1-30&t=1&akid=9366%2E3935704%2EToRjsr)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_

Thank you, thank you, thank you. And please, make sure you and your loved ones have all voted before polls close tomorrow.
My very best,
Gabby Giffords

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564082/510411647/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDczN2Y0ZS1mMzlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x_atu91j_kCopPxB4v6OTyAu6oYE5gEf7WHAXrtV5_c=&emci=1c73acd7-ef9a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=94737f4e-f39a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=43402272) | Hi Peter, If you’re anything like me, you’re probably already waiting with bated breath for election results to roll in later this week... But today, I want to share a story with all of you. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564083/510411661/-1919974473?&refcode=E11501-20241104-PutneySchool-Image-Education&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDczN2Y0ZS1mMzlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x_atu91j_kCopPxB4v6OTyAu6oYE5gEf7WHAXrtV5_c=) _Photo credit: Kristopher Radder, Brattleboro Reformer_ Last week, I had the pleasure of visiting a school in southern Vermont and spending time with middle school students. It was a great day at school: I answered their questions, we ate lunch together, and we talked about the value of building community and making connections with people who are different to us. Many of you may know this, but I was actually a middle school history and social studies teacher myself! I think it’s so important to encourage and inspire Vermont’s young students, and my heart was so full hearing them share their thoughts, questions, and dreams. **That’s why I do this work, Peter.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564084/510411668/-1919974473?&refcode=E11501-20241104-PutneySchool-Image-Education&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDczN2Y0ZS1mMzlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x_atu91j_kCopPxB4v6OTyAu6oYE5gEf7WHAXrtV5_c=)**
_Photo credit: Kristopher Radder, Brattleboro Reformer_ It’s why I’ve spent the past few months campaigning hard for Democrats up and down the ballot and across the nation: so that the next generation is safe being who they are in the classroom, and so they have every door wide open for them. That includes a greener future, more educational and economic opportunities, and a world in which all LGBTQ+ children and adults are safe and empowered. Tomorrow, we’ll elect the nation’s first female President, the first Black woman president, and the first Asian president. All of your efforts – from donating to volunteering and encouraging your loved ones to vote – will have made it possible. And together, we will keep fighting this good fight for future generations to come! I’ll be in touch,
Becca

name: Jonathan Nez
subject: Eli Crane doesn’t stand with rural Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jonathan Nez for Congress
body:
| Hi Peter, I grew up in the tiny town of Shonto, Arizona, a very remote community with a population of around 500 people. In those days, it was a 60-mile round trip just to get the water we needed for our crops and livestock out on the ranch. Even today, many folks in rural Arizona’s most remote communities don’t have access to electricity or reliably clean water. I quickly learned the value of putting aside differences to work with our neighbors towards common solutions, and I’ve always embraced bipartisanship over the course of my career in public service. My opponent has taken the opposite approach during his time in public office. In those days, it was a 60-mile round trip just to get the water we needed for our crops and livestock out on the ranch. Even today, many folks in rural Arizona’s most remote communities don’t have access to electricity or reliably clean water. I quickly learned the value of putting aside differences to work with our neighbors towards common solutions, and I’ve always embraced bipartisanship over the course of my career in public service. clean_body: Fellow Patriot, Our college campuses have witnessed all sorts of protests. We only see the angry kids burning flags, but there is actually an army of student liberty activists doing great work, too. Instead of blocking traffic, these students are helping liberty candidates win tough races and getting pro-liberty legislation passed into law. No, these aren't overpaid consultants wasting campaign resources. These are college-aged youth trained in effective activism, making a difference by door-knocking in some of the most critical districts in the country, and they are delivering major success. I'm talking about Young Americans for Liberty 's Operation Win at the Door. Before I tell you their success rate, please let me explain why it is critical - especially today - to support them in 2024. Alright, now here are the stats showing you how successful these student door knockers are: Since 2018, YAL-recruited student activists have helped elect 328 liberty legislators who have passed over 500 pro-liberty bills. In 2020, YAL-trained student activists helped pro-liberty candidates win races in 72 Counties that Biden carried. YAL-recruited student door knockers have helped elect 66 legislators who were outspent by their opponents. It's more powerful than money! YAL-trained activists helped secure 128 Wins with margins of victory within 5%! * Independent studies prove YAL-trained door knockers help swing races by 6-15%! Here's the truth that no one wants to admit... If YAL's Operation Win at the Door is so successful, then why isn't everyone doing this? Good question! The simple answer is it is NOT easy to pull off. Conservatives are way behind the radical left when it comes to door-to-door operations. It requires a large network of youth to mobilize such a program, and most organizations do not have access to a large pool of applicants. Most conservative consultants would rather throw money at TV advertisements instead of doing the hard work of door-knocking. However, Young Americans for Liberty is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus. They have thousands of students already in their network from which to recruit. Thank you for supporting America and standing up for the values our country was founded on. Without your support, none of this is possible. Thank you, Vivek Ramaswamy P.S. These student door-knockers are the single biggest influence on close elections. They are swinging races by 6% to 15%. October Update

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/ppp2gaxknr-12713456?e=8f9fef7158)
October Update
Friends and Fellow Hoosiers,

This month, we honored "World Mental Health Day" on October 10th, raising awareness to end the stigma and put a spotlight on mental health education and resources.

If you or someone you know is looking for resources in Indiana, please click here (https://mentalhealthroundtable.org/resources/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
Suzanne Crouch
Mental Health Roundtables Around the State
I had the privilege of criss-crossing the state this month to host mental health conversations. From Greenfield to Richmond to Elkhart and Frankfort to Fort Wayne, thank you to all who participated in these important conversations. These community partners are providing care to some of the most vulnerable in our state.

Building Socially Connected Communities Grants Awarded
Through the Office of Community and Rural Affairs, 10 communities were awarded grants from the Building Socially Connected Communities pilot program to combat isolation and loneliness, especially in rural communities.
* Town of Vernon
* Town of Hope
* Rush County Economic and Community Development Corp.
* Merom Camp and Retreat Center
* Brown County Art Gallery Foundation
* Owen County Community Foundation
* Orange County Community Gardens
* Thriving Grant County Inc.
* Traditional Arts Today
* North Daviess Spanish 4

A virtual town hall will take place in July 2026 for the awardees to discuss the impact of their projects.
LEARN MORE (https://www.insideindianabusiness.com/articles/ocra-awards-first-grants-in-pilot-to-combat-loneliness-in-rural-areas?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In The News
Lieutenant Governor Suzanne Crouch visits Fort Wayne’s Shepherd’s House Wednesday (https://www.21alivenews.com/2024/10/23/lieutenant-governor-suzanne-crouch-visits-fort-waynes-shepherds-house-wednesday/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

"Indiana’s Lieutenant Governor Suzanne Crouch was in Fort Wayne on Wednesday to visit Shepherd’s House.

Shepherd’s House is a long-term residential facility that offers a professional-led, clinical program to homeless Veterans who suffer from alcoholism, chemical dependency, or mental health issues.

The visit highlights the state’s commitment to addressing the needs of Hoosier veterans facing challenges such as homelessness, addiction, and mental health issues."
READ MORE (https://www.21alivenews.com/2024/10/23/lieutenant-governor-suzanne-crouch-visits-fort-waynes-shepherds-house-wednesday/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Indiana Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch on a mission to support mental health (https://www.wndu.com/2024/10/08/indiana-lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-mission-support-mental-health/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

"Her time as lieutenant governor is coming to an end, but Indiana’s own Suzanne Crouch is still on a mission for mental health.

Before speaking, Crouch toured Oaklawn’s Crisis Center to learn about their approach to mental health.

Crouch says she has long been a supporter for mental health awareness."
READ MORE (https://www.wndu.com/2024/10/08/indiana-lt-gov-suzanne-crouch-mission-support-mental-health/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Mental health hits home for Lt. Gov. Crouch (https://westernwaynenews.com/mental-health-lt-gov-crouch/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=60b407effa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

"Indiana Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch’s attention to mental health developed through multiple family situations.

“My interest is very personal,” Crouch said Oct. 3 while participating in a discussion with Wayne County mental health professionals and leaders at the Neighborhood Health Center’s administration building."

Information on How to Vote in the General Election| | |
---
# **General Election - Nov 5th**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | Happy Election Day eve! In preparation for the 2024 general election on Tuesday, November 5th, my office has assembled information for your consumption. Regardless of who you choose to support in each of the contested races, in our democracy, every voice matters. **If you did not vote early, I hope you find this information useful as you prepare to cast your vote tomorrow, Election Day.**
---
| | The Prince William County Office of Elections website, [PWCvotes.org](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564875/510414230/-1178791060?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=&emci=e2c6b5cc-f29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=817939b4-f49a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=21796801), is your one-stop shop for all things voting. You can find links on [how to look up your voting place](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564876/510414231/1384590612?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=&emci=e2c6b5cc-f29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=817939b4-f49a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=21796801), [check your voter registration status](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564877/510414232/549338864?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=&emci=e2c6b5cc-f29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=817939b4-f49a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=21796801), and a [guide on how the counting process works](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564878/510414233/569452661?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=&emci=e2c6b5cc-f29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=817939b4-f49a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=21796801) so you can understand how our elections are fairly and accurately run.
---
| |
# **Election Day Voting:**
---
On Election Day, you will need to present an ID to vote. The most commonly used IDs are listed below.
---
* Voter confirmation documents you received after registering to vote
* Virginia DMV-issued driver’s license or ID card
* Valid US passport
* Any ID card issued by the US, Virginia, or a local Virginia government
* Any student ID card issued by a US college or university
* Valid student ID issued by a school in Virginia
* Employer-issued photo ID card
* Any current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document with your name and address
* An ID confirmation statement

---
Please note that an out-of-state driver’s license is **NOT accepted.** If you are uncertain if your ID will be accepted, please refer to the [full list of acceptable IDs](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564879/510414234/1143453033?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=&emci=e2c6b5cc-f29a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=817939b4-f49a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=21796801).
---
| |
# **How to Same-Day Register & Vote**
---
**If you missed the deadline to register for the first time or update your registration, you can still vote!** Virginia has same-day voter registration, meaning you need to bring your ID and plan to vote provisionally. You will complete your registration and vote on a ballot that will be counted once your registration is confirmed. If you have any more questions, refer to this [Same-Day Voter Registration FAQ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96564880/510414235/1136519850?emci=ebcdd6e1-c490-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=eeaa1eb2-d89a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=35347160&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTc5MzliNC1mNDlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wPjbQsJ-vEdOB00na5Fav7BACJockvVnNlN7TMG9Si8=). Do not hesitate to call the Prince William County Office of Elections at 703-792-6470.
---
| |
# **Accessible Voting**
---
If you are 65 or older, or have a disability, you may vote on Election Day without leaving your vehicle. Look for a sign with a button outside the polling place, ring the bell, and an election officer will come to your car.
---
| |
# **Mail Ballots**
---
If you requested a mail ballot and have not returned it, it is recommended that you **take your completed mail ballot to your regular polling place on Tuesday, November 5th,** to ensure your vote is counted. Simply complete the ballot as normal and take it to the polling site rather than placing it in the mail. Make sure your vote counts. If you are unable to drop-off your mail ballot in-person on Election Day, be sure to complete your mail ballot ASAP. Remember your mail ballot must be postmarked no later than Tuesday, November 5th and received by the Office of Elections no later than noon on Friday, November 8th.
---
# **Rides to the Polls**
---
If you need a ride to the polls, the NAACP is paying for rides via the rideshare app, Lyft. Simply book your trip via Lyft and use the code **NAACPVOTE24** to claim up to $20 off two rides ($40 total)— one to the polls and one back.
---
# **Voter Protection Hotlines**
---
If you encounter issues with casting your ballot, the number for the non-partisan voter protection hotline is 1-866-687-8683. Please note that the non-partisan voter protection hotline is available in multiple languages. See below!**English:** 866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683).**Spanish:** 888-VE-Y-VOTA (888-839-8682)**Arabic:** 844-YALLA-US (844-925-5287)**Asian languages:** 888-API-VOTE (888-274-8683) It's important to ensure that everyone's voting rights are protected, so don't hesitate to reach out if you need assistance. **It is illegal to intimidate, threaten, or coerce someone in order to interfere with their right to vote. Report any voter intimidation to your local registrar’s office.**
---

clean_body: Information on How to Vote in the General Election| | | General Election - Nov 5th Dear neighbors, | | Happy Election Day eve! In preparation for the 2024 general election on Tuesday, November 5th, my office has assembled information for your consumption. Regardless of who you choose to support in each of the contested races, in our democracy, every voice matters. If you did not vote early, I hope you find this information useful as you prepare to cast your vote tomorrow, Election Day. | | The Prince William County Office of Elections website, , is your one-stop shop for all things voting. You can find links on , , and a so you can understand how our elections are fairly and accurately run. | | Election Day Voting: On Election Day, you will need to present an ID to vote. The most commonly used IDs are listed below. Voter confirmation documents you received after registering to vote Virginia DMV-issued driver’s license or ID card Valid US passport Any ID card issued by the US, Virginia, or a local Virginia government Any student ID card issued by a US college or university Valid student ID issued by a school in Virginia Employer-issued photo ID card Any current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document with your name and address An ID confirmation statement Please note that an out-of-state driver’s license is NOT accepted. If you are uncertain if your ID will be accepted, please refer to the . | | How to Same-Day Register & Vote If you missed the deadline to register for the first time or update your registration, you can still vote! Virginia has same-day voter registration, meaning you need to bring your ID and plan to vote provisionally. You will complete your registration and vote on a ballot that will be counted once your registration is confirmed. If you have any more questions, refer to this =. Do not hesitate to call the Prince William County Office of Elections at 703-792-6470. | | Accessible Voting If you are 65 or older, or have a disability, you may vote on Election Day without leaving your vehicle. Look for a sign with a button outside the polling place, ring the bell, and an election officer will come to your car. | | Mail Ballots If you requested a mail ballot and have not returned it, it is recommended that you take your completed mail ballot to your regular polling place on Tuesday, November 5th, to ensure your vote is counted. Simply complete the ballot as normal and take it to the polling site rather than placing it in the mail. Make sure your vote counts. If you are unable to drop-off your mail ballot in-person on Election Day, be sure to complete your mail ballot ASAP. Remember your mail ballot must be postmarked no later than Tuesday, November 5th and received by the Office of Elections no later than noon on Friday, November 8th. Rides to the Polls If you need a ride to the polls, the NAACP is paying for rides via the rideshare app, Lyft. Simply book your trip via Lyft and use the code NAACPVOTE24 to claim up to $20 off two rides ($40 total)— one to the polls and one back. Voter Protection Hotlines If you encounter issues with casting your ballot, the number for the non-partisan voter protection hotline is 1-866-687-8683. Please note that the non-partisan voter protection hotline is available in multiple languages. See below!English: 866-OUR-VOTE (866-687-8683).Spanish: 888-VE-Y-VOTA (888-839-8682)Arabic: 844-YALLA-US (844-925-5287)Asian languages: 888-API-VOTE (888-274-8683) It's important to ensure that everyone's voting rights are protected, so don't hesitate to reach out if you need assistance. It is illegal to intimidate, threaten, or coerce someone in order to interfere with their right to vote. Report any voter intimidation to your local registrar’s office. | | Sample Ballots | | | | | | | | If you are unsure of what district you are in, you can find that information at Stay In Touch** Please be on the lookout for a robust summary of recent district events and policy updates in the near future. Peter -- **Join us for a fun night watching the election results together at the OKGOP Election Night Watch Party!**
### Reminder: [Get Your Free Tickets To Attend By Clicking Here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=OuHnzqubmow6O_1L76Q3v2F3UxM7-W63U87VaIpPAxdH2VoT8wIrOl0qViseTbJ4&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_reminder_get_your_free_ticke&n=2)

Starting: 6:00 pm
Where: Champion Convention Center \-
(Behind the Hilton Garden Inn Hotel)
737 S Meridian Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73108

Welcome to the **OKGOP Election Night Watch Party**! Join us on **Tuesday, Nov. 5, 2024** at **6:00 PM** at the **Champion Convention Center** for a night of excitement and anticipation as we watch the election results roll in. Come mingle with fellow party members, enjoy the live band, and cheer on your favorite candidates. There will be a hot dog vendor and cash bar, as well several Elected Officials will be there to make brief remarks. It's going to be a night to remember, so don't miss out! ---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

Tomorrow is election day! If you have not already voted, please ensure you make plans to do so tomorrow at your assigned polling place. Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Please [click here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=2a31fe44ed&e=d1c1b9864f) to find your election day polling place. Our future hangs in the balance of this election! Please vote for Ryan Chamberlin for State Representative, and let’s keep us the Free State of Florida.

Today, I will be sharing with you an update from last week’s events in the district. I had a great time attending community events, speaking with constituents, and learning more about the issues important to you. As always, [please do not hesitate to reach out to me and my office](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=6a934288ce&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something you need assistance with. We would be more than happy to speak with you!
---
| | **2024 Future of Florida Forum (F3) & Florida Chamber Annual Meeting**
---
|
---
| It was an honor to attend the 2024 Future of Florida Forum (F3) & Florida Chamber Annual Meeting reception with my wife Jenny. It was great to see familiar faces and meet new people as well. I look forward to continuing my partnership with the Florida Chamber of Commerce in the upcoming legislative session.
---
| | **Grand Opening of the EMS Central Grand Facility**
---
|
---
---
| I had the pleasure of attending the grand opening of the EMS Central Grand Facility which replaced their former location that was built in the 1960s. This new facility will greatly boost the operational efficiency and working conditions of our deserving EMS personnel. It will also enable EMS services to assist our community even more effectively. Ocala is grateful for the partnership between Marion County and Marion County’s Hospital District for making this new facility possible. It also couldn’t have been done without your help in contributing to the Marion County penny tax.
---
| | **We Voted Early!**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I voted early with my wife Jenny and my son Avery! It is such a privilege to be able to vote for our leaders. Early voting turnout was incredible, meaning it’s going to be a big year.
---
| | **Speaking to Lake Weir High School Seniors**
---
|
---
---
| I had the opportunity to speak to Lake Weir High School seniors who are taking state government. It was great to see so many hands raised to ask questions about the process of being a state legislator. Seeing a group of young folks so civically engaged certainly brings hope to me as they near graduation.
---
| | **Grand Opening of the Rock Program’s New Pantry at Fort McCoy School**
---
|
---
| It was a pleasure to attend the grand opening of the Rock Program’s new pantry at Fort McCoy School. With pantries now open in every school in the Ocala National Forest, the Rock Program is providing our students and communities with items such as food, clothing, and toiletries. They are doing amazing work, and I look forward to seeing how else the Rock Program improves our community in the future.
---
| | **Marion County Fire Rescues’ First Annual Medal Day Ceremony**
---
|
---
---
| It was an honor to help celebrate the Marion County Fire Rescues’ first annual Medal Day Ceremony. With over 400 first responders showing out, I couldn’t be more proud to represent Marion County. There were 11 different award categories, and we also celebrated those individuals who were awarded the Medal of Valor, Distinction, and Commendation. Thank you to Fire Chief James Banta and all of our first responders who put their lives on the line every day to ensure the well-being of our community.
---
| | **Marion County REC’s 2nd Annual Sequins and Saddles Gala**
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| Jenny and I had a great time celebrating with family and friends at the Marion County REC’s 2nd annual Sequins and Saddles Gala. It was phenomenal to hear from Congressman Mike Waltz and Congresswoman Kat Cammack, who were followed by rising star, Pastor Lorenzo Sewell. Topping off the event was Scott Baio (Chachi from Happy Days). Kurt Kelly did a stellar job as master of ceremonies and the saxophone stylings of Erinn Abu were lovely to hear all night. A big shout out to Marion REC Chair Brigitte Smith for putting together an amazing event. It was truly a night of celebration and inspiration.
---
| | **Groundbreaking for Marion County Animal Services’ New Location**
---
|
---
---
| My staff attended the groundbreaking for Marion County Animal Services’ new location on 20 acres of land donated by the Roberts family. They are now one step closer to achieving their dream of a brand-new facility for all of our community’s pets in need. I look forward to seeing the final building completed. Again, this is thanks to your support for contributing to the penny tax!
---
| | **Final Walk for Erika Booth**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of participating in Erika Booth’s final walk in Orange and Osceola counties before election day. I know Erika will provide great representation for her district and the rest of Florida in our state legislature.
---
| | **Watch My Podcast - The Constitutional Entrepreneur**
---
| [ ](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=dc01d7445a&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| You can watch my podcast, The Constitutional Entrepreneur, on [YouTube](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3bae765af4&e=d1c1b9864f) by clicking above or by [listening on Apple Podcasts](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c684a6c109&e=d1c1b9864f).

I believe our country was founded on Godly, entrepreneurial principles. The more we deviate from those principles, the more political problems we seem to have. Let’s influence this generation to move back towards them. I’m excited to share what I’ve learned and am still learning. I’m also excited to introduce you to other key influencers and what they have learned. We’re in this together!
---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**

You see, the Democrats in power are TERRIFIED I’d reach out to you. They think they can shut us up and marginalize people like you and me.
My name is Hung Cao. You don’t know me, but I’m a ret. Navy Captain who served in Special Forces for 25 years. I was a refugee from Vietnam in 1975 & my family, by the grace of God, came to America the right way— _legally_. My wife April and I have 5 beautiful kids that we homeschool.
Look, my life’s story is not what the liberal media & Democrat mob claims conservatives should be. I represent EVERYTHING they hate the most.
Biden and the Radical Dems have already announced $45 MILLION to destroy our GOP candidates, Fellow Patriot. They’ll mock us & smear our records with lies & insults. **[That’s why I’m humbly asking for you for just a few bucks today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=02dfaeeb0b1e42bab4762324db5a7cd3&_e=m4bNCmf7gN0gK6bFxQloAwa8ccKnSvL14hLhotSAonlg89xAXpEfG1QClnJ_2eKTrOiUk7g_IhxgVUd75PKrOCUMtLgV0DqRhvfgq72y2pZiP6GlqD1UeFKDRvfov5hXZPcQD4rA5oAu3kskoveKBOWGVIejMwK3YosLEUs83ARqayNavdpLYTd6149Wz2AiDs5R84tQEx-_dZcyT2kYhgL9fAow_tE36I5GnoGi0etnrZLcxG0-nI8iBw2E8h0TMZIwglc8nC29cJvSJWMPuIPUFuz0yciiGoAgvsLxSPHgQt5GRqLGBpmguKsbYA7FpXz_3Qpw6bacvTnN9G3on4jHI2u83bUAI_ENvi2Xds_SRswKz2YmKFTFPZ6ptmV0FsLT3v5aF8efZF5VHUkRJw%3D%3D)** We’re out of time the election is tomorrow. name: Congressman Bob Dold
subject: A Message from Former Congressman Bob Dold – Let’s Elect Jim Carris for Our Future
body:
Dear Peter,**This is our last chance. This election is too important to sit out. **I had the honor of representing Illinois' 10th District, so I know what's at stake for our families, communities, and businesses. I know that families are desperate for change and for a brighter future. We need strong, committed leadership to secure a brighter economic future for all of us. **That 's why I'm giving my full support to [Jim Carris for Congress](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-stylkhk-tlidtddjku-r/).**Jim understands the financial challenges our District families face every day. As a knowledgeable business leader, Jim knows firsthand what it's like to sign both sides of a paycheck. He knows the importance of keeping budgets in check and bringing inflation down, and he's got the vision and skills to make a real difference for all of us. **Jim will fight to keep our economy strong and ensure the 10th District remains a great place to live and work.** This election, make sure your voice is heard. With only two days left to go, after casting your vote, help a friend or neighbor get to the [polls](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-stylkhk-tlidtddjku-y/) - especially our elderly and disabled community members. **Let 's make it clear that every vote counts and that we're committed to choosing a leader who will stand up for the economic future we all deserve.**The next two years **can and should be better.** Join me in supporting Jim Carris. Let's make our voices heard and build a stronger future for the 10th District together.Best regards, Bob Dold

Team, My mission as your mayor is to urgently move Los Angeles in a new direction — especially when it comes to the homelessness crisis. We have much more work ahead of us, but I wanted to make sure you saw the big news about our work so far: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96566142/510419769/1526939395?refcode=AU_KRB_EG_GEN_PET_IN_20241104_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2FiYjMyOC1mODlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KaAl2vrW4lDHwblG9dAefhIPrBi6E0C6kANxLlJs0J8=&emci=89131732-f79a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=fcabb328-f89a-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=2429742) From declaring a state of emergency to accelerating the construction of affordable housing, we are changing how L.A. brings people inside and saves lives. * Street homelessness is down 10% — the biggest decrease in the last 9 years

* The number of people moved into shelter rose by 12.7%
* The number of Angelenos who moved into permanent housing is at an all-time high
