The 2024 election culminates tomorrow--yet even though armies of writers have spilled no end of ink [observing](https://substack.com/redirect/3dd8ad6a-79af-4854-aeb6-968cc793d414?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) every step the [corporate candidates](https://substack.com/redirect/dc563606-a6f7-4bab-93bd-aacf4f5d707e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have taken, some of the most important (and disturbing) elements of the process remain widely unobserved. Meanwhile, the most influential actions that voters can take involve grassroots actions well beyond the ballot box or polling station.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39654222-71d0-4619-9789-82263c64d4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **Elections only matter if their results are respected**
Despite the public discussion surrounding it, the election culminating tomorrow might not actually matter at all. Trump--who would be both the [oldest person ever](https://substack.com/redirect/0fe96417-d60f-4191-aa40-6b0c77f2e101?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) elected President if he wins, as well as the first convicted criminal to occupy the White House--has [already begun](https://substack.com/redirect/170c1a95-cdc7-4477-aadb-de2dea9734b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) calling the legitimacy of the process into question, which suggests that the results will be determined not on election day, nor even as the ballots are counted, but rather in courtrooms over the weeks following the election.
Nor is that anything new in this country. The pivotal election of 2000 was decided by the Supreme Court, which unconstitutionally abandoned settled law and the separation of powers to determine its own composition. That was the critical step that enabled the conservative cabal that now dominates jurisprudence in the United States. In the years since then, more observers have finally recognized the need for alarm in the wake of decisions undermining [reproductive liberty](https://substack.com/redirect/cf8949aa-e020-4b3b-8d0c-c8f8d53e0659?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the independence of [administrative agencies](https://substack.com/redirect/cdf56007-78f9-4d82-9e63-58c70db51646?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But their alarm may have come too late.
Since at least 2010 (when the Supreme Court decided _[Citizens United](https://substack.com/redirect/8d1f09d7-b861-4d3c-83d1-23418ace0fe1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_), elections in the U.S. have been little more than contests to see which party could do more to raise money from corporate capital. The role of money in politics is entirely de-legitimating, even if we're just looking at the electoral phase, and ignoring everything that happens afterward from corporate lobbying to poaching retired members of Congress and industrial capture of regulatory agencies.
_Help inform and educate your friends by sharing this post!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=151177867&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUxMTc3ODY3LCJpYXQiOjE3MzA3NTc3OTMsImV4cCI6MTczMzM0OTc5MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.BlMOxj4EN2WRTrWeFVW-ZYqdD39ve_LQwpdPep5g3LI)
### **Disinformation renders elections incoherent**
Even if the election results are respected, and do not become the basis for [another armed insurrection](https://substack.com/redirect/d1da1fe1-f281-476f-bf73-3f2a688fbf42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the events preceding the election render it impossible to discern a coherent mandate from whatever the result may be.
The role of disinformation in this election cycle unhinges the election and its results from any modicum of principle, or a potential political mandate. With figures repeating lies about everything from the results of the 2020 election to the integrity of the 2024 process, the roles of immigrants and their communities, and the results of policy positions embraced by corporate candidates in the past, voters are being called on to discern not their preferences among articulated political visions, but rather [flavors of culture](https://substack.com/redirect/3fb7472e-3c63-498e-9941-7dd988ed436e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with little policy substance to back them. Each has been fueled by visions of reality distorted by professionals who bend it to serve them selves.
### **The voting process formally discriminates among voters**
In addition, the electoral college is an anachronism that unapologetically disregards any pretense of democratic legitimacy. An election for the chief executive of a nation of 400 million people across 50 states can not justifiably be determined by the choices of perhaps a few hundred thousand voters in [seven particular states](https://substack.com/redirect/5dcb39fd-0ec4-4d24-abe0-9bb57e761427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who have been made pivotal not only because of a quirk privileging their geographic jurisdiction, but also their preceding [relative lack of interest](https://substack.com/redirect/ebf43253-4a3d-485c-97a0-18e976737a6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the process.
In an even more direct way than the machinations of billionaires, the electoral college represents a formal violation of the "[one person, one vote](https://substack.com/redirect/aa5d15b7-a7aa-409a-9702-8fdd4a83d7dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" principle on which democracy is predicated. Put another way, the electoral college--even setting aside the disinformation and threats of violence surrounding the election--is enough to distinguish our political process from any modicum of democracy.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work promoting accountability for bipartisan corruption, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..txpgBO04xgD_6QOngVUHlganHlKegpGH9xKGJQD_GPc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=151177867)
### **The axis of lawlessness**
Finally, political theorists have long imagined that democracies favor peace and human rights, rather than imperialism and international belligerence. This view positions democracy as not only a set of procedural commitments, but also a substantive framework informed by the legacy of the Second World War.
Despite playing a crucial role in the Allied victory 75 years ago, the United States today [actively undermines the principles it established](https://substack.com/redirect/4acb9e4b-607a-40a6-af47-0ae87579142c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To international observers, this may be the most obvious reason to critique the self-congratulatory pretense among Americans that our country "leads the free world." In fact, the U.S. in fact stands well outside the "free" world, having led an international assault on democracy and human rights around the planet for over 75 years.
In addition to [weapons contracts](https://substack.com/redirect/4641c075-4003-47b2-95b5-6421da427eaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) handed out to every two-bit despot around the planet, [accountability for torture](https://substack.com/redirect/6935b22b-4f12-48a8-86db-4d4f9ceb6048?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) offers an especially glaring and disturbing example. No one has ever been held accountable for an [official policy](https://substack.com/redirect/3b7aa2e9-5dc5-48cb-b37c-80bc58d08d55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) under the Bush administration used by the CIA to justify crimes including torture, [murder](https://substack.com/redirect/a5eec023-6501-4733-be1b-5af6191bfc29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [rape](https://substack.com/redirect/241d45e2-cda3-4fcc-b0cf-03e52f6faa89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). At least hundreds (if not thousands, or more) detainees were tortured. When he was president, Obama chose to support secrecy by [suppressing](https://substack.com/redirect/4a3b01e5-9a18-4b8f-a2b4-af681926d5c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a report compiled by the Senate Judiciary Committee rather than hold CIA officials accountable for international human rights violations.
The United States has for decades openly flaunted international human rights. To the extent any rationale could justify our refusal to apply the law to [our own corrupt leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/9939ec46-b0a4-48c5-a1b5-ad99536bc618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it would be the lame and discredited principle that "might makes right."
The same pattern of belligerence with impunity is apparent in the ongoing Israeli genocide in Gaza, which is enabled by not just Washington, but particularly [a Democratic president who claims not to be a fascist](https://substack.com/redirect/ffab1b2c-90c5-409c-afff-c16263dd064b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even while arming a military power shamelessly slaughtering civilians.
### **Democracy? Yeah, sure**
People who pretend that elections in the U.S. have any legitimacy have probably not ever discovered what happens when a grassroots voice actually confronts power. Having dedicated six years of my life to liberating a congressional seat still held by an [unapologetically corrupt oligarch](https://substack.com/redirect/5f8236f9-eb81-40e3-aeec-63a46eb8ec3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a leadership role in the Democratic Party, I'm quite grateful for the chance to observe Washington's corruption from the sidelines.
The relationship between what passes for democracy in America and actual democracy is kind of like the relationship between the World Wrestling Federation and competitive wrestling. In both contexts, entertainment eclipses meaningful competition. Tragically, more Americans are able to see through the theater of wrestling than to recognize that the political process in the world's richest and most powerful country is no less theatrical.

| | Peter,

Our race is getting noticed nationally. Just this weekend, Newsmax headlined, "Maryland's Neil Parrott has shot at winning open seat." (3) Our team is putting everything we can into this critical race, but we need help to reach voters and pay for our commercials!

### Thank You for Your Hard Work!
---
Dear Team,

As we near the end of this campaign, I want to pause and recognize the dedication and passion each of you has poured into this effort. Every door you’ve knocked, every Swipe you have sent, and every conversation you’ve had has helped us reach voters across Minnesota’s 3rd District, and for that, I am profoundly grateful.

We are running this race because we believe that Minnesota families deserve more than just talk. Our message is simple: it’s time to bring real solutions to Washington, not more political games. Here’s why we’ve worked so hard and what we’re fighting for in these final days:

1\. Economic Security for Every Family: Rising prices are crushing families, and
Washington has failed to respond meaningfully. We need real solutions that address inflation, lower costs, and ensure our local businesses can thrive. This is about restoring a sense of security and optimism for our families and communities.

2\. A Government That Works for the People: We need to put partisanship aside and get things done. I’ve spent my career finding common ground, and I’ll bring that spirit to Washington. It’s time for leaders who listen, who care about our communities, and who focus on results, not headlines.

3\. Strong, Safe Communities: I’m committed to supporting law enforcement, keeping our neighborhoods safe, and ensuring that everyone in our district can feel secure. This means prioritizing resources, supporting our officers, and strengthening community trust.

4\. Protecting Our Minnesota Values: This campaign is about preserving what makes Minnesota special. From supporting our farmers to standing up for the hardworking people in every town across our district, I’m here to protect our values and keep Minnesota strong for future generations.

With just days left, we’re in the home stretch. Let’s make every moment count. Reach out to voters, remind them what’s at stake, and let’s bring this victory home together.

Your belief in our campaign means the world to me. Let’s finish strong and bring change to Washington for Minnesota’s 3rd District!

Thank you for your hard work and dedication,

Tad Jude

clean_body: | | Thank You for Your Hard Work! Dear Team, As we near the end of this campaign, I want to pause and recognize the dedication and passion each of you has poured into this effort. Every door you’ve knocked, every Swipe you have sent, and every conversation you’ve had has helped us reach voters across Minnesota’s 3rd District, and for that, I am profoundly grateful. We are running this race because we believe that Minnesota families deserve more than just talk. Our message is simple: it’s time to bring real solutions to Washington, not more political games. Here’s why we’ve worked so hard and what we’re fighting for in these final days: 1\. Economic Security for Every Family: Rising prices are crushing families, and Washington has failed to respond meaningfully. We need real solutions that address inflation, lower costs, and ensure our local businesses can thrive. This is about restoring a sense of security and optimism for our families and communities. 2\. A Government That Works for the People: We need to put partisanship aside and get things done. I’ve spent my career finding common ground, and I’ll bring that spirit to Washington. It’s time for leaders who listen, who care about our communities, and who focus on results, not headlines. 3\. Strong, Safe Communities: I’m committed to supporting law enforcement, keeping our neighborhoods safe, and ensuring that everyone in our district can feel secure. This means prioritizing resources, supporting our officers, and strengthening community trust. 4\. Protecting Our Minnesota Values: This campaign is about preserving what makes Minnesota special. From supporting our farmers to standing up for the hardworking people in every town across our district, I’m here to protect our values and keep Minnesota strong for future generations. With just days left, we’re in the home stretch. Let’s make every moment count. Reach out to voters, remind them what’s at stake, and let’s bring this victory home together. Your belief in our campaign means the world to me. Let’s finish strong and bring change to Washington for Minnesota’s 3rd District! | | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _one day away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. Monday, November 04, 2024 | Peter -- We're almost there—election day is tomorrow! But the last and most important job is still ahead of us—voting. If you've already voted by mail or through early voting, thank you for doing your civic duty! If you haven't yet voted, or can't until election day in your jurisdiction, use today to make a voting plan. When, where, how. See a sample ballot that was mailed to you or online, and look into the candidates you haven't heard of. Be sure to check out our [list of endorsed candidates](https://home.forwardparty.com/endorsements?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_1&n=2) to see if any are on your ballot! You can find your [polling place](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_1&n=3) at this link! When you have a voting plan in place, let us know on our social channels, tagging us and using #2024ward. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_1&n=4 "Find Your Polling Place") [Find Your Polling Place](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=ihU6dxQApWhDfn3sWyy-khVkZUq2vgEvUcdDfrQQf_fP9AlV0BPU03xsmxadqqHm&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=election_week_gotv_1&n=4)
---
There's plenty to be excited about on the ballot this year:
* Forward has more than 125 endorsed candidates on ballots across the country.
* There are over a dozen statewide and municipal pro-reform ballot initiatives this year to support.
* There are 2 statewide anti-reform ballot initiatives this year to defeat.

We're close! In just about 36 hours, we'll know the results of _most_ of the elections in this country. Let's finish strong!

Capitalism, socialism, liberalism, conservatism, atheism, and monotheism are often the fault lines upon which this clash occurs in the West. This is what made America unique and strong. The constitutional distinction of the individual, individual rights, and citizenship.

[ **III. MILITARY INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX // WAR OR PEACE?** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2731cb47a0854d669805e8e644d96632&_e=uymjUQozRecOwuE3CFTGJXemA9zmAKdL9NGh4gLk1HJ3zqOZY6AnRnMGl2j8uO54iV17g7Eea7kTlgXdbsmYDm9XEd-uSURy9m82O79wJstfOFjU8nMWenjeir7ObgIXFMI87IP-SjAd1YvUX-Fkp9dRd_0zcxVxcjMQvPEdvlUstNIKLdsL3odrcAXOct1PbiEHNZ5Ua5OzfL9FEptBa9pUjon4UsgdS3lOb7R_b21yb2yti_b_mEhayFTjU66DUoVbhUEKnTgRzcEgC0OGVaq519l1kCjeGi7V9gyNKQ0FncQ1bPekP-0Q61ZO-HTaqEAbu1sG6yw3eDqQ7lcI2Q%3D%3D)
---

A man with faith in God can never hold government as his highest authority. With an absence of God and the rise of statism or totalitarianism, who benefits? Today, the answer is obvious... Technology. More specifically, war, the military, the industry of death, and debt.

[ **IV. THE ECONOMY OF DEATH AND DEBT // OWNERSHIP OR SLAVERY?** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2731cb47a0854d669805e8e644d96632&_e=uymjUQozRecOwuE3CFTGJXemA9zmAKdL9NGh4gLk1HJ3zqOZY6AnRnMGl2j8uO54iV17g7Eea7kTlgXdbsmYDm9XEd-uSURy9m82O79wJstfOFjU8nMWenjeir7ObgIXFMI87IP-SjAd1YvUX-Fkp9dRd_0zcxVxcjMQvPEdvlUstNIKLdsL3odrcAXOct1PhPD3iS1GM-rFirzByseLHoDuk8xntwvXoDyahcUhYDzNm_9X1_rvQu8v0PmI4tCNbEeqEx2VtXFNLV-BE377OZOKXNYTKfr1CHxUh_3vU5EiiwaNC-Jh-GS2n4-qV4fIfas0K9Jn8qEHFO6bDJDHIw%3D%3D)
---

If you can't own your own business or your own property but still are forced to pay your taxes... You are a slave. Why do you think China is now the manufacturing superpower of the world? Slave Labor. And I don't mean the slave labor of their labor camps during Mao’s reign or the concentration camps Xi Xingping currently has the Muslim Uyghurs in. I'm talking about structural, economic, and slave labor. Where private ownership disappears from society.

[ **V. VOTE FOR YOU // DONALD TRUMP AND MAGA WILL HELP** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2731cb47a0854d669805e8e644d96632&_e=uymjUQozRecOwuE3CFTGJXemA9zmAKdL9NGh4gLk1HJ3zqOZY6AnRnMGl2j8uO54iV17g7Eea7kTlgXdbsmYDm9XEd-uSURy9m82O79wJstfOFjU8nMWenjeir7ObgIXFMI87IP-SjAd1YvUX-Fkp9dRd_0zcxVxcjMQvPEdvlUstNIKLdsL3odrcAXOct1PPRS9TxyKSMrQ0OAZlf2aISUOp8w3mn1Lw87WqgIbsovnXQdkwH4KMAnl2UvD6FBffwewiTquaHGhcGzrADzoOnQBjJJX2Lwb0TvakYE_7lkKIq-QEVXFzkgCSncQ3XsD_hTlKMzhBm4A9HsfQIUCGQ%3D%3D)
---

It truly is my life's honor to be on the ballot for one of our nation's most important elections. It’s actually a bit surreal. I don't covet money or power, so I'm not maniacal about endeavors regarding the 2. My focus is always more geared toward seeing the truth and, when given the chance, speaking the truth. The theme of the campaign **“The People Are Coming!”** is a battle cry for the polls tomorrow. But even more, it is a declaration that inevitably, the truth will prevail, and people will continue to wake up and see the truth.

**Your donation will help me reach the final undecided voters in this NECK AND NECK election. We cannot afford to leave one voter left uncontacted.**

Amy Klobuchar will only continue to poison America with her Radical Left policy, valuing foreign nationals over Americans, Communism over God, War over Peace, Slavery over Ownership and Private Property, and Kamala over Trump/MAGA.

| | | | | Friend,
This is it! We’re in the closing hours of this campaign and we are on our way to victory - if we get everyone out to vote!
I want to thank you for all the work that you’ve done on behalf of our effort, and there are just a few final things to go over.
**Closing Arguments**
For everyone knocking doors, making phone calls, or working a poll on election day, here’s the closing argument for voters: It’s time for change. Change in the direction of our country, change from the failed policies of the last four years, and change from the corrupt, out-of-touch Washington establishment that’s letting down our communities. Only one candidate in this race has a strong, bipartisan track record of delivering real results. That includes tough new laws that cracked down on illegal immigration, laws that improved healthcare access and maternal health, and commonsense economic policies that closed corporate tax loopholes and put more money back into the pockets of working families. For more info, be sure to check out our [website](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=a3eaa279af&e=5ccada9200).
**Have you Talked to your Friends?**
Are your friends voting? Have you talked to them about the campaign? Consider sending a quick text or email to 10 friends about tomorrow’s election and our campaign.
Here’s an example:“Hey, it’s _________, I’m just reminding my friends that tomorrow is election day! If you’re not sure where you vote, make sure you check: vote.pa.govWhen you do vote, I hope you consider supporting Ryan Mackenzie for Congress. mackenzieforcongress.com”
Looking for Something to do?
The best cure for pre-return jitters is putting in some work! Come by our office to make some phone calls or head out to greet a poll! Stop by our office at 1125 S. Cedar Crest Blvd (bottom floor) in Allentown, open from 7 AM - 5:00 PM.
**For Poll Greeters:**
Thank you very much for signing up to greet voters at the polls for our campaign! We’ve put together an amazing election day operation, and it’s going to help put us over the top. If you have any questions or need more information, please reach out to Sara Baran at [sara@mackenzieforcongress.com](mailto:sara@mackenzieforcongress.com) or at 484-860-5989.
One last time: **THANK YOU!!**
Ryan

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: In 24 hours we make history
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We’re down to the final 24 hours.
Tomorrow, we don’t just cast votes – we make history.
We take everything we’ve built together, every conversation, every moment of doubt turned into determination, and we shape the future we’ve dreamed of.
When we started this movement, there were plenty of skeptics.
Pundits said we didn’t stand a chance.
They underestimated what happens when a strong woman steps up with purpose and fire in her heart.
And here we are, even in the polls and the most well-funded and structured opponent Jim Jordan has ever faced on the cusp of proving everyone wrong.
Not just for me, not just for Ohio, but for every woman who’s ever been told she can’t – and then went out and did it anyway.
This is our moment to show the power of women’s leadership.
It’s women who will deliver the House, the Senate, and the White House.
We’ve seen time and again that when women lead, communities thrive, progress is made, and voices long ignored are finally heard.
Will you chip in $25, $50, or more now to help us push through these final 24 hours? Your support now ensures we reach every last voter. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241104_election_eve_link1]
Think of the future we’re building – a future where strong women aren’t just part of the conversation, they lead it.
Where policies are shaped by empathy and real-world experience, where our children see role models who reflect resilience and courage, and where equality and justice are not just ideals but the standard.
In these final moments, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
Tomorrow, we can turn the page on years of ULTRA-MAGA chaos, division, and neglect.
We can replace fear and anger with hope and progress. But it’s going to take all of us giving every ounce of energy, every phone call, every conversation, every single dollar.
Here’s the truth – strong women have been quietly changing the world for centuries.
Tomorrow, we will make it loud.
This is more than an election.
This is a movement driven by every grandmother who fought for her rights, every mother who balanced it all, every young woman dreaming of her place in the world, and every girl watching and thinking, “I can do that too.”

We’re down to the wire here and need to ask if you can split a contribution between two critical Senate campaigns and ours: Tammy Baldwin in Wisconsin and Colin Allred in Texas. Friends,

My uncle has always been for sale. Any person or entity, from Putin to Saudi Arabia’s LIV Golf, willing to throw Donald a few bucks for a Trump Tower condo has gained access and influence.

And now, Big Tech billionaire Elon Musk has purchased a few shares in exchange for the keys to the federal government. **According to the _New York Times_ , Musk has spent at least $140 million on the pro-Trump America PAC** — and Donald has told several people that this amount could increase to as much as _$500 million_.

Musk’s efforts to amplify my uncle’s message has made it “impossible to capture the financial value of all the support [Musk] is providing” to my uncle. In fact, Donald’s campaign is coordinating with Musk in order to suppress or remove stories the campaign finds unflattering or harmful to its mission. **They want to keep the American electorate as ignorant as possible — we fight back with voter education campaigns to combat disinformation and spread the truth.** [**Rush a split donation between Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and my org to help us ensure that voters have the information they need to exercise their right to vote in just 1 day!**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56766?t=7&akid=22508%2E4449941%2Ezc1r4-) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and the Democracy Defense Fund will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/56767?t=8&akid=22508%2E4449941%2Ezc1r4-)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Jill Stein
subject: What we’re fighting for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=closing_argument&n=1)
---
Peter,

For months now, our campaign rallying cry has been: **_As Gaza goes, we all go.

_** This is not just a plea to remember Gaza, stop this horrific genocide, and free Palestine.

**It’s a reminder that all that we are fighting for is connected, that we are fighting empire both abroad and at home.

** Working people are struggling to keep up with the cost of rent and put food on the table. They’re delaying critical, lifesaving healthcare and rationing their prescriptions to keep the lights on.

Everyday Americans are watching their homes get swallowed up by floods and hurricanes and wildfires brought on by the climate emergency.

There is so much that our government can do – the tenacity and ingenuity and love of our people can do – to solve these problems.

But instead of helping us, the two corporate parties remain chained to Wall Street and the war machine – shoveling TRILLIONS of dollars into endless war and genocide abroad.

And when we rise up and organize, demanding justice and an end to forever wars, they attempt to crush our movements with sweeping police brutality – sending in cops armed with weapons of war and trained by Israeli Occupation Forces.

When we begin to organize for electoral power, they weaponize administrative systems and the courts to kick us off the ballot and deny YOU a real choice.

All of this money and effort and time and energy that is poured into limiting our options and controlling our bodies and keeping us compliant COULD be poured into building a society where everyone’s basic needs are met – one designed around human thriving and a livable future.

**We have the capacity to solve great problems. We do not have to settle. Never let anyone tell you that your choice is irrelevant.

** In the last few weeks, our movement has been smeared and slandered. People have questioned my motives – and yours.

They keep asking me why I am running, as if the answer is not obvious.

The system is not broken, it’s working exactly as designed. And it’s time we build a new one.

We’re running for the world we want to build. We’re running for the future we deserve. We’re running for the sustainability of life as we know it.

That’s the choice before us tomorrow, America. And no matter which way the votes come down when the polls close, it is the world we will keep fighting for.

[**Thank you for your support throughout this journey. We still have much work to do, and I would be grateful for any contribution today to carry us forward.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=closing_argument&n=2)

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---
It’s important that we don’t let any of our allies fall prey to Trump’s sloppy, self-serving lies. I’ve called out his corruption and incompetence for years.

I will keep doing so until this public menace is driven out of power for good.
---

Team,

Hello,
It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.
So 5 years after the day that changed my and my brother’s lives, I am asking you to support my pro-democracy movement and protect this seat from my extremist opponent.

**We’ve identified the places where your contribution will have an _outsized_ impact.** What you do right now may make the difference for some of these toss-up races:
* In Arizona, Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the state house and state senate. If we can help get out the vote and _win a majority in both chambers_ , we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
* In New Hampshire, mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. _Democrats need to win majorities in the state house and state senate_ to prevent Republicans from engaging in mid-cycle partisan gerrymandering.
* In Michigan, _Republicans are trying to take back the state house_ and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
* In Minnesota, the Democrats hold a trifecta which helped enact Gov. Tim Walz’s bold agenda. _Republicans only need to flip five seats to gain control of the state house_ and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen there this year.
* Pennsylvania is currently the only state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the state house in 2022. If we _flip the state senate_ AND _hold the state house_ , another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform.

clean_body: When it’s this close, what we do today and tomorrow could make the difference in these extremely tight races. | Peter, We’ve been closely watching the key legislative chambers that are likely to flip tomorrow. Back in the summer, Politico reported that Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, and Pennsylvania as the five states that were “the most likely to see legislative chambers flip in November.” And just last week, Sabato’s Crystal Ball included those in a short list of the “most vulnerable to a party shift.” All five of these states are on our list of priority states. We’ve been working hard to flip chambers in Arizona and New Hampshire; to hold chambers in Michigan and Minnesota; and to do both in Pennsylvania — flip the state senate and defend the state house. The future of electoral maps in these five crucial states are at stake — and with these elections coming down to the wire, we need your help. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = We’ve identified the places where your contribution will have an outsized impact. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers , we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. In New Hampshire, mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win majorities in the state house and state senate to prevent Republicans from engaging in mid-cycle partisan gerrymandering. In Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the state house and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. In Minnesota, the Democrats hold a trifecta which helped enact Gov. Fellow Patriot, I’ve waited my whole life to email you. # Dear Friend,
# San Diego County is facing serious challenges, and it’s time for a leader who shows up,
takes action, and delivers results. As your Supervisor, I will hit the ground running withthe experience, dedication, and solutions to our community needs.
I’ll work every day to ensure our police officers have the resources they need to keepour neighborhoods safe, and I refuse to let San Diego County turn into the nextLos Angeles or San Francisco. I will support expanding shelter spaces, increasingmental health resources, and making sure those struggling on our streets have a path tosafety, care, and stability.
As Mayor, I successfully reduced homelessness, and I’m ready to do it again as yourCounty Supervisor. Together, we’ll get San Diego County moving in the right directionby creating real solutions for those most in need and by providing our communities withthe safety and support they deserve.
But I need your help. Please reach out to your friends, family, and neighbors and askthem to join us in voting for a better future. Together, we can create a safer, morecompassionate San Diego County.
Thank you for your support.
With gratitude,
Kevin Faulconer

body:
With just ONE DAY LEFT before Election Day and hundreds of millions being spent in these races, we simply can't slow down.
#
**BIG NEWS:** Not only did we hit our $180,000 goal to protect the Frontline Five — the five Democratic senators in the closest races — **we blew past it and are set to raise $250,000 to protect these champions for working families and reproductive freedom.**
**[I hate to ask again, Derek, but here's the thing: With just ONE DAY LEFT before Election Day and hundreds of millions being spent in these races, we simply can't slow down. So will you rush $5 to make sure we protect the Frontline Five?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241104?refcode=em20241104-9562&refcode2=9562_434096_87E2uB&akid=9562%2E434096%2E87E2uB)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241104?amount=5&refcode=em20241104-9562&refcode2=9562_434096_87E2uB&akid=9562%2E434096%2E87E2uB)**
I appreciate everything Team Fetterman does for these folks. Backing all 5 of them is no small feat, because every single one of them REALLY matters.
Here's exactly why each of their races is so close:
**💪 Bob Casey (Pennsylvania)**
**Cook Political Report Rating:** Toss-Up
A new poll shows Bob trailing for the first time — but it's by a mere 0.4% despite the fact that Mitch McConnell and Republican outside groups are spending more here in Pennsylvania than Michigan, Wisconsin and Arizona _combined_. I'll be damned if I let my partner for protecting PA get pushed out by a bunch of out-of-state jagoffs.
**🚜 Jon Tester (Montana)**
**Cook Political Report Rating:** Leans Republican
Jon is the only working dirt farmer in the U.S. Senate, and won his first Senate race by just 3,562 votes. 2024 might be his closest yet. Don't let the haters tell you Democrats can't win in places like Montana. Jon has, repeatedly, and dammit we're gonna fight tooth and nail so he does again.
**🎲 Jacky Rosen (Nevada)**
**Cook Political Report Rating:** Leans Democratic
The last Senate election in Nevada was decided by just 7,928 votes — or roughly _one percent_. Donald Trump keeps showing up in the state and Mitch McConnell's Super PAC is spending $6.2 million on ads to defeat Jacky. But I'd never bet against someone who worked as a cocktail waitress at Caesar's Palace to pay her way through college.
**🐦 Sherrod Brown (Ohio)**
**Cook Political Report Rating:** Toss-Up
You'll be hard-pressed to find a harder fighter for blue collar workers than Sherrod. Compare that to his jagoff of an opponent who's been accused in lawsuits of not paying his employees overtime. Who DOES that? With $441 million dumped into Ohio, this race is on record to be the most expensive Senate race in the country.
**🧀 Tammy Baldwin (Wisconsin)**
**Cook Political Report Rating:** Toss-Up
Seriously, where do Republicans keep finding these rich out-of-staters? Tammy's opponent is the CEO of a multi-billion dollar bank, so he's got deep pockets to buy this seat. But Tammy's tough enough to beat him — you don't become the first openly gay woman elected to the House AND Senate if you aren't tough.
**If Democrats don't hold the Senate,** there's no chance of passing a national law that protects your reproductive freedom regardless of your zip code.
**If Democrats don't hold the Senate,** we can't pass legislation that lifts up working families like expanding the child tax credit, increasing financial assistance for first-time home buyers, and paid sick leave for ALL workers.
**[I know, the emails and texts and phone calls are all coming fast and furious. But with just ONE DAY LEFT, there's no way I want any of us to look back and wish we'd done more. So will you have the Frontline Five's back one more time? Pitch in $5 or more right now>> ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20241104?refcode=em20241104-9562&refcode2=9562_434096_87E2uB&akid=9562%2E434096%2E87E2uB)**

❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

It’s fun, easy, and incredibly valuable in a race that could come down to hundreds of votes among millions. You could be the person who gets someone out to vote for Kamala, Peter; there’s not many feelings more rewarding than that! = Let’s finish the job and win this thing. — Wiley Wiley Nickel for North Carolina PO Box 563 Raleigh, NC 27602 United States | mailto:info@wileynickel.com | Paid for by Wiley Nickel for North Carolina
